OCR: 'supradicto cognationis die' read as 'coronationis die'; 'translatant' for 'translatam'. Volume 9 = 1876 but the Brief is of 1875. Country derived from 'Bononiae'.

rubric_latin: BREVE quo Archiepiscopo Taurinensi committitur facultas solemniter coronandi, nomine et auctoritate Apostolica, Imaginem Mariae SS. Auxiliatricis.
incipit_latin: Omnium sane templorum quae bo. me. Ioannes Bosco Salesianae Sodalitatis pater legifer ad maiorem Dei gloriam
image_title_latin: Imago Mariae SS. Auxiliatricis (Beatae Virginis Opiferae)

notes: Rubric OCR reads 'nomine et tauctoritate Apostolica' -> 'auctoritate'; addressee line OCR spaced as 'R i c h e l m y'. The Brief commits to the Archbishop of Turin the faculty to crown the image 'solemni ritu Nostro nomine et auctoritate', with a diadem to be imposed on both heads ('sacro utrique capiti tum Virginis tum Pueri Iesu diadema pro dignitate imponatur') - so the Infant Jesus is crowned as well. Petitioner: Michael Rua, Rector Major of the Salesians. Classified as papal_coronation_act because this is the granting act itself, though it simultaneously deputes Card. Richelmy to crown in the Pope's name (papal_legate_deputation is a defensible alternative). Exact coronation date not stated: only 'huius anni die per te eligendo', i.e. a day of 1903 to be chosen by the Archbishop. Datum 'die XIII Februarii MCMIII' = 1903, the second year of ASS vol. 35 (1902-03). Text of the act runs on to printed p. 581.

rubric_latin: EPISTOLA SS.mi D. N. Leonis PP. XIII ad Moderatorem Generalem Salesianorum, occasione eorumdem conventus.

The letter itself names no church or town, but the address line reads 'Dilecto filio Michaeli Rua Moderatori Generali Sodalitatis Salesianae Augustae Taurinorum', hence Turin; locality/diocese/country inferred from that address line, so confidence lowered to medium. Datum OCR 'die x n Maii MGMIII' read as die XII Maii MCMIII = 1903-05-12 (Pontificatus anno vigesimo sexto confirms 1903). Coronation year 1903 inferred from the imminence of the congress relative to the letter's date.

rubric_latin: LITTERAE APOSTOLICAE quibus LEO PP. XIII gratulatur Archiepiscopo Cameracen, de felici exitu Incoronationis B. Mariae Virginis « Des Dunes ».

The act is printed in French on p. 10 ('le couronnement de Notre Dame des Dunes'), with the Latin 'Versio' on p. 11 — the incipit given here is from that Versio; the French incipit after the salutation is 'L'eclatant exemple de foi et de piete donne publiquement, ces jours derniers, par la ville de Dunkerque'. Coronation date not stated beyond 'ces jours derniers' / 'diebus nuper transactis' before the Datum of 10 June 1903, so only the year is recorded. Also indexed in the volume's Summa Actorum (p. 758) and Index (p. 764) as 'de felici exitu Incoronationis B. M. V. des Dunes ... 10'. rubric_latin: Ecclesia B. Mariae Virginis Gratiarum in Monte Sancto ad dignitatem Basilicae minoris evehitur.
incipit_latin: In sublimi Beati Petri Cathedra, ad quam licet immerentes evecti sumus, nihil potius habemus, quam sacrarum aedium honor et cultus magis magisque in dies augeatur.

church_or_sanctuary: Ecclesia Beatae Mariae Virginis Gratiarum in Monte Sancto
locality: Mons Sanctus prope Urbem Goritiam (Monte Santo / Sveta Gora, near Gorizia)
notes: Brief elevating the church to a minor basilica; the coronation is mentioned in passing: 'venerata Deiparae Virginis Imago quae summa religione ibidem colitur iam inde ab anno MDCCXVII ex decreto Capituli Vaticani aureo diademate ornata sit' — i.e. crowned with a golden diadem in 1717 by decree of the Vatican Chapter. The act begins on printed p. 19 (rubric + 'AD PERPETUAM REI MEMORIAM'); the coronation sentence itself falls on p. 20, which is the passage's printed_page. Datum line reads 'die XIX Novembris MCMVI, Pontificatus Nostri anno quarto' = 1906-11-19, one year earlier than the volume year (ASS 40 = 1907); trusted the act. The text places the shrine 'prope Urbem Goritiensem' in 'Austriacae Ditionis' (Austrian Littoral, county of Gorizia, 1907); the modern country is inferred — Sveta Gora / Monte Santo lies today in Slovenia, above Nova Gorica, just across the Italian border — hence confidence lowered to medium. Raw OCR: 'celebérrimas' for 'celeberrimas'. No vernacular title given in the text.

rubric_latin: Pii PP. X circa coronationem simulacri S. Cordis Iesu.
incipit_latin: Me taedet preces tuas exaudire non posse eo quod S. Rituum Congregatio ultimis hisce diebus incongruum declaravit imaginibus divini Cordis Iesu coronas imponere
notes: NEGATIVE norm, not a grant: Pius X tells Léon Gauthey, Bishop of Nevers, that he cannot grant his petition because the S. Congregation of Rites has just declared it 'incongruum' to impose crowns on images of the Sacred Heart of Jesus, permitting only that a crown be laid at the feet of the statue ('corona ad simulacri pedes deponatur'), which the bishop may do in the Pope's name. Emitted as `norms` per SPEC (general legislation about crowning images) with image fields null, though the letter arises from one concrete case: a simulacrum of the Sacred Heart in the diocese of Nevers (Nivernensis), France, for which no coronation was in fact permitted. Retained because it is the governing rule of the period on crowning Sacred Heart images and explains later refusals. Datum: 'Ex aedibus Vaticanis, die 9 Iulii 1908'. OCR: 'exaudiré' -> 'exaudire'. The letter is indexed at ASS 41, p. 621 ('Epistola Pii X circa coronationem simulacri S. Cordis Iesu ... 621').

rubric_latin: TEMPLUM B. M. VIRGINIS VULGO " DEL PILASTRELLO " PROPE LENDINARAM ADRIENSIS DIOECESEOS AD DIGNITATEM BASILICAE MINORIS EVEHITUR.

image_title_latin: simulacrum Virginis Iesum Infantem ulnis gestantis, B. M. V. de Pila parva
church_or_sanctuary: Templum B. Mariae Virginis de Pila parva, vulgo "dei Pilastrello" (Olivetan monastery church)

OCR 'tempia' repaired to 'templa'. Diocese is today Adria-Rovigo.

rubric_latin: ECCLESIA S. DOMINICI CONFESSORIS, CORDUBAE IN REPUBLICA ARGENTINA, ERIGITUR IN BASILICAM MINOREM.

Decessoris Nostri nomine et auctoritate aureo diademate redimitam fuisse vetustissimam ac thaumaturgam Virginis Deiparae Imaginem'. OCR prints the year as 'MDCCcxcii' = 1892. The image is said to have come ashore at Callao in Peru and thence been taken to Córdoba.

rubric_latin: ECCLESIA AUGUSTAE TAURINORUM IN HONOREM VIRGINIS CHRISTIANORUM ADIUTRICIS ERIGITUR IN BASILICAM MINOREM.
incipit_latin: Anno reparatae salutis MDCCCLXXXVI pietate ac religione insignis vir, venerabilis Dei famulus Ioannes Bosco, Salesianae familiae pater ac legifer, Augustae Taurinorum ab imis fundamentis splendidum in honorem Deiparae Virginis Christianorum Adiutricis templum excitandum curavit
image_title_latin: Imago thaumaturgae Virginis Adiutricis (Deipara Virgo Christianorum Adiutrix)
church_or_sanctuary: Sacra Aedes Deiparae Virginis Christianorum Adiutricis (Salesian sanctuary, Valdocco)
notes: Basilica Minor elevation; states that Leo XIII gave the Cardinal Archbishop of Turin the faculty to impose a golden diadem in his name and by his authority 'sexto Kalendas Iunias anno millesimo nongentesimo tertio' = 27 May 1903. The crowner is not named at that point ('Cardinali Antistiti Taurinensium'); the same act later names Augustinus S. R. E. Card. Richelmy as Archbishop of Turin, so legate left null. Passage printed_page was 411; the act begins on printed page 410 (rubric and incipit verified in the volume text), used as aas_page. Country Italy inferred from Turin - unambiguous.

rubric_latin: AD R. P. D. FRANCISCUM M. GIEURE, BAIONENSIUM EPISCOPUM, OCCASIONE CORONATIONE B. MARIAE V. « DU BEAU RAMEAU », AD TEMPLUM BÉTHARRAM.

notes: Source passage in this batch is the volume index (printed p. 751, 'Dies non longe. - Ad R. P. D. Franciscum M. Gieure ... occasione coronationis B. M. Virginis « du Beau Rameau », ad templum Bétharram'); the act itself was read in txt/AAS-04-1912-ocr.txt at printed p. 490, so `page` is set to 490 rather than the index page 751. The same volume's analytic index (batch passage AAS-04-1912-ocr#g771, p. 771) repeats it: 'Gieure Franciscus ... epistolam accipit, qua ei fit potestas B. M. V. « du Beau Rameau » ad Bétharram decorandi aureis coronis a beatissimo Patre oblatis, 490.' Key act wording: 'idemque binas afferet áureas coronas, quibus tibi divinae Matris Filiique effigiem, sollemnibus caeremoniis, exornandi facimus potestatem' — the Pope sends two golden crowns via Victor Bourdenne, Procurator General, and grants the diocesan bishop the faculty to crown the image of the Virgin and Child. OCR of the rubric reads 'GIBURE' for GIEURE and 'CORONATIONE' for CORONATIONIS. coronation_date: the letter (14 June 1912) says the solemnity is imminent ('Dies non longe abest'), and the index heads the letter 'occasione coronationis', so the year 1912 is stated in substance; no day/month given. Country inferred from the diocese of Bayonne, named in the rubric.

rubric_latin: DE SANCTUARIO S. MARIAE AD RUPES AD VALLEM SUPPENTONIAM.
incipit_latin: Quo pietatis studium in Cristifidelium animis impensius excitarent Sanctorumque cultum omni ope proveherent, consueverunt Romani Pontifices decessores Nostri perhonorificis nominibus, privilegiis gratiisque ea loca sacra vel templa augere
image_title_latin: Sacerrimum Virginis simulacrum, S. Maria ad Rupes
church_or_sanctuary: Sanctuarium S. Mariae ad Rupes
locality: Castel Sant'Elia (sancti Eliae Castrum), vallis Suppentonia
notes: Motu proprio erecting the sanctuary into a minor basilica, stating in passing 'decreto Ordinis Canonicorum Basilicae Vaticanae, sacerrimo Virginis simulacro diadema ex auro gemmisque est impositum' - i.e. crowning by decree of the Vatican Chapter; no date given. Passage printed_page was 554; the act begins on printed page 553 (rubric and incipit verified in the volume text), used as aas_page. OCR reads 'Cristifidelium' for 'Christifidelium'. Country Italy inferred from Nepi/Castel Sant'Elia - unambiguous.

rubric_latin: AD V. E. DOMINICUM CARD. FERRATA, ARCHIPRESBYTERUM LATERANENSEM, QUEM RENUNTIAT LEGATUM SUUM AD CONVENTUM EUCHARISTICUM MELITENSEM.

image_title_latin: sacerrimum Virginis Deiparae simulacrum quod Conspicuae colitur
legate: Dominicus Card. Ferrata
notes: Letter naming Ferrata Legate to the Malta Eucharistic Congress; it recalls in passing that Pius X had earlier sent him to Malta to crown a Marian image: 'ea ipsa loca non ita pridem, missus item a Nobis, adivisti, ut sacerrimo Virginis Deiparae simulacro quod Conspicuae colitur, auream coronam imponeres'. 'Conspicuae' is a locative and is read as Cospicua (Bormla), Malta - identification inferred, hence medium confidence. No date is given for the crowning ('non ita pridem'). The diocese (Melitensis) is inferred from the Maltese setting, not stated for the image.

rubric_latin: AD R. P. D. VINCENTIUM SCOZZOLI, ARIMINENSIUM EPISCOPUM, SAECULO IAM EXEUNTE, EX QUO S. P. PIUS VII, V. R., E GALLICA CAPTIVITATE REDUX, SIMULACRUM SSMAE VIRGINIS MARIAE, ARIMINENSIBUS SACRUM, DIADEMATE EXORNAVIT.

image_title_latin: pervetustum Virginis augustae simulacrum, Ariminensibus sacrum
notes: Pius VII crowned the image in person while passing through Rimini on his return from captivity in France: 'qui Ariminum pertransiens e gallica redux captivitate ... regio illud diademate ornavit'. No year is given; the 1914 letter says the century is drawing to a close ('saeculo iam exeunte'), which implies c. 1814 - not stated, so coronation_date left null. Datum reads 'die viri aprilis' in the OCR = die VIII aprilis. The same act is indexed at AAS 6 (1914) 733 and 762.

rubric_latin: AD R. P. D. IOSEPHUM SCATTI, EPISCOPUM SAVONENSEM ET NAULENSEM, DE SACRIS SOLLEMNIBUS ANNO PROXIMO SAVONAE CELEBRANDIS QUOD CENTUM ANNIS ANTE PIUS VII P. M. IMAGINEM " MATRIS MISERICORDIAE " CORONA REDIMIERAT.
incipit_latin: Si unquam recentioribus aetatibus Petri navicula turbulentissimis est iactata fluctibus, id certe tum evenit
image_title_latin: miserentissimae Matris imago, Mater Misericordiae
notes: Pius VII crowned the image in person: 'post annum, promissa exsecutus, istic miserentissimae Matris imaginem pretiosa corona redimiit'. The year 1815 is derived from the rubric ('centum annis ante') read against the centenary solemnities announced for 7-13 May 1915 - not printed as a numeral, so treat the year as reconstructed. Same act indexed at AAS 6 (1914) 733-734 and 762.

rubric_latin: AD R. P. D. IOSEPHUM SCATTI, EPISCOPUM SAVONENSEM ET NAULENSEM, OB SOLLEMNIA SAECULARIA IN HONOREM DOMINAE NOSTRAE A MISERICORDIA.
incipit_latin: Decessorem Nostrum sanctae memoriae Pium X scimus anno superiore, datis ad te litteris, venerabilis Frater, de sacris saecularibus
image_title_latin: simulacrum Savonense, Maria Auxiliatrix christianorum, Domina Nostra a Misericordia
church_or_sanctuary: Savonensis aedes (Marian sanctuary of Savona)
notes: Attests the personal coronation by Pius VII: 'eundemque anno post, aurea corona simulacro Savonensi imposita, votum Mariae Auxiliatrici christianorum solvisse' ('abhinc fere centum annis'). Year 1815 reconstructed (a year after Pius VII's return in 1814); not printed as a numeral. Benedict XV here deputes Andrea Card. Ferrari, Archbishop of Milan, as his Legate to the centenary solemnities - not to a coronation - so the legate field is left null. The letter begins on printed p. 201; the passage's printed_page is 202.

rubric_latin: AD R. P. D. BARNABAM PIEDRABUENA, EPISCOPUM CATAMARCENSIUM, DE SOLLEMNIBUS GRATULATUR, QUAE B. M. V. « DEL VALLE » APPARANTUR.

image_title_latin: B. M. V. « del Valle » / Nostra Domina « dei Valle »
notes: The batch passage is the volume index (printed p. 500), whose entry ('Litteris tuis. - Ad R. P. D. Barnabam Piedrabuena, episcopum Catamarciensium, de sollemnibus gratulatur, quae B. M. V. « dei Valle » apparantur') does not itself mention a crowning; the crowning is attested in the act it points to, read in txt/AAS-08-1916-ocr.txt at printed p. 144: 'iidem, labente vicesimo quinto anno ex quo Virginis simulacrum, sollemni Ecclesiae ritu, aureo donatum est diademate, velint huius eventus faustitatem iteranda pietatis significatione commemorare'. `page` therefore set to 144, not to the index page 500. coronation_date 1891 is arithmetic: the 25th year was running in 1916 ('labente vicesimo quinto anno'); the act itself states no year, so verify. The act names no authority for the original coronation beyond 'sollemni Ecclesiae ritu'. Country inferred from the see of Catamarca (the act speaks of an Apostolic Legate 'apud istam Rempublicam'). The Legate named in the act (Achilles, titular archbishop of Thessalonica) is deputed for the 1916 anniversary solemnities, not for the coronation, so `legate` is left null.

rubric_latin: TEMPLUM S. MARIAE VULGO " DI POZZANO ", APUD STABIAM SEU CASTRUM MARIS, TITULO BASILICAE HONESTATUR.
incipit_latin: Romanorum Pontificum Decessorum Nostrorum vestigia persequentes, sacras Aedes, quae, ante actis aetatibus erectae artisque omne genus operibus exornatae
image_title_latin: vetustissima Imago Virginis Deiparae, B. Virgo a Pozzano
church_or_sanctuary: Sanctuarium Mariale in colle vulgo Pozzano (Ord. Minimorum)
locality: Castellammare di Stabia (Castrum Maris seu Stabia)
notes: 'Ordo Canonicorum Basilicae Vaticanae anno MDCCCLXXIV, cum ingenti bonorum plausu laetitiaque, eandem Deiparae Imaginem aurea corona redimiit.' The act begins on printed p. 259 (passage printed_page is 260). Two other images in the same church (Christ crucified, St Francis of Paola) are mentioned but not said to be crowned.

rubric_latin: " PARVUM SANCTUARIUM MARIAE VIRGINIS PERDOLENTIS VULGO ' AL FIUMICELLO ' ", QUOD NEAPOLI EXSTAT, PONTIFICIO COGNOMINE PERPETUO DECORATUR.
incipit_latin: Romani Pontifices Decessores Nostri, ut Christiani populi religio ac pietas erga Deiparam Virginem magis magisque augescerent in dies
image_title_latin: simulacrum B. Mariae Virginis Perdolentis
church_or_sanctuary: Sacra Aedes B. Mariae Virgini Perdolenti dicata, vulgo " al Fiumicello "
notes: Pius X granted the Archbishop of Naples the faculty to crown the image ('facultatem libenter fecit, ut simulacrum eiusdem B. Virginis ... aurea corona redimiret'); it was carried out in the metropolitan church on 4 September 1910 in the Pope's name and by his authority by the Cardinal Archbishop, who is not named in the text. The act is dated 1916 although printed in AAS vol. 9 (1917); this is confirmed by the surrounding acts, which run in date order from Oct. 1914 to Feb. 1916, and by 'Pontificatus Nostri anno secundo'.

rubric_latin: CURIALE TEMPLUM RHEDONENSE, SUB TITULO SS.MI SALVATORIS ET B. M. V. DE MIRACULIS ET VIRTUTIBUS, BASILICAE MINORIS DIGNITATE IN PERPETUUM COHONESTATUR.

image_title_latin: Simulacrum B. Mariae Virginis de Miraculis et Virtutibus
church_or_sanctuary: Curiale templum Ssmi Salvatoris et B. M. V. de Miraculis et Virtutibus

rubric_latin: TITULUS BASILICAE MINORIS PRO PAROCHIALI ECCLESIA RHEDONENSI S. ALBINO EP. ET CONF. AC B. M. V. DE BONIS NUNTIIS DICATA.
incipit_latin: Conspicua Dei templa, quae non minus antiquitate et artis splendore, quam potissimum decore, cultu et fidelium celebritate excellant
image_title_latin: Imago Deiparae Virginis Mariae de Bonis Nuntiis
church_or_sanctuary: Ecclesia parochialis S. Albini Ep. et Conf. ac B. M. V. de Bonis Nuntiis

rubric_latin: ECCLESIA TARVISINA ASSUMPTIONIS B. M. V., VULGO " LA MADONNA GRANDE " TITULO ET PRIVILEGIIS BASILICAE MINORIS DECORATUR.

church_or_sanctuary: Ecclesia S. Mariae Maioris, vulgo " La Madonna Grande "
notes: 'SSmae Virginis imaginem aurea corona ex Capituli Vaticani decreto usque ab anno MDCCCXGVII redimitam fuisse' - OCR 'MDCCCXGVII' read as MDCCCXCVII = 1897. The act begins on printed p. 324 (passage printed_page is 325).

rubric_latin: TEMPLUM VULGO «DEL CARMINE MAGGIORE» NUNCUPATUM CIVITATIS NEAPOLITANAE IN BASILICAM MINOREM ERIGITUR.

church_or_sanctuary: Templum B. Mariae Virginis de Carmelo, vulgo « del Carmine Maggiore »
notes: Basilica minor act; coronation stated in passing: « Novissime prodigiosa Imago anno millesimo octingentesimo septuagesimo quinto a Capitulo Nostro Vaticano diademate aureo sollemni pompa redimita fuit ». Crowned by the Vatican Chapter, not personally by the Pope. The act opens on printed page 12 (rubric + 'Ad perpetuam rei memoriam'); the coronation clause falls on page 13, so aas_page is the act's START page.

rubric_latin: TEMPLUM B. MARIAE VIRG. DE MERCEDE IN CIVITATE BARCINONENSI TITULO ET PRIVILEGIIS BASILICAE MINORIS DECORATUR.
incipit_latin: Conspicua templa in memoriam magni alicuius eventus erecta, quaeque non minus artis operibus quam et cultus splendore et potissimum fidelium pietate praestent

image_title_vernacular: Mare de Déu de la Mercè / Nuestra Señora de la Merced
church_or_sanctuary: Regale templum parochiale B. Mariae Virginis de Mercede
notes: 'dum Leo XIII tam insigne simulacrum aurea corona redimiendum sollemniter decrevit' - no year is given, so coronation_date is null; it falls within the pontificate of Leo XIII (1878-1903). The act begins on printed p. 435 (passage printed_page is 436).

rubric_latin: TEMPLUM LOCARNENSE B. M. VIRGINIS A SAXO, IN DIOECESI LUGANENSI, TITULO AC PRIVILEGIIS BASILICAE MINORIS HONESTATUR.
incipit_latin: Locarni, intra fines Luganensis dioecesis, antiquum exstat percelebre templum Deo in honorem B. Mariae Virg. a Saxo dicatum
image_title_latin: ligneum affabre sculptum simulacrum B. Mariae Virg. a Saxo, in ulnis Puerum Iesum gestantis
church_or_sanctuary: Templum B. Mariae Virg. a Saxo (Ord. Fratrum Minorum Capulatorum)
notes: The image was crowned twice: 'semel iterumque aureo diademate redimitum fuit, primo quidem a Legato Apostolico apud Helvetios anno MDCXVII; secundo autem decreto Vaticani Capituli anno MDCCCLXXX, scilicet quarto redeunte centenario a mirifica Deiparae Virginis apparitione'. coronation_date records the second (Vatican Chapter) crowning of 1880; the first was in 1617 by the Apostolic Legate to Switzerland.

rubric_latin: ECCLESIA ROTHOMAGENSIS B. M. VIRGINIS A BONO SUCCURSU TITULO AC PRIVILEGIIS BASILICAE MINORIS DECORATUR.
incipit_latin: Illustriores inter sacras Aedes, quae tum praestantibus artis operibus Galliae regiones illustrant, tum Francorum religionis alacre studium miramque munificentiam late praedicant
image_title_latin: simulacrum B. Mariae Virginis a Bono Succursu (cum Infante Iesu)
church_or_sanctuary: Ecclesia parochialis B. Mariae Virginis a Bono Succursu (sanctuarium Mariale)
legate: S. R. E. Cardinalis de Bonnechose, Rothomagensium antistes
notes: Basilica minor act reporting the earlier coronation: « nono kalendas iunias anno millesimo octingentesimo octogesimo ... Cardinalis de Bonnechose ... pretiosissimum et auro et gemmis coronam, Decessoris Nostri ... Leonis Pp. XIII nomine, eidem simulacro Virginis et Infantis Iesu ... sollemni ritu imposuit ». 'nono kalendas iunias' converted to 24 May 1880. The crown was imposed on both the Virgin and the Infant Jesus. Act opens on printed page 226; the coronation clause is on page 227, so aas_page is the act's START page. 'legate' here is the prelate who actually crowned the image in Leo XIII's name, recorded retrospectively, not a legate deputed by this act.

rubric_latin: AD R. P. D. MARTINUM HIERONYMUM IZARD, ARCHIEPISCOPUM BITURICENSEM, QUINQUAGESIMO REDEUNTE ANNO CUM IMAGINI DOMINAE NOSTRAE A S. CORDE IESU IN BASILICA EXOLDUNENSI AUREA CORONA IMPOSITA EST.

church_or_sanctuary: Basilica Exoldunensis (basilica of Our Lady of the Sacred Heart)
legate: Carolus A. de la Tour d'Auvergne, Archiepiscopus Bituricensis (crowned 'nomine decessoris Nostri f. r. Pii IX')
notes: Letter of Benedict XV to Abp Martin Jerome Izard of Bourges for the golden jubilee of the coronation. The passage does not state the coronation year explicitly: it says the fiftieth year is about to be completed ('annus propediem expleatur quinquagesimus') since the crowning done by Abp de la Tour d'Auvergne in the name of Pius IX, and the jubilee solemnities are set for 8 September (letter dated 15 Aug 1919), hence 1869 - inferred, verify. The 'legate' field records the prelate who performed the original crowning in the Pope's name, not a legate deputed by this act. Rubric OCR read 'BITURICENSEM' as 'BITÜRICENSEM'.

rubric_latin: ECCLESIA B. M. VIRGINIS AD NIVES, IN OPPIDO CUGLIERI, DIOECESIS BOSANENSIS, BASILICAE MINORIS TITULO AC PRIVILEGIIS HONESTATUR.

image_title_latin: Beata Maria Virgo ad Nives
church_or_sanctuary: Sanctuarium seu Ecclesia Conlegiata Beatae Mariae Virginis ad Nives

Rubric OCR 'ECCLESIA EU M. VIRGINIS' repaired to 'ECCLESIA B. M. VIRGINIS'. Marble statue ('marmoreum eius simulacrum, auro gemmisque ornatum').

rubric_latin: SANCTUARIUM BEATAE MARIAE VIRGINIS DE POUPSIS, VULGO « DI POLSI », IN DIOECESI HIERACENSI, TITULO ABBATIAE NULLIUS DECORATUR, ET RECTORI EIUS PRO TEMPORE CONCEDUNTUR TITULUS ABBATIS NULLIUS, NONNULLA PRIVILEGIA ET FACULTAS SACRAMENTI CONFIRMATIONIS CONFERENDI CERTIS CIRCUMSCRIPTA FINIBUS.
incipit_latin: Sanctuarium beatae Mariae Virginis de Poupsis, vulgo di Polsi, in finibus dioecesis Hieracensis situm, a comite Rogerio Normanno aut a Rogerio I rege exstructum dicitur
image_title_latin: Beata Maria Virgo de Poupsis (Regina Montium)
church_or_sanctuary: Sanctuarium Beatae Mariae Virginis de Poupsis (di Polsi)
notes: Act granting the title of abbatia nullius; it states in passing 'Beatae Mariae Virginis signum sollemni ritu, die xxx mensis augusti an. MDCCCLXXXI, aurea redimitum corona'. No crowning authority named. Act begins on printed page 151 (passage printed_page is 152) and ends p. 154 with the Datum used here.

rubric_latin: ECCLESIA SANCTAE MARIAE ANGELORUM IN URBE AD BASILICAM MINOREM EVEHITUR.
incipit_latin: Titulum sancti Cyriaci in Thermis, fidei christianorum tempore Diocletiani imperatoris perinsigne monumentum, inde ab anno 1091 Carthusianis commissum
image_title_latin: Beata Maria Virgo Angelorum
church_or_sanctuary: Ecclesia sanctae Mariae Angelorum (S. Maria degli Angeli e dei Martiri, in the Baths of Diocletian)
notes: Basilica Minor act; states 'Quod quidem simulacrum die 27 elapsi mensis iunii, hoc anno, aureo diademate Ordo Canonicorum sacrosanctae Nostrae Basilicae Vaticanae pro instituto suo sollemniter decoravit' - crowned by the Vatican Chapter on 27 June 1920. Act begins on printed page 435 (passage printed_page is 436). The image was set up for public veneration by the priest Antonio Del Duca.

rubric_latin: CATHEDRALIS AEDES LEONENSIS DEIPARAE « MATRI LUMINUM » SACRA, IN REPUBLICA MEXICANA, TITULO AC PRIVILEGIIS BASILICAE MINORIS AUGETUR.
incipit_latin: Tot inter celeberrima templa, quae in honorem Deiparae Virginis exstructa sunt ubique terrarum, iure adnumeramus praeclaram
image_title_latin: Deipara a Matre luminum
image_title_vernacular: Nuestra Senora de la Luz (Madre Santisima de la Luz)
church_or_sanctuary: Cathedral church of Leon
notes: Basilica Minor act; states that Leo XIII 'per similes Litteras die 20 martii anni 1901 Piscatoris annulo obsignatas, aurea corona eius imaginem praecingendam curavit' - i.e. the papal grant of coronation is dated 20 March 1901; the date of the crowning rite itself is not given, so coronation_date left null. Rubric OCR 'LBONENSIS'/'AUGETÜR' repaired. Act begins on printed page 437 (passage printed_page is 436).

rubric_latin: AD THOMAM PIUM S. R. E. PRESB. CARD. BOGGIANI, ARCHIEPISCOPUM IANUENSEM, QUI DELEGATUR A B. P. UT EIUS NOMINE SIMULACRUM DEIPARAE A VINEIS AUREA CORONA REDIMIAT ET BENEDICTIONEM IMPERTIAT CUM INDULGENTIA PLENARIA.
incipit_latin: Quae civitatis istius, pastorali studio tuo commissae, propius intersint, ea planum est sic ad Nos pertinere
image_title_latin: Deipara a Vineis
church_or_sanctuary: Templum curiale Deiparae a Vineis (Santa Maria delle Vigne)
legate: Thomas Pius S. R. E. Card. Boggiani, Archbishop of Genoa
notes: Benedict XV delegates Card. Boggiani to crown the marble image in his name ('hoc tibi munus delegamus, ut, nomine Nostro, et effigiem Deiparae a Vineis aurea, quam memoravimus, corona redimias'). Coronation date derived from 'ea in diem primum ac vicesimum vertentis mensis, qui dies Deiparae a Vineis sacer est ... indixistis' in a letter dated 1 November 1920, hence 21 November 1920 - verify. This is the fourth centennial crowning: Abp Orazio Spinola first crowned the image in 1616 ('anno MDCXVI ... diademate primum ornasse'), with the rite to be repeated every hundred years; the 1916 centenary was deferred because of the war. Benedict XV, baptized in this parish church, donated the golden crown.

rubric_latin: TEMPLUM PAROCHIALE SANCTI IOANNIS DE DEO, IN CIVITATE MACARAIBO, DIOECESIS ZULIENSIS, TITULO AC PRIVILEGIIS BASILICAE MINORIS AUGETUR.
incipit_latin: Exstat in civitate episcopali Macaraibo, dioecesis Zuliensis, intra fines Reipublicae de Venezuela, Americae meridionalis, ecclesia parochialis
image_title_latin: Beata Maria Virgo de la Chiquinquira
church_or_sanctuary: Parish church of St John of God (San Juan de Dios)
notes: Basilica Minor act (dated 18 May 1920, published in AAS 13 [1921] 5) stating that the miraculous image 'beatae Mariae Virginis de la Chiquinquira nuncupata' is 'aureo per Nos diademate redimita' - crowned by (the authority of) Benedict XV himself. Neither the date nor the minister of the coronation is given. OCR gives 'Macaraibo' for Maracaibo.

rubric_latin: TEMPLUM CARMELITARUM, BEATAE MARIAE VIRGINI DE MONTE CARMELO SACRUM, IN URBE RECIFENSI, E STATU PERNAMBUCI, IN BRASILIA, TITULO AC PRIVILEGIIS BASILICAE MINORIS DECORATUR.
incipit_latin: Quod inclitus Carmelitarum antiquae observantiae Ordo templum habet suae custodiae curaeque commissum in urbe Recifensi, e Statu Pernambuci
image_title_latin: simulacrum, cedrino ligno sculptum, Beatae Mariae Virginis de Monte Carmelo
church_or_sanctuary: Templum Carmelitarum B. Mariae Virgini de Monte Carmelo sacrum
notes: Basilica minor act stating: « cum eiusdem simulacro Ordo Canonicorum Patriarchalis Basilicae Vaticanae Nostrae, pro instituto suo, aureum diadema decrevisset, sacer ritus, die 21 mensis septembris anni 1919 ... sollemniter peractus est ». Coronation decreed by the Vatican Chapter; the same image had been declared Patroness of Recife in 1908.

rubric_latin: ECCLESIA NATIVITATIS BEATAE MARIAE VIRGINIS IN CIVITATE SENGLEA, INSULAE MELITENSIS, IN BASILICAM MINOREM ERIGITUR.
incipit_latin: Ad perennandam memoriam gloriosae victoriae contra exercitum Turcarum, anno MDLXV latae, et in gratiarum actionem ob civitatem ab extremo discrimine servatam
image_title_latin: sacrum simulacrum Mariae Infantis
church_or_sanctuary: Ecclesia collegiata Nativitatis B. Mariae Virginis, « a Victoria » dicta
notes: The Basilica minor petition was made « auspicata occasione coronationis sacri simulacri Mariae Infantis, ut aiunt, «Maria Bambina», quod religiosissime ipso in templo colitur », i.e. on the occasion of the (then forthcoming) coronation. The act itself neither grants the coronation nor gives its date, so evidence is a passing attestation only; no date stated in the passage. The volume index (p. 190 entry, seen at AAS-13-1921 pp. 625-626) records 'B. M. V. Infantis (« Maria Bambina ») simulacrum coronatum, 190' and lists it among 'imagines B. M. V. Capituli auctoritate diademate donatae, 8, 190, 492, 305 s.' — suggesting the Vatican Chapter authorised it; a checker should verify.

rubric_latin: SANCTUARIUM BEATAE MARIAE VIRGINIS DE MISERICORDIA IN DIOECESI MACERATENSI TITULO AC PRIVILEGIIS BASILICAE MINORIS HONESTATUR.
incipit_latin: Anno Domini 1447, mortifera grassante pestilentia, Maceratensis urbis cives Virginem Mariam, sub titulo Misericordiae, civitatis Patronam vocarunt
image_title_latin: Beata Maria Virgo de Misericordia
church_or_sanctuary: Sanctuarium Beatae Mariae Virginis de Misericordia
notes: Basilica Minor act granted on the approaching bicentenary of the coronation: 'eidemque die 24 mensis augusti anno 1721, ex decreto Capituli Patriarchalis Vaticanae Basilicae, aureum diadema donatum impositumque fuit'. A silver crown had been offered by the townsmen in 1496 (not a papal coronation). Rubric OCR 'MACERATECI' repaired to 'MACERATENSI'. The act begins on printed page 305 (passage printed_page is 306).

rubric_latin: TITULUS BASILICAE MINORIS CONFERTUR ECCLESIAE SEU SANCTUARIO ANNUNCIATIONIS B. M. V., OPPIDI « FOLLINA », DIOECESIS CENETENSIS.
incipit_latin: Ampla ac pervetusta Cisterciensium Fratrum abbatia, decimo secundo labente saeculo fundata, exstat intra fines dioecesis Cenetensis, in civitate vulgo Follina
image_title_latin: Beata Maria Virgo cum Puero Iesu (Annuntiatio B. M. V.)
image_title_vernacular: Madonna di Follina (Santa Maria Assunta / Annunciazione)
church_or_sanctuary: Ecclesia seu sanctuarium Annuntiationis B. M. V., abbey of Follina (Servites)
notes: Basilica Minor act granted on the occasion of a FUTURE coronation: 'auspicatam occasionem nactus coronationis dictae prodigiosae imaginis quae ex decreto Basilicae Vaticanae Capituli proximo septembri mense aureo diademate sollemni pompa augebitur' - to be crowned by decree of the Vatican Chapter in September 1921 (day not given; letter dated 10 August 1921). Image is a marble carving of the Virgin with the Child Jesus. Act begins on printed page 470 (passage printed_page is 471).

rubric_latin: TITULUS BASILICAE MINORIS CATHEDRALI TEMPLO MONOPOLITANO CONFERTUR
incipit_latin: Inter potiores sacras Apuliae aedes Monopolitanum cathedrale templum iure meritoque accensendum est, ineunte saeculo xii a sancto Romualdo Episcopo
image_title_latin: Virgo a Madia
church_or_sanctuary: Cathedral of Monopoli
notes: Basilica Minor act stating 'ipsaque Virginis imago anno MDCCLXIX aureo diademate est coronata' (1769); no crowning authority named. The image is painted on wood ('Virginis imago in ligno depicta'). The act also mentions that a Cardinal Legate of Benedict XV attended the 1921 eighth-centenary festivities - not a coronation legation.

rubric_latin: ECCLESIA NOSTRAE DOMINAE A MIRACULIS IN CIVITATE MAURIAC, DIOECESIS SANCTI FLORI, EXSTANS, AD TITULUM ET DIGNITATEM BASILICAE MINORIS EVEHITUR.
incipit_latin: Constat apprime ecclesiam a Nostra Domina a miraculis, sitam in urbe Mauriac appellata, quae est ex praecipuis civitatibus dioecesis Sancti Fiori in Gallia
image_title_latin: Beata Maria Virgo a miraculis
church_or_sanctuary: Ecclesia Nostrae Dominae a miraculis (Notre-Dame-des-Miracles)
notes: Basilica Minor act stating 'Vetus beatae Mariae Virginis a miraculis simulacrum ... anno MDCCCLV a Pio Pp. IX, rec. mem. Decessore Nostro, aureo diademate redimitum'. Act begins on printed page 493 (passage printed_page is 492). Rubric OCR 'SANCTI PLORI' repaired to 'SANCTI FLORI'.

rubric_latin: SANCTUARIUM B. M. V. DE ARANZAZU, DIOECESIS VICTORIENSIS, TITULO AC DIGNITATE BASILICAE MINORIS COHONESTATUR.
incipit_latin: In Cantabris montibus, dioecesis Victoriensis intra fines, haud procul ab « Onate », quod est provinciae Guipuzcoae oppidum
image_title_latin: Beata Maria Virgo de Aranzazu
church_or_sanctuary: Sanctuarium Beatae Mariae Virginis de Aranzazu (Franciscan friars)
notes: Basilica Minor act stating 'eandemque anno MDCCCLXXXVI, clero populoque plaudente, a Victoriensi Episcopo aureo diademate redimitam' - crowned in 1886 by the Bishop of Vitoria; papal authority for that crowning is NOT stated in the passage, hence confidence medium. The same act recalls that Benedict XV himself declared the Virgin of Aranzazu principal patroness of the civil province of Guipuzcoa in 1918. Old stone image of the Virgin with the Infant Jesus. OCR gives 'Ofiate'/'Onate' for Onate (Onati).

rubric_latin: AD R. P. D. IOANNEM GAMBERONI, ARCHIEPISCOPUM VERCELLENSIUM: DE SACRO SOLEMNI RITU QUO DIADEMATE ORNABATUR THAUMATURGA B. M. V. IMAGO IN METROPOLITANA AEDE.
incipit_latin: Maximus ille venerationis cultus erga sanctissimam Dei Parentem, qui a prima aetate amoris flammam in Nobis accendit semperque aluit
image_title_latin: Thaumaturga Beatae Mariae Virginis Imago
church_or_sanctuary: Metropolitana aedes Vercellensis (cathedral of Vercelli)
notes: The passage itself is the volume index (printed p. 706); the act is Benedict XV's Epistola I at printed p. 38 of AAS 14 (1922), consulted in txt/AAS-14-1922-ocr.txt and used for rubric, incipit and date. The letter congratulates on the forthcoming solemn rite in which the image will be crowned ('proximis diebus ... thaumaturga Imago diademate ornabitur ... quae sub nomine Madonna degli infermi tribus abhinc saeculis mirifica pietate colitur'); it is not itself the grant of coronation. Coronation year 1921 inferred from 'proximis diebus' plus the letter's date. Volume-text rubric OCR reads 'ORNARATUR'.

rubric_latin: SANCTUARIUM B. M. V. IN OPPIDO ASPRICOLLIS, ARCHIDIOECESIS MECHLINIENSIS, TITULO ET PRIVILEGIIS BASILICAE MINORIS AUGETUR.
incipit_latin: Penes oppidulum Aspricollis vulgo Scherpenheuvel, haud longe a civitate Lovaniensi, archidioecesis Mechliniensis intra fines, priscis a temporibus
image_title_latin: Beata Maria Virgo Aspricollis
church_or_sanctuary: Templum Aspricollense (sanctuary of Our Lady of Scherpenheuvel/Montaigu)
notes: Basilica Minor act granted on the fiftieth anniversary of the coronation; states 'ab Archiepiscopo Mechliniensi postea Cardinali Dechamps, nomine et auctoritate Praedecessoris Nostri rec. mem. Pii PP. IX, anno MDCCCLXXII solemni ritu aureo diademate redimitum effulsit' - crowned in 1872 by Abp (later Cardinal) Dechamps in the name and by the authority of Pius IX; day and month not given. Rubric OCR 'MECHLINIEN-SI^' repaired.

rubric_latin: TEMPLUM B. M. V. MATRIS GRATIARUM, UTINI, TITULO AC DIGNITATE BASILICAE MINORIS CONDECORATUR.
incipit_latin: Minime Nos latet templum Gratiarum Utinensis civitatis anno MXXXX conditum et decimo quinto vertente saeculo restitutum
image_title_latin: Beata Maria Virgo Mater Gratiarum
church_or_sanctuary: Templum sive sanctuarium Beatae Mariae Virginis Matris Gratiarum
notes: Basilica minor elevation; states the image was 'aureo diademate anno MDCCCLXX auctoritate Apostolica redimitam'. OCR of rubric read 'CONDE COR ATUR'; foundation year printed 'anno MXXXX' (likely OCR corruption). No vernacular title given in the act.

rubric_latin: AEDES CURIALIS B. M. V. DE FUNICULO, IN CIVITATE VALENCIENNES, AD TITULUM AC DIGNITATEM BASILICAE MINORIS EVEHITUR.
incipit_latin: Templa Dei vetustis inclyta memoriis et fidelium religione celebria de more Romanorum Pontificum Decessorum Nostrorum, singularibus titulis privilegiisque decorare, pro re ac tempore, satagimus.
image_title_latin: Beata Maria Virgo de Funiculo
church_or_sanctuary: Ecclesia paroecialis (curialis) B. M. V. de Funiculo
notes: Act begins on printed p. 492 (passage page 491). States that Leo XIII by Apostolic Letters sealed 16 March 1896 decreed the statue be solemnly crowned in his own name and authority ('statuam memoratam Virginis a Funiculo, ipsius Romani Pontificis nomine et auctoritate, sollemni ritu coronandum decrevit'); the date of the crowning itself is not given, so coronation_date left null. OCR gives the vernacular title as 'du Saint Gordon' (= du Saint Cordon).

rubric_latin: TEMPLUM B. M. V. DE MERCEDE, IN URBE SANCTI IACOBI DE CILE, AD TITULUM ET DIGNITATEM BASILICAE MINORIS EVEHITUR.
incipit_latin: Inter sacras aedes quibus Cilena regio nobilitatur, templum Beatae Mariae Virgini de Mercede dicatum in urbe Sancti Iacobi
image_title_latin: lignea imago Beatae Mariae Virginis de Mercede
church_or_sanctuary: Templum Beatae Mariae Virgini de Mercede dicatum (Ordinis Redemptionis Captivorum)
notes: Basilica minor act attesting: « devotissima asservatur lignea imago Beatae Mariae Virginis de Mercede aureo gemmatoque diademate Sanctae huius Sedis auctoritate redimita ». No coronation date given in the act.

rubric_latin: AD EM.UM P. D. PETRUM, TIT. SANCTI LAURENTII IN LUCINA, S. R. E. PRESB. CARDINALEM GASPARRI, A NEGOTIIS PUBLICIS ADMINISTRUM, QUEM LEGATUM MITTIT AD TRANSVEHENDAM LAURETUM BEATAE MARIAE VIRGINIS NOVAM ICONEM, A SE BENEDICTAM AUREOQUE DIADEMATE REDIMITAM.
incipit_latin: Norunt omnes quo maerore affectus sit orbis catholicus, cum, haud ita pridem, Lauretana aede ardescente, imago illa augustissima Beatae Mariae Virginis penitus deleta est
image_title_latin: Beata Maria Virgo Lauretana (nova icon)
church_or_sanctuary: Alma Domus Lauretana (basilica Lauretana)
legate: Petrus Card. Gasparri
notes: The new statue made after the 1921 fire: 'cum Ipsi simulacrum novum Mariae et Iesu diademate aureo ditaverimus, tum idem sollemni ritu benedictum coronavimus' - Pius XI crowned it himself in Rome before 17 Aug 1922. Card. Gasparri is deputed as Legate only to convey the image to Loreto, not to crown it. Country inferred from Loreto/Lauretum (unambiguous); diocese not named in the act.

rubric_latin: AD VENERABILES FRATRES PATRIARCHAS, PRIMATES, ARCHIEPISCOPOS, EPISCOPOS, ALIOSQUE LOCORUM ORDINARIOS PACEM ET COMMUNIONEM CUM APOSTOLICA SEDE HABENTES: DE PACE CHRISTI IN REGNO CHRISTI QUAERENDA.
incipit_latin: Ubi arcano Dei consilio ac nutu Nos, qui nullis sane meritis commendaremur, ad hanc et veritatis cathedram et caritatis evecti sumus
image_title_latin: Beata Maria Virgo Lauretana (venerabile simulacrum)
church_or_sanctuary: Sacra aedes Lauretana
notes: Encyclical 'Ubi arcano Dei consilio', which begins on printed p. 673; the coronation reference is on p. 675 (the passage page): 'venerabile ipsius simulacrum, apud Nos affabre refectum, Nostrisque manibus et consecratum et corona redimitum, restituendum curavimus'. Rubric and incipit taken from p. 673 of the same volume text. Same image as AAS 14 (1922) 544. Country inferred (Loreto).

rubric_latin: AD R. P. D. ALPHONSUM ANDREOLI, EPISCOPUM RECINETENSEM ET LAURETANUM, QUINQUAGESIMO PLENO ANNO AB INITO SACERDOTIO.
incipit_latin: Cum allatum ad Nos sit, quinquagesimum sacerdotii natalem a te propediem actum iri, placet in partem venire, ut aequum est, gaudii laetitiaeque tuae
image_title_latin: Nova Virginis Effigies (Lauretana)
church_or_sanctuary: Alma Lauretana Domus
notes: Act VIII begins on printed p. 215 (the passage page marker is 216). Attests in passing: 'populi pietas in novam Virginis Effigiem, quam Nosmet ipsi lustravimus et corona redimivimus'. Coronation year 1922 taken from the parallel acts AAS 14 (1922) 544 and 675, not stated here; country inferred (Loreto).

rubric_latin: SANCTUARIUM A MATRE DOMINI, INTRA FINES ARCHIDIOECESIS SALERNITANAE, TITULO BASILICAE MINORIS AUGETUR.
incipit_latin: Iam inde a saeculo post Christum natum XII, intra fines archidioecesis Salernitanae, vetus exstat sanctuarium titulo a Matre Domini
image_title_latin: antiqua imago Virginis Deiparae foventis ulnis Infantem Iesum, a Matre Domini
church_or_sanctuary: Sanctuarium a Matre Domini (Ordinis Fratrum Minorum)
notes: Coronation clause: « Miraculis quidem inclyta Virginis imago, Apostolica auctoritate et sollemni ritu, anno MDCCLIX, diademate aureo redimita fuit ». Locality not named in the act, only 'intra fines archidioecesis Salernitanae'; supporting petitions come from the bishops of Salerno, Nocera, Cava and Sarno and from 'municipii Iuceriae Superioris' (OCR; most likely 'Nuceriae Superioris' = Nocera Superiore), which would place the shrine at Materdomini in Nocera Superiore — NOT asserted here, needs a checker. Act date OCR reads 'die xr mensis iunii, anno MDCCCCXXIII'; read as XI = 11 June 1923, verify.

rubric_latin: TITULUS BASILICAE MINORIS CONFERTUR PAROECIALI ECCLESIAE BEATAE MARIAE VIRGINIS CONSOLATRICIS AFFLICTORUM, OPPIDI KEVELAER, DIOECESIS MONASTERIENSIS.
incipit_latin: In civitate Kevelaer appellata, prope Regni Hollandici fines, intra limites Monasteriensis dioecesis posita, Mariale sanctuarium praeclarissimum exstat
image_title_latin: Beata Maria Virgo Consolatrix afflictorum
church_or_sanctuary: Mariale sanctuarium / ecclesia paroecialis B. M. V. Consolatricis afflictorum
legate: Cardinalis Archiepiscopus Coloniensis (not named in the act)
notes: 'Iconem autem Virginis Decessor Noster rec. mem. Leo PP. XIII per Cardinalem Archiepiscopum Coloniensem anno MDCCCXC aureo diademate sollemni pompa ornatam voluit.' The crowning Cardinal Archbishop of Cologne is not named. Rubric OCR reads 'CONSOLATRICE?' for 'CONSOLATRICIS'. Country inferred from diocese of Münster/Kevelaer (act says it lies near the Dutch border, within the diocese of Münster).

rubric_latin: TITULO ET PRIVILEGIIS BASILICAE MINORIS CONDECORATUR ECCLESIA PAROECIALIS B. M. V. GRATIARUM, CIVITATIS « ESTE », IN DIOECESI PATAVINA.
incipit_latin: Surgit in civitate Este, dioecesis Patavinae intra limites, ecclesia Deo dicata in honorem Beatae Mariae Virginis sub Gratiarum invocatione
image_title_latin: Beata Maria Virgo Gratiarum
church_or_sanctuary: Ecclesia B. M. V. Gratiarum
notes: 'Ipsa sacra imago ex decreto Vaticanae Basilicae Capituli diei XV mensis decembris anni MDCCCXXII, pretioso diademate redimita refulget.' The date given (15 December 1822) is that of the Vatican Chapter decree, not necessarily of the crowning, so coronation_date left null. Image said to have been brought from Constantinople in 1408.

rubric_latin: TITULO AC PRIVILEGIIS BASILICAE MINORIS HONESTATUS SANCTUARIUM MARIALE B. M. V. CONSOLATRICE AFFLICTORUM DE VERDELAIS, IN ARCHIDIOECESI BURDIGALENSI.
incipit_latin: Exstat in civitate Verdelais, intra fines archidioecesis Burdigalensis, iam inde a saeculo XII erectum, templum sive sanctuarium Mariale
image_title_latin: statua Beatae Mariae Virginis, Consolatricis afflictorum
church_or_sanctuary: Templum sive sanctuarium Mariale de Verdelais (Societatis Mariae)
legate: Cardinalis Donnet, tunc archiepiscopus Burdigalensis
notes: Clause: « quae, de speciali mandato fel. rec. Nostri Praedecessoris Pii PP. IX, iuxta Litteras Apostolicas, Piscatoris annulo die IV mensis maii anno MDCCCLV obsignatas, aureo diademate redimita fuit a bo. me. Cardinali Donnet, tunc archiepiscopo Burdigalensi, die II mensis iulii sequentis anni MDCCCLVI ». Papal mandate 4 May 1855; crowning 2 July 1856. 'legate' field records the prelate who crowned it by Pius IX's mandate (recorded retrospectively, not deputed by this act).

rubric_latin: AD EM.UM P. D. ANDREAM TIT. SS. COSMAE ET DAMIANI S. R. E. PRESB. CARD. FRUEHWIRTH, QUEM LINCIAM LEGATUM SUUM MITTIT OCCASIONE DEDICATIONIS NOVI TEMPLI CATHEDRALIS.
incipit_latin: Linciae, in urbe episcopali illius in Austria dioecesis quae, ob singularem Deiparae amorem cultumque, Marialis merito nuncupatur
image_title_latin: Signum Virginis Immaculatae
church_or_sanctuary: Sacellum novi templi cathedralis Linciensis (chapel of the new cathedral of Linz)
legate: Andreas Card. Fruehwirth
notes: Act III begins on printed p. 228 (verified in txt/AAS-16-1924-ocr.txt); the coronation reference falls on p. 229, the passage page, which is used here. The OCR of this page interleaves two columns: 'cuius signum, venerationi Linciensium in sacello novi templi propositum, ... Leo XIII aurea corona, a se pie liberaliterque muneri data, anno MDCCCCII redimiri iusserat'. The legation itself is for the cathedral dedication, not for a coronation.

rubric_latin: AD R. P. D. ALCIMUM GOURAUD, EPISCOPUM VENETENSEM: TERTIO PLENO SAECULO AB APPARITIONE SANCTAE ANNAE, PROPE AURAY.
incipit_latin: Tertium affers completum iri proximo mense saeculum, ex quo, haud procul ab urbe vulgo Auray nuncupata, quae intra dioecesis istius tuae fines sita est, Sancta Anna
image_title_latin: Statua Sanctae Annae
image_subject: other (St Anne, mother of the Blessed Virgin Mary)
church_or_sanctuary: Sanctuarium Beatae Annae, vulgo d'Auray
notes: 'praeterquam quod Pius IX et statuam corona aurea redimiri suo nomine iussit'. No year of the crowning is given. Rubric taken from p. 284 of the volume text (OCR 'ALCTMTJM GOURAUD ... AURAT'); the addressee is the Bishop of Vannes (Venetensis).

rubric_latin: TITULUS BASILICAE MINORIS CONFERTUR ECCLESIAE CONLEGIATAE B. M. V. A SALUTE, IN CIVITATE PAZCUARO, ARCHIDIOECESIS MECHOACANENSIS.
incipit_latin: Ecclesia conlegiata Deo dicata in honorem Beatae Mariae Virginis sub titulo Salutis, in civitate Pazcuaro, archidioecesis Mechoacanensis intra fines sita
image_title_latin: Beata Maria Virgo a Salute
church_or_sanctuary: Ecclesia conlegiata B. M. V. a Salute (vulgo de la Salud)
notes: 'atque anno MDCCCLXXXXIX, auctoritate Leonis PP. XIII rec. me. Praedecessoris Nostri, aureo diademate, sollemni ritu, coronata fuit'. Sixteenth-century sculpture made under Bishop Vasco de Quiroga; the act itself gives the vernacular form 'de la Salud'.

rubric_latin: ECCLESIA BEATAE MARIAE VIRGINIS DE MERCEDE, IN CIVITATE LIMANA, TITULO AC PRIVILEGIIS BASILICAE MINORIS AUGETUR.
incipit_latin: Limana in civitate quoddam, Beatae Mariae Virgini sub titulo de Mercede dicatum, templum exstat, quod, uti traditur, anno MDXXXIV
image_title_latin: prodigiosa Beatae Mariae Virginis de Mercede imago
church_or_sanctuary: Ecclesia Beatae Mariae Virginis de Mercede (Ordinis Redemptionis Captivorum)
notes: Clause: « prodigiosa Beatae Mariae Virginis de Mercede colitur imago, quae die XXIV mensis septembris anno MDCCXXI pretioso diademate, sollemni ritu, redimita est ». Same act notes she is Patrona ac Regina of the Peruvian nation. The act does not state under whose authority the 1721 crowning took place.

rubric_latin: AD EM.UM P. D. EUGENIUM, TIT. SS. SILVESTRI ET MARTINI, S. R. E. PRESB. CARD. TOSI ARCHIEPISCOPUM MEDIOLANENSEM, QUEM DELIGIT LEGATUM SUUM AD CORONAS IMPONENDAS INFANTI IESU ET BEATAE VIRGINI DE FONTANELLATO, IN DIOECESI PARMENSI.
incipit_latin: Quod Sanctuarii de Fontanellato laus ac fama non modo in dioecesis Parmensis totiusque Aemiliae finibus percrebrescit, sed etiam apud exteras gentes
image_title_latin: Beata Virgo de Fontanellato cum Infante Iesu
church_or_sanctuary: Sanctuarium de Fontanellato (basilica since c. 1903)
legate: Eugenius Card. Tosi, Archiepiscopus Mediolanensis
notes: Single statue group: crowns for both the Virgin and the Infant Jesus she carries ('coronas ... Virgini de Fontanellato et Infanti Iesu, quem Ipsa in ulnis sustinet, veluti manibus Nostris imponas'), the Pope himself blessing the crowns beforehand. Solemnities set for May 1925 ('sacris sollemnibus mense maio Parmae habendis'), hence coronation_date 1925. The act also records earlier crownings in 1660 and 1771 ('quam annis MDCLX et MDCCLXXI factum est'). Vernacular title supplied from the place name; the act gives only 'Virgo de Fontanellato'.

rubric_latin: AD EM.UM P. D. CAIETANUM PROTODIACONUM S. AGATHAE S. R. E. CARDINALEM BISLETI: QUEM LEGATUM MITTIT CALARIM AD MARIALIA SOLLEMNIA.
incipit_latin: Insignis admodum ac perantiqua est Marialis aedes quae, in Calaritana urbe sita, a Bono Aere nuncupatur
image_title_latin: Beata Maria Virgo de Bono Aere
church_or_sanctuary: Sanctuarium B. M. V. de Bonaria (Ordo B. M. V. de Mercede)
legate: Caietanus Card. Bisleti
notes: Re-coronation after the sacrilegious theft of the crowns of the Virgin and the Child three years earlier (c. 1923): 'te ... his Litteris eligimus qui coronam auream simulacro Virginis de Bono Aere nomine et auctoritate Nostra imponas'. The act also attests the earlier crowning by the Vatican Chapter ('a Vaticano Capitulo corona aurea redimita sit', dated 1870 by AAS 18 [1926] 376). Coronation year 1926 inferred: the solemnities were being prepared at the date of the letter (25 March 1926) and the new church was inaugurated 22 April 1926 per AAS 18 (1926) 376.

rubric_latin: SANCTUARIUM B. M. V. DE BONARIA CALARITANAE CIVITATIS IN BASILICAM MINOREM EVEHITUR.
incipit_latin: Calaritana in civitate ac dioecesi sanctuarium Beatae Mariae Virginis de Bonaria nuncupatae exstat, curis religiosorum sodalium ex Ordine Beatae Mariae Virginis de Mercede concreditum
image_title_latin: Antiqua et prodigiosa Virginis effigies de Bonaria
church_or_sanctuary: Vetus sanctuarium marianum de Bonaria
notes: 'in quo antiqua et prodigiosa Virginis effigies, iam aureo diademate anno MDCCCLXX per decretum Capituli Vaticani redimita, colitur'. Same image as AAS 18 (1926) 302. The act also notes the inauguration of the new church on 22 April 1926 and the 1908 proclamation of the Virgin of Bonaria as principal patron of Sardinia by Pius X.

rubric_latin: TITULUS ET PRIVILEGIA BASILICAE MINORIS CONFERUNTUR METROPOLITANAE ECCLESIAE S. CYRIACI EP. M. ANCONAE, SACRIS RELIQUIIS ET PRODIGIIS PRAECLARAE.
incipit_latin: Metropolitanum Anconae templum in excelso civitatis colle situm, late mare prospiciens Hadriacum, saeculo octavo exeunte traditur fuisse erectum
image_title_latin: Regina Sanctorum omnium
church_or_sanctuary: Metropolitana ecclesia S. Cyriaci Ep. M. (cathedral of Ancona)
notes: The passage itself is the volume's Index rerum analyticus (printed p. 491), whose entry reads 'Pius PP. VII, 201; redimivit corona imaginem Reginae omnium Sanctorum, Anconae, 14'. Verified against the act in the same volume file: the Litterae Apostolicae raising the metropolitan church of Ancona to a minor basilica begin on printed p. 13 and state on p. 14 'Imaginem thaumaturgam titulo Reginae Sanctorum omnium excultam, a captivitate redux sa. me. Pius PP. VII Praedecessor Noster, maxima populi ac civitatis laetitia, aurea gemmataque corona sollemni pompa redimivit'. So the crowning was performed personally by Pius VII after his return from captivity (i.e. after 1814; no date given - coronation_date null); it is here reported retrospectively inside a basilica-minor act of Pius XI, hence retrospective_attestation rather than papal_personal_coronation. The image is a Marian image painted on linen on one of the principal altars. Datum line: 'die xiv mensis Iulii anno MDCCCCXXVI'. page set to 13 (act begins) though the coronation sentence and the index citation are on p. 14. Country 'Italy' inferred from Ancona / 'inter sacras Piceni aedes'; confidence dropped to medium for that reason only - the coronation fact itself is explicit.

rubric_latin: AD EM.UM P. D. HENRICUM TIT. S. PETRI IN MONTE AUREO S. R. E. PRESB. CARD. REIG Y CASANOVA, ARCHIEPISCOPUM TOLETANUM, DE CONGRESSU EUCHARISTICO EX TOTA HISPANIA.
incipit_latin: Sacras inter aedes, quas catholicae Hispaniae filii, media aetate, excitarunt, principem videtur obtinere locum, cum ob molis amplitudinem
image_title_latin: Virgo a Sacrario
church_or_sanctuary: Cathedrale templum Toletanum (primatial cathedral of Toledo)
notes: Act I begins on printed p. 52 (the passage page marker is 53). The Pope commends, but does not himself grant, the plan of the Archbishop of Toledo: 'itemque quam vos singulari cultu caelestem Patronam veneramini Virginem a Sacrario, eius effigiem aurea corona redimiendi. Utrumque autem, quod iam in eo es ut perficias, propositum ...'. Prospective, not retrospective, and not the coronation grant itself - classified as retrospective_attestation for want of a better category. No date is given for the crowning (letter dated 4 October 1926, coronation imminent).

rubric_latin: AD R. P. D. BENEDICTUM ALOISI MASELLA, ARCHIEPISCOPUM TIT. CAESARIENSEM, EUNDEMQUE APUD CHILENSEM REMPUBLICAM NUNTIUM APOSTOLICUM, QUEM LEGATUM MITTIT AD SOLEMNIA CORONATIONE B. M. V. DE MONTE CARMELO IN URBE SANCTI IACOBI.
incipit_latin: Deiparam Virginem de Monte Carmelo proxime in urbe ista Chilensis Reipublicae principe, aurea corona sollemniter redimitum iri
image_title_latin: Beata Maria Virgo de Monte Carmelo
legate: Benedictus Aloisi Masella, Archiepiscopus tit. Caesariensis, Nuntius Apostolicus in Chile
notes: 'te ... hisce litteris Legatum Nostrum deligimus ac renuntiamus, qui ... coronam auream pretiosisque gemmis ornatam simulacro Virginis de Monte Carmelo, Nostris veluti manibus, imponas'. The rubric as printed reads 'AD SOLEMNIA CORONATIONE' (for 'CORONATIONIS'). The crowning is said to be 'proxime' at the date of the letter (29 Nov 1926) but no date is given, so coronation_date is null. The church/sanctuary is not named; the act refers only to the capital of Chile. The Virgin of Carmel had earlier been acclaimed patron of the republic.

rubric_latin: TITULUS ET HONORES BASILICAE MINORIS CONCEDUNTUR ECCLESIAE S. FRANCISCI ASS. CIVITATIS MENDOZA, IN DIOECESI SANCTI IOANNIS DE CUJO.
incipit_latin: Sacra aedes intra limites dioecesis Sancti Ioannis de Cujo in civitate Mendoza in honorem divi Francisci Asisiensis, licet recens erecta
image_title_latin: Beatae Mariae Virginis titulo Montis Carmeli imago
church_or_sanctuary: Ecclesia S. Francisci Assisiensis (Ordinis Fratrum Minorum)
notes: Coronation attested in passing: 'rec. mem. Pius PP. X aureo eandem diademate augendam curavit'. No coronation year stated. Country explicit ('Reipublicae Argentinae').

rubric_latin: AD EM.UM P. D. IOSEPHUM ERNESTUM TIT. S. MARIAE DE ARACOELI S. R. E. PRESB. CARDINALEM VAN ROEY, ARCHIEPISCOPUM MECHLINIENSEM, QUEM LEGATUM SUUM MITTIT AD SOLEMNIA QUINQUIES SAECULARIA UNIVERSITATIS STUDIORUM LOVANIENSIS CELEBRANDA.
incipit_latin: Quinto feliciter exeunte saeculo ex quo Lovaniensis ista Studiorum Universitas condita est, iuste quidem Rector eius magnificus Paulinus Ladeuze
image_title_latin: Sedes Sapientiae
church_or_sanctuary: Universitas Studiorum Lovaniensis
legate: Iosephus Ernestus Card. Van Roey, Archiepiscopus Mechliniensis
notes: Act I begins on printed p. 307 (verified in txt/AAS-19-1927-ocr.txt); rubric and incipit taken from there; the coronation reference is on the passage page 308: 'auspice Virgine Matre, quam ab ipso iam initio veluti Sedem Sapientiae venerari consueverunt Lovanienses, cuiusque augusta effigies, Nostro quidem nomine, corona aurea mox redimietur'. The legation is primarily for the university's fifth-centenary solemnities; the crowning is to be done in the Pope's name ('Nostro nomine'), presumably by the same Legate, but the letter does not say so expressly. Coronation year 1927 inferred from 'mox' and the date of the act. Diocese given as that of the Legate's see (Louvain lay in the archdiocese of Mechelen); country inferred.

rubric_latin: BASILICAE MINORIS HONORIBUS CONDECORATUR SANCTUARIUM B. M. V. AB APPARITIONE, IN OPPIDO TIRANO, COMENSIS DIOECESIS.
incipit_latin: In Comensis dioecesis oppido, cui vulgo nomen Tirano, matutinis horis diei XXVIIII mensis Septembris anno MDIV Beato Mario Omodei, uti fertur, Deipara Virgo apparuit
image_title_latin: Beata Maria Virgo ab Apparitione
church_or_sanctuary: Sanctuarium ab apparitione Deiparae Virginis nuncupatum
notes: Act I begins on printed p. 337 (the passage page marker is 338). 'Haec quidem statua Virginis, ulnis gestantis puerum Iesum, aureo diademate ex Apostolicae Sedis concessione redimita est anno MDCLXXXX, die apparitionis anniversaria, scilicet XXVIIII mensis Septembris' = 29 September 1690. Rubric OCR reads 'B. M. V. Air APPARITIONS'; day numerals printed 'x x v m i'/'x x v n n' for XXVIIII (29). Vernacular title supplied from the place name.

rubric_latin: SANCTUARIUM B. M. V. IN CAELUM ASSUMPTAE, IN OPPIDO STARAVIEN, DIOECESIS PREMISLIEN. LAT., BASILICAE MINORIS PRIVILEGIIS AUGETUR.
incipit_latin: Exstat intra fines dioecesis Premisliensis Latinorum, in oppido Stammen vulgo nuncupato, celeberrimum sanctuarium Deo sacrum in honorem B. Mariae Virginis Deiparae sideribus receptae
image_title_latin: Imago Virginis (B. Mariae Virginis in caelum Assumptae)
church_or_sanctuary: Sanctuarium B. M. V. in caelum Assumptae (Societatis Iesu)
legate: Ludovicus Iacobini, Apostolicae Sedis Legatus
notes: Coronation attested: 'imago Virginis diademate aureo ab Apostolicae Sedis Legato Ludovico Iacobinio anno MDCCCLXXVII redimita'; the act is sought on the 50th anniversary 'ex quo supradicta Imago Virginis sollemni ritu corona praecincta fuit'. Place name OCR-mangled: rubric 'STARAVIEN', body 'in oppido Stammen vulgo nuncupato' and 'loci vulgo Star avien' = Starawieś. Country explicit ('in Polonia').

rubric_latin: SANCTUARIUM N. D. A ROSARIO, O. P., OPPIDI CHINQUINQUIRA, INTRA FINES DIOECESIS TUNQUENSIS, AD HONORES BASILICAE MINORIS EXTOLLITUR.
incipit_latin: Exstat in Columbia, in loco cui vulgo nomen de Chinquinquira, dioecesis Tunquensis intra fines, Nostrae Dominae a Rosario celeberrimum sanctuarium
image_title_latin: Beata Maria Virgo a Rosario de Chinquinquira
image_title_vernacular: Nuestra Señora del Rosario de Chiquinquirá
church_or_sanctuary: Sanctuarium Nostrae Dominae a Rosario (Ordo Praedicatorum)
notes: Act II begins on printed p. 18 (the passage page marker is 19). 'nuperque anno MDCCCCXIX per Capituli Vaticani decretum ipsa imago Virginis sollemni pompa aureo diademate redimita affulsit.' The act spells the place 'Chinquinquira' (modern Chiquinquirá) and calls the Virgin 'Virginis Columbiae Reginae'. Printed in AAS vol. 20 (1928); the act itself is dated 18 August 1927.

rubric_latin: ECCLESIA ORDINIS CARMELITARUM, ARENZANI IN ARCHIDIOECESI IANUENSI, PUERO IESU PRAGENSI SACRA, BASILICAE MINORIS HONORIBUS CONDECORATUR.
incipit_latin: Pragensem Pueri Iesu Imaginem christifideles omnes non modo quidem in Pragensi ecclesia a Carmelitis nuncupata, sed etiam multis aliis in locis, ubique terrarum, colunt et celebrant
image_title_latin: Sacra Infantis Pragensis effigies
church_or_sanctuary: Templum Puero Iesu Pragensi dicatum, Carmelitarum Excalceatorum
legate: Raphael S. R. E. Cardinalis Merry del Val, Archipresbyter Capituli Vaticani
notes: Coronation attested: 'quam anno MDCCCCXXIV die XXIV Februarii, aureo gemmatoque diademate per decretum Patriarchalis Sacrosanctae Basilicae Vaticanae Capituli, dilectus filius Noster Raphael ... Cardinalis Merry del Val ... sollemni ritu ... coronavit'. Crowning done by the Archpriest of the Vatican Chapter (not strictly a papal legate); classified as retrospective attestation within the basilica minor act. Passage printed_page 321; act opens on p. 320.

rubric_latin: BASILICAE MINORIS TITULO AUGETUR ECCLESIA B. M. V. AB ANGELO SALUTATAE, IN SUBURBIO LEZAJEK DIOECESIS PREMISLIENSIS LAT.
incipit_latin: Constat apprime templum ab Annuntiatione B. Mariae Virginis Deiparae, quod in suburbio Lezajelc dioecesis Premisliensis Latinorum situm
image_title_latin: imago Beatae Mariae Virginis Infantem Iesum ulnis ferentis
image_title_vernacular: Matka Boża Pocieszenia (Our Lady of Leżajsk)
church_or_sanctuary: Ecclesia/sanctuarium ab Annuntiatione B. Mariae Virginis (Order of Friars Minor)
notes: Basilica Minor act; states the miraculous image in the right-hand chapel, together with the Divine Child, was crowned 'aureo ac pretioso diademate celeberrima pompa' on 8 Sept 1752 by Bishop Venceslaus comes Sierakowski 'de Apostolica autoritate, ac de mandato Benedicti PP. XIV'. OCR gives the place as 'Lezajek'/'Lezajelc' (= Leżajsk). Country from the text's own 'universa Polonia'. Vernacular title supplied from the shrine's identity, not from the text. Act begins on printed p. 351 (passage flagged at p. 352, where the coronation clause falls).

rubric_latin: TITULUS ET HONORES BASILICAE MINORIS TRIBUUNTUR SANCTUARIO CAPRIMONTENSI BEATAE MARIAE GRATIARUM, ORDINIS CARMELITARUM EXCALCEATORUM, INTRA FINES DIOECESIS LEODIENSIS.
incipit_latin: Leodiensis dioecesis intra fines Carmelitarum Discalceatorum exstat, e religiosa provincia Brabantina, conventus Caprimontensis, cui annexum est templum
image_title_latin: Beata Maria Virgo Mater Gratiarum
church_or_sanctuary: Sanctuarium Caprimontense B. M. V. Matris Gratiarum (Discalced Carmelites)
notes: Basilica Minor act; small statue of the BVM holding the Infant Jesus, placed by the Jesuits on the hill of Chèvremont, 'quam, nomine ac mandato Nostro, anno MCMXXIII Leodiensium Episcopus pretioso diademate sollemniter redimivit'. Country inferred from diocese of Liège and the Archbishop of Mechelen named as commender. Act begins on printed p. 183; coronation clause falls on p. 184.

rubric_latin: ECCLESIA CATHEDRALIS SUESSANA, SUB TITULO SS. APOSTOLORUM PETRI ET PAULI, HONORIBUS BASILICAE MINORIS AUGETUR.
incipit_latin: Suessanae in Auruncis civitatis cathedrale templum, quod loco vetustissimae ecclesiae, quae inibi exsistebat, initiis saeculi post Christum natum decimisecundi erectum est
image_title_latin: Prodigiosa imago Beatae Mariae Virginis, populi Suessani Advocata
church_or_sanctuary: Ecclesia cathedralis Suessana SS. Apostolorum Petri et Pauli
notes: Coronation attested: 'Imagini vero ipsi Episcopus Suessanus vigore facultatum, quas eidem Patriarchalis Basilicae Vaticanae ... Capitulum concessit, anno MDCCCCIV mense Septembri auream coronam solemniter imposuit' - i.e. September 1904, by the Bishop of Sessa with faculties granted by the Vatican Chapter; day not given.

rubric_latin: B. M. V. IMMACULATA SUB TITULO « APPARECIDA » PRINCIPALIS PATRONA BRASILIAE CONSTITUITUR.
incipit_latin: Ab Archiepiscopo Sancti Sebastiani Fluminis Ianuarii ceterisque Archiepiscopis, Episcopis, Praelatis atque Apostolicis Praefectis Brasiliae rogati sumus
image_title_latin: Beata Maria sub titulo de Apparecida
church_or_sanctuary: templum ingenti mole conspicuum in quo antiqua effigies servatur (shrine of Apparecida)
notes: Patron-declaration act; states the simulacrum was crowned 'decreto Capituli sacrosanctae Patriarchalis Vaticanae Basilicae, anno quinquagesimo recurrente a definitione dogmatica de Immaculato Virginis Conceptu, aurea corona' — i.e. 1854+50 = 1904, corroborated by the act's own reference to the 25th year since that solemn coronation. Coronation year is computed, not printed. OCR of the vernacular title is corrupt ('Fossa Berihora de Gonceigao Apparecida'). No locality or diocese named in the act.

rubric_latin: TEMPLUM TERSACTENSE B. M. V. MATRIS GRATIARUM IN DIOECESI SEGNIENSI, TITULO HONORIBUSQUE AUGETUR BASILICAE MINORIS.
incipit_latin: Dioecesis Segniensis et Modrusiensis intra fines, in loco vulgo Trsat nuncupato, exstat sub titulo Beatae Mariae Virginis Matris Gratiarum Tersactense sanctuarium
image_title_latin: Beata Maria Virgo Mater Gratiarum Tersactensis
image_title_vernacular: Majka Božja Trsatska (Our Lady of Trsat)
church_or_sanctuary: Sanctuarium Tersactense B. M. V. Matris Gratiarum (Friars Minor)
notes: Basilica Minor act; the image sent by Urban V is said to have been crowned: 'Sanctae Romanae Ecclesiae Cardinalis Marcus Antonius Barbarigo aurea corona solemni ritu decoravit'. No date given and papal authority not stated explicitly, though the crowning cardinal implies the usual Vatican Chapter procedure. Modern country inferred (text says Croatia/Iugoslavia); vernacular title supplied, not in the text. Act begins on printed p. 44; coronation clause on p. 45.

rubric_latin: SANCTUARIUM B. M. V. DE BONO SUCCURSU PAROECIAE DE LABLACHÈRE, DIOECESIS VIVARIENSIS INTRA FINES, BASILICAE MINORIS TITULO HONORIBUSQUE AUGETUR.
incipit_latin: Dioecesis Vivariensis intra fines in paroecia de Lablachere conspicuum exstat sanctuarium sub titulo Beatae Mariae Virginis a Bono Succursu
image_title_latin: Beata Maria Virgo de Bono Succursu
church_or_sanctuary: Sanctuarium B. M. V. de Bono Succursu (Oblates of Mary Immaculate)
notes: Basilica Minor act granted on the fiftieth anniversary of the coronation: 'quodque prodigiis gratiisque clarum aureo diademate anno MDCCCLXXX Apostolica auctoritate coronatum est'. Country inferred from the diocese of Viviers and the French place name.

rubric_latin: CATHEDRALE TEMPLUM SENOGALLIENSE HONORIBUS BASILICAE MINORIS AUGETUR.
incipit_latin: Senogalliensi in civitate exstat templum cathedrale in honorem Sancti Petri Apostoli Deo dicatum, quod loco prioris cathedralis
image_title_latin: Beata Maria Virgo a Spe
church_or_sanctuary: Templum cathedrale S. Petri Apostoli
notes: Basilica Minor act; 'In eodem autem templo imago colitur, suo in magnificentissimo sacello, Beatae Mariae Virginis a Spe, quam iam sacrosanctae Basilicae Vaticanae Capitulum aureo diademate redimivit'. No coronation date given. Country inferred from Senigallia.

rubric_latin: TITULO PRIVILEGIISQUE MINORIS BASILICAE INSIGNITUR TEMPLUM CONLEGIALE B. M. V. IN CIVITATE FRIBURGENSI HELVETIORUM.
incipit_latin: A venerabili fratre Lausannensium, Genevensium et Friburgensium Episcopo edocemur Friburgi in Helvetia antiquum et celebre titulo Nostrae Dominae conlegiale templum exstare
image_title_latin: Beatae Mariae Virginis simulacrum (Nostrae Dominae)
church_or_sanctuary: Templum conlegiale Nostrae Dominae
notes: Basilica Minor act; 'in quo Beatae Mariae Virginis simulacrum, iam nomine atque auctoritate rec. mem. Decessoris Nostri Leonis Pp. XIII aureo diademate coronatum, servatur et colitur'. Coronation date not given (under Leo XIII, 1878-1903). Country explicit in the text ('in Helvetia').

rubric_latin: TITULO ET HONORIBUS BASILICAE MINORIS AUGETUR TEMPLUM B. M. V. SIDERIBUS RECEPTAE, QUOD EXSTAT TRAIECTI IN DIOECESI RUREMONDENSI.
incipit_latin: Ruremondensis dioecesis intra fines, Traiecti in civitate, templum exstat paroeciale Beatae Mariae Virginis in caelum Assumptae in honorem Deo dicatum
image_title_latin: Beata Maria Virgo sub titulo « Stellae Maris »
image_title_vernacular: Sterre der Zee (Star of the Sea)
church_or_sanctuary: Templum paroeciale B. M. V. in caelum Assumptae
notes: Basilica Minor act; 'statua servatur Beatae Mariae Virginis sub titulo « Stellae Maris », quae iam ab anno MDCCCCXII, auctoritate Apostolica, aurea corona sollemniter redimita est'. 'Traiectum' here = Maastricht (diocese of Roermond); locality and country inferred, not spelled out. OCR renders the diocese as 'Euremondensis'/'Buremondensium'. Act begins on printed p. 242; coronation clause on p. 243.

rubric_latin: R. P. D. FRANCISCUS M. SERRAND EPISCOPUS BRIOCENSIS DEPUTATUR AD AUREA CORONA DONANDUM SIMULACRUM B. M. V. « DE LA DÉLIVRANCE » OPPIDI QUENTIN.
incipit_latin: Uti ad Nos attulisti, in loco « Quentin » in tuae dioecesis intra fines sito, insigne exstat sanctuarium mariale sub titulo Beatae Mariae Virginis de la Délivrance
image_title_latin: Beata Maria Virgo de la Délivrance
church_or_sanctuary: Sanctuarium/templum paroeciale B. M. V. de la Délivrance
legate: Franciscus M. Serrand, Episcopus Briocensis
notes: The Pope commits to the Bishop of Saint-Brieuc that he himself crown the image 'die per te statuendo, post sollemnia Missarum, per te ipsum, servatis servandis, Nostro nomine et auctoritate, sollemni ritu aurea corona redimias' — date left to the bishop, so no coronation date. The immediately preceding act (I, pp. 222-223, same date) raises the same church to a minor basilica. Country inferred from the diocese of Saint-Brieuc.

rubric_latin: AD EMUM P. D. ALAFRIDUM ILDEFONSUM TIT. SS. SILVESTRI ET MARTINI IN MONTIBUS S. R. E. PRESBYTERUM CARDINALEM SCHUSTER, MEDIOLANENSIUM ARCHIEPISCOPUM: QUEM MITTIT LEGATUM AD SOLEMNIA DECIES SAECULARIA ABBATIAE EINSIDLENSIS.
incipit_latin: Non levi animi delectatione nuper intelleximus de sollemnibus decies saecularibus, quae Einsidlenses monachi in honorem Deiparae « eremitarum Dominae » appellatae summo studio apparare contendunt
image_title_latin: prodigiosum « eremitarum Dominae » simulacrum
image_title_vernacular: Unsere Liebe Frau von Einsiedeln (Our Lady of the Hermits)
church_or_sanctuary: Templum et coenobium Einsidlense (Benedictine abbey of Einsiedeln)
legate: Alafridus Ildefonsus S. R. E. Card. Schuster, Archiepiscopus Mediolanensis
notes: Letter deputing Cardinal Schuster as Legate: '... et prodigiosum « eremitarum Dominae » simulacrum, tanta populi veneratione excultum, nomine Nostro Nostraque auctoritate sollemni coronae impositione exornes.' No coronation date stated; the rites were to take place 'proxime' during the 1934 millenary celebrations of the abbey. Country and locality inferred from 'Einsidlensis' (Einsiedeln); the letter names no diocese. OCR 'mtelleximus' repaired to 'intelleximus'.

rubric_latin: BEATISSIMA VIRGO MARIA LAPURDENSIS, PATRONA PRAECIPUA CONSTITUITUR OPPIDI ET VICARIATUS A « STELLA » IN DIOECESI SAVONENSI.
incipit_latin: Edocemur admodum esse in votis clero populoque civitatis Stella nec non eodem nomine vicariatus foranei in finibus dioecesis Savonensis
image_title_latin: simulacrum Beatae Mariae Virginis Lapurdensis
church_or_sanctuary: Ecclesia matrix Sancti Martini Episcopi
notes: Patron-declaration act; 'idemque simulacrum anno millesimo nongentesimo nono aureo diademate redimitum esse' (1909). The act does NOT state by whose authority the crowning was done — a checker should verify it was a papal/Vatican Chapter coronation. Act date: the OCR reads 'anno MDCCCXXXIV' but the pontifical year ('decimo tertio') fixes 1934; die xvi mensis Iulii = 16 July 1934. Country inferred from the diocese of Savona.

rubric_latin: SANCTUARIUM B. M. V. VULGO « DE MONTE SION » NUNCUPATUM, IN DIOECESI NANCEIENSI ET TULLENSI, BASILICIS MINORIBUS ACCENSETUR.
incipit_latin: Seiuntensi in monte, vulgo Sion nuncupato, Dioecesis Tullensis intra fines, iam saeculo decimo fere exeunte, parva admodum exstabat Deiparae Virginis in honorem Deo dicata sacra aedes
image_title_latin: Beata Virgo Maria a Monte Sion (Nostra Domina de Monte Sion)
church_or_sanctuary: Sanctuarium B. M. V. de Monte Sion (Oblatorum B. M. V. Immaculatae)
legate: Cardinalis Archiepiscopus Bisuntinus (Summi Pontificis Legatus; name not stated)

IX decretam, atque anno MDCCCLXXIII a Cardinali Archiepiscopo Bisuntino Summi Pontificis Legato peractam' and 'hoc anno, sexagesimo ab eadem simulacri Deiparae sollemni pontificia coronatione'. The Legate is identified only by see (Besançon). Vernacular title is the standard French form of the Latin 'de Monte Sion'; locality given by the act as 'Seiuntensi in monte, vulgo Sion' in Lorraine. Passage printed_page 329; act opens on p. 328.

rubric_latin: EMUS P. D. ALEXIUS HENRICUS M. TIT. SANCTAE SUSANNAE S. R. E. PRESB. CARDINALIS LÉPICIER DEPUTATUR AD AUREA CORONA ORNANDUM SIMULACRUM B. MARIAE V. « TA PINU » NUNCUPATAE IN EIUSDEM BASILICA DIOECESIS GAUDISIENSIS.

image_title_latin: Imago Beatae Mariae Virginis in caelum Assumptae sub titulo « ta Pinu »
church_or_sanctuary: Basilica B. Mariae V. « ta Pinu »
legate: Alexius Henricus Maria S. R. E. Card. Lépicier, tit. Sanctae Susannae
notes: Cardinal Lépicier, already Legate to the Regional Council of Malta, is charged 'ut arbitrio eius eligendo die ... aureum diadema Nostro nomine et auctoritate imponat' — day left to the legate, so no coronation date. The painting is described as by Stephanus Amedeus de Perusia, 1619. The act itself recalls that the sanctuary was made a minor basilica by Litterae Apostolicae of 31 Aug. 1932. No town named (the shrine is at Għarb); country inferred from the diocese of Gozo and the reference to the neighbouring diocese of Malta.

rubric_latin: TEMPLUM DEI GENITRICI, ANGELORUM REGINAE, IN URBE CARTAGO, INTRA FINES ARCHIDIOECESIS S. IOSEPHI DE COSTARICA DICATUM, TITULO AC PRIVILEGIIS BASILICAE MINORIS DECORATUR.

church_or_sanctuary: Sanctuarium Marianum B. Mariae Virginis ab Angelis (templum Dei Genitrici, Angelorum Reginae, dicatum)

Capitulo Patriarchalis Vaticanae Basilicae S. Petri aureo diademate redimita est' - i.e. crowned by the Vatican Chapter, not by a papal legate. Incipit has OCR noise ('Constat ex pluribus JU... ~*.e prae-claris documentis'); noise silently dropped. Vernacular title (Nuestra Senora de los Angeles) is not in the text.

rubric_latin: AD EXCMUM P. D. PASCHALEM RIGHETTI, EPISCOPUM SAVONENSEM ET NAULENSEM, QUARTO EXEUNTE SAECULO A MANIFESTATIONE DOMINAE NOSTRAE A MISERICORDIA IN SACRARIO PROPE SAVONENSEM URBEM VENERATAE.

image_title_latin: Domina Nostra a Misericordia
church_or_sanctuary: Sanctuarium Dominae Nostrae a Misericordia (prope urbem Savonensem)

Quod quidem contigit, quum Pius VII ... die x Maii anno MDCCCXV ...' and later 'dies x Maii, quo Virginis simulacro aurea corona per augustas manus imposita est'. Passage printed_page is 267, but the act plainly begins on p. 266 (verified against the volume text); page 266 used. Rubric OCR 'NOSTRA®' repaired to 'NOSTRAE'.

rubric_latin: SAVONEN. BEATIFICATIONIS ET CANONIZATIONIS SERVAE DEI MARIAE IOSEPHAE ROSSELLO, E TERTIO ORDINE S. FRANCISCI, FUNDATRICIS FILIARUM DOMINAE NOSTRAE A MISERICORDIA.

image_title_latin: Beatissima Virgo, Misericordiae Mater (Domina Nostra a Misericordia)
church_or_sanctuary: Sanctuarium Dominae Nostrae a Misericordia, prope Savonam
notes: Decree on the heroic virtues of Maria Giuseppa Rossello; mentions in passing that Pius VII crowned the Savona image with his own hand after his return from France: 'venerandus Pontifex Eiusdem simulacrum aurea corona sua manu redimivit' (OCR 'redimi vit'). No date given here; the parallel Epistola of the same volume (p. 266) dates it 10 May 1815. Datum taken from p. 305 of the volume: 'Datum Romae, in festivitate S. Ioseph C, 19 Martii a. D. 1936'.

rubric_latin: TEMPLUM SSMI CORDIS IESU ET B. MARIAE V. DE MONTE CARMELO IN ARCHIDIOECESI ET CIVITATE S. IACOBI DE CHILE ERECTUM, BASILICAE MINORIS TITULO AC PRIVILEGIIS HONESTATUR.

image_title_latin: Imago Beatissimae Virginis de Monte Carmelo
church_or_sanctuary: Templum Sanctissimi Salvatoris, ad honorem Sacratissimi Cordis Iesu dicatum
notes: Coronation attested: 'ita ut Imaginem eandem pretioso etiam diademate, vota omnium exsolvens, Legatus Noster anno millesimo nongentesimo vicesimo sexto redimierit'. The papal Legate who crowned the image is not named.

rubric_latin: SAVONEN. BEATIFICATIONIS ET CANONIZATIONIS VENERABILIS SERVAE DEI MARIAE IOSEPHAE ROSSELLO E TERTIO ORDINE S. FRANCISCI, FUNDATRICIS INSTITUTI FILIARUM NOSTRAE DOMINAE A MISERICORDIA.
incipit_latin: S. Augustinus illud psalmi commentans: Deus meus misericordia mea, «O nomen, scribit, sub quo nemini desperandum est!»
image_title_latin: Beata Virgo a Misericordia
notes: 'Tuto' decree for the beatification of M. G. Rossello; passing attestation: 'ob tenerrimam religionem erga Beatam Virginem a Misericordia, cuius veneranda imago Savonae a Pio VII sa. me. non multis ante annis aureo diademate fuerat redimita'. 'Non multis ante annis' is relative to 1837. Passage printed_page 232, but the decree begins on p. 231 (verified in the volume text); p. 231 used. Datum: 'ex Arce Gandulphi, diei 26 maii a. D. 1938'.

rubric_latin: VENERABILIS DEI FAMULA MARIA IOSEPHA ROSSELLO E TERTIO ORDINE S. FRANCISCI, FUNDATRIX INSTITUTI FILIARUM NOSTRAE DOMINAE A MISERICORDIA, BEATA RENUNTIATUR.
incipit_latin: Misericordia Domini plena est terra sed multae quidem misericordiae omnibus invocantibus Eum, quoniam Ipse est gloria virtutis illorum
image_title_latin: Beata Maria a Misericordia (Nostra Domina de Misericordia)
notes: Beatification brief of M. G. Rossello. Passing attestation: 'sub tutissimo Beatae Mariae a Misericordia, cuius veneranda Imago Savonae a Pio Pp. VII rec. mem. Decessore Nostro haud multis ante annis aureo diademate fuerat redimita'. The act actually begins on printed p. 405 (rubric and incipit read there in the volume text); the coronation sentence is on p. 406, which is kept as aas_page. Datum read on p. 410: 'die vi m. Novembris, an. MCMXXXVIII'.

rubric_latin: TEMPLUM NOSTRAE DOMINAE A TABULIS INTER FINES CIVITATIS AC DIOECESIS MONTIS PESSULANI HONORIBUS BASILICAE MINORIS INSIGNITUR.

image_title_latin: Nostra Domina a Tabulis
church_or_sanctuary: Ecclesia Nostrae Dominae a Tabulis
notes: Basilica Minor grant. Attestation: 'Huiusmodi vero Beatae Virginis simulacrum, gratiis miraculisque clarum ... nomine Decessoris Nostri Leonis Pp. XIII aurea corona decoratum est' (OCR reads 'decora-tur, est'). Crowned in the name of Leo XIII, so between 1878 and 1903; no date given. The image is an 11th-cent. black wooden statue of the Virgin with the Infant Jesus. Passage printed_page 40, but the act begins on p. 39 (rubric visible in the context before the p. 40 running head). Country confirmed by the text's reference to the 'Gallicae Revolutionis' eversores; vernacular title (Notre-Dame des Tables) is not in the text.

rubric_latin: BASILICAE MINORIS HONORIBUS DECORATUR TEMPLUM-SANCTUARIUM BEATAE MARIAE VIRGINIS DE « COPACABANA », INTRA FINES DIOECESIS PACENSIS IN BOLIVIA.
