image_title_latin: Deiparae Virginis statua de « Copacabana »
church_or_sanctuary: Templum-sanctuarium B. M. V. de Copacabana (Ordinis Minorum)
notes: Coronation mentioned only in passing and without date or agent: 'Deiparae Virginis statua in eodem honorifice servatur, quam recentiori tempore sollemniter etiam aureo diademate redimitam, boliviani christifideles peculiari cultu venerantur'. Papal authority for the crowning is not explicitly stated, hence medium confidence.

rubric_latin: BEATA MARIA VIRGO SUB TITULO «DEL CORO», CORONA REDIMITA, CIVITATIS SANCTI SEBASTIANI IN DIOECESI HISPANIAE VICTORIENSI PATRONA DECLARATUR.
incipit_latin: Urbis Sancti Sebastiani intra fines Victoriensis dioecesis in ecclesia paroeciali matrici Sanctae Mariae iam ab annis multis religiosissime asservatur imago Beatae Virginis Mariae vulgo «Virgen del Coro» nuncupata
image_title_latin: Beata Maria Virgo a Choro (sub titulo «del Coro»)
church_or_sanctuary: Ecclesia paroecialis matrix Sanctae Mariae
notes: Combined patron-declaration and coronation grant: the Bishop of Vitoria is charged to crown the image in the Pope's name on a day of his own choosing - 'Venerabili Fratri Victoriensium Episcopo eas partes committimus, ut arbitrio suo eligendo die ... Imaginem Beatae Virginis a Choro praedictam per se ipsum vel per ecclesiasticum virum in dignitate constitutum, et ab eodem deputandum, iuxta ritum formulamque praescripta aureo diademate, servatis servandis, Nostro nomine et auctoritate, post Missarum sollemnia, redimiat'. No legate is named (the ordinary or his delegate). Incipit ('Urbis Sancti Sebastiani') confirmed by the volume index on p. 583.

rubric_latin: BEATA MARIA VIRGO SUB TITULO DE «OCOTLAN» TOTIUS ARCHIDIOECESIS ANGELORUM, MEXICANA IN DITIONE, PATRONA COELESTIS CONFIRMATUR.
incipit_latin: Mexicana in ditione archidioecesis Angelorum intra fines exstat Sanctuarium Beatae Mariae Virginis de «Ocotlan» nuncupatae, quam christifideles regionis impense devoteque colunt.
image_title_latin: Beata Maria Virgo Immaculata de Ocotlan
church_or_sanctuary: Sanctuarium B. Mariae Virginis de Ocotlan
notes: Patron confirmation. Attestation: 'iam rec. mem. Decessorem Nostrum Pium Pp. X aureo diademate decrevisse Sacram Imaginem Beatae Mariae Immaculatae in sanctuario de Ocotlan servatae coronari' - so the coronation was decreed by Pius X (1903-1914); no date given. The act was issued on the occasion of the 4th centenary of the finding of the image, to be commemorated in 1941.

rubric_latin: ARCHIPRESBYTERALE TEMPLUM, CIVITATIS AC DIOECESIS COMENSIS INTRA FINES, IN HONOREM S. GEORGII MARTYRIS DEO DICATUM, TITULO BASILICAE MINORIS CONDECORATUR.
incipit_latin: Comensi in civitate ac dioecesi exstat antiquum templum archipresbyterale in honorem Sancti Georgii Martyris Deo dicatum, quod Sancti Euthychii Episcopi Comensis titulo etiam honestatur
image_title_latin: Nostra Domina a Sacro Corde (Iesu)
church_or_sanctuary: Templum archipresbyterale S. Georgii Martyris
legate: Andreas Carolus Ferrari, S.R.E. Cardinalis, Archiepiscopus Mediolanensis
notes: Basilica Minor grant. Attestation: 'Nostrae Dominae a Sacro Corde simulacrum, quod eadem in ecclesia custoditur, magni pretii coronis redimitum, quas nomine Decessoris Nostri Benedicti Pp. XV, pretiosorum quoque lapidum quibus ipsae coronae sunt contextae munifici donatoris, Sanctae Romanae Ecclesiae Cardinalis recolendae memoriae Andreas Ferrari, Mediolanensium Archiepiscopus uti Legatus imposuit'. OCR reads 'Andreas Perrari' and 'redimitimi'; repaired. Crowned in the name of Benedict XV (so 1914-1921, Ferrari d. Feb. 1921); no date given. Passage printed_page 327, but the act begins on p. 326 (verified in the volume text).

rubric_latin: ECCLESIA CATHEDRALIS CAIAMARCENSIS, TITULO B. MARIAE VIRG. «A VALLE», BASILICAE MINORIS PRIVILEGIIS HONORIBUSQUE AUGETUR.
incipit_latin: Postulat a Nobis Venerabilis Frater Catamarcensium Episcopus, intra fines Reipublicae Argentinae, quinquagesimi anni occasione ab imposita corona aurea, qua statua Beatae Mariae Virginis a Valle ... redimita fuit
image_title_latin: Beata Maria Virgo a Valle
church_or_sanctuary: Ecclesia Cathedralis Catamarcensis
notes: Basilica Minor grant made on the fiftieth anniversary of the crowning: 'quinquagesimi anni occasione ab imposita corona aurea, qua statua Beatae Mariae Virginis a Valle, in templo Cathedrali suo servata, redimita fuit'. coronation_date 1891 is computed from that fifty-year interval (act dated 1941), not stated explicitly - please verify. Rubric OCR 'CAIAMARCENSIS' for 'CATAMARCENSIS'; the body reads 'Catamarcensium Episcopus'. Datum reads 'die u m. Iulii' (= II, 2 July). No act numeral: the section heading is a bare 'LITTERAE APOSTOLICAE'.

rubric_latin: TEMPLUM SANCTI FRANCISCI ASSISIENSIS SEU SANCTUARIUM B. MARIAE VIRG. IMMACULATAE, IN CIVITATE AGRIGENTINA EXSTANS, BASILICIS MINORIBUS ACCENSETUR.
incipit_latin: Refert ad Nos Venerabilis Frater Agrigentinus Episcopus intra fines civitatis suae episcopalis conspicuum titulo Sancti Francisci Assisiensis templum exstare

church_or_sanctuary: Templum Sancti Francisci Assisiensis, seu Sanctuarium B. Mariae Virginis Immaculatae
notes: Basilica Minor act; coronation attested in passing: 'anno proxime elapso Marianum ipsum simulacrum, Decreto Capituli Sacrosanctae Basilicae Vaticanae aurea corona est honestatum'. Coronation year 1940 derived from 'anno proxime elapso' relative to the act's year (MCMXXXXI); the year itself is not printed. Act day OCR-damaged: 'die rr m. Iulii, an. MCMXXXXI' (probably 'die II'), so act_date left null. Venerated image is a wooden statue ('veneranda lignea statua').

rubric_latin: BASILICAE MINORIS HONORIBUS DECORATUR TEMPLUM IN HONOREM S. MARTINI EP. DEO DICATUM SEU SANCTUARIUM DEIPARAE A MONTE CARMELO, IN URBE BONONIENSI ORDINI FRATRUM CARMELITARUM CONCREDITUM.
incipit_latin: Bononiensi in urbe templum in honorem Sancti Martini Episcopi Deo dicatum exstat, curis ministerioque concreditum Ordinis Fratrum Carmelitarum
image_title_latin: Beata Maria Virgo de Monte Carmelo
church_or_sanctuary: Templum Sancti Martini Episcopi, seu Sanctuarium Deiparae a Monte Carmelo
notes: Passage printed_page was 33; the act begins on printed p. 32, used here. Text: 'quodque aureo diademate, Capituli Vaticani decreto iam anno millesimo septingentesimo quarto exornatum, ab hodierno Archiepiscopo ... Ioanne Baptista S.R.E. Cardinali Nasalli Rocca di Corneliano iterum anno millesimo nongentesimo trigesimo nono decoratum est' — i.e. first crowned 1704 by decree of the Vatican Chapter, re-crowned 1939 by Card. Nasalli Rocca.

rubric_latin: BEATA MARIA VIRGO, SUB TITULO « DE URIBARRI », QUAE IN OPPIDO « DURANGO » VICTORIENSIS DIOECESIS VENERATUR, TOTIUS ARCHIPRESBYTERALIS REGIONIS DURANGUENSIS PATRONA COELESTIS DECLARATUR.
incipit_latin: Victoriensis dioecesis intra fines, in oppidi « Durango » nuncupati templo archipresbyterali, Imago quaedam Beatae Mariae Virginis religiosissime colitur sub populari titulo « de Uribarri »
image_title_latin: Beata Maria Virgo de Uribarri
church_or_sanctuary: Templum archipresbyterale de Durango
notes: Patron declaration that also grants the coronation: 'ut Imaginem eandem corona Nomine Nostro redimiri decerneremus ... ipsi Venerabili Fratri Episcopo titulo Siandensi, Victoriensis dioecesis Apostolico Administratori, eas partes committimus ut Imaginem ... aureo diademate, nomine atque auctoritate Nostris, sollemniter redimiat'. The executor is the titular Bishop of 'Siandensis', Apostolic Administrator of Vitoria; his personal name is not given in the act, so legate left null. Date of coronation left to him ('die ab eodem statuendo'). Passage printed_page was 221; act begins on printed p. 220. Vernacular title supplied as the Spanish form of the Latin 'de Uribarri' (only the Latin form appears).

rubric_latin: PAROECIALIS CONLEGIATAQUE ECCLESIA, IN « TAGGIA » INTRA FINES VENTIMILIENSIS DIOECESIS, SUB TITULO SANCTORUM IACOBI ET PHILIPPI ERECTA, DIGNITATE AC TITULO BASILICAE MINORIS DECORATUR.
incipit_latin: Ventimiliensium Episcopus Nos edocet castri satis perspicui, quod intra fines dioecesis suae « Taggia » nuncupant, paroecialem titulo sanctorum Iacobi et Philippi ecclesiam
image_title_latin: Sacrum Cor Immaculatum Beatae Mariae Virginis
church_or_sanctuary: Ecclesia paroecialis et conlegiata Sanctorum Iacobi et Philippi (Sanctuarium Mariale)
notes: Basilica Minor act; coronation attested in passing: 'apud Sanctuarium eiusdem thaumaturgae imaginis, quae iam anno millesimo octingentesimo quinquagesimo sexto aurea corona exornata est'. Image described as 'Sacri Cordis Immaculati Beatae Mariae Virginis simulacrum'; no crowning authority named.

rubric_latin: NUNTIUS RADIOPHONICUS A BEATISSIMO PATRE, DIE XXXI MENSIS OCTOBRIS ANNO MCMXXXXIII, IN FESTO D. N. IESU CHRISTI REGIS, CHRISTIFIDELIBUS DATUS, OB III CONVENTUM EUCHARISTICUM E TOTA PERUVIANA NATIONE IN URBE TRUXILLENSI COADUNATIS
notes: Radio message of Pius XII closing the 3rd Peruvian National Eucharistic Congress at Trujillo. Spanish original, p. 356: 'para que Tu, Virgen de la Puerta, solemnemente coronada el pasado miercoles'; Italian version, p. 359 (this passage): 'Tu, Vergine della Puerta, incoronata solennemente lo scorso mercoledi'. The source names only the devotional title, never an image, and does not state under whose authority the crowning took place; it is the Pope himself who acknowledges it, and the Congress was presided by his Legate. The act begins on p. 353 (Spanish) with the Italian version beginning p. 357; the rubric above is transcribed from p. 353, not from this passage. 'Last Wednesday' relative to the stated act date (31 October 1943, a Sunday) would be 27 October 1943, but the passage does not give a date, so only the year is recorded. Also greeted in the same sentence is 'Nuestra Senora del Socorro' of Huanchaco, of whom no crowning is said.

rubric_latin: NEAPOLITANA. BEATIFICATIONIS ET CANONIZATIONIS VENERABILIS SERVI DEI PLACIDI BACCHER, SACERDOTIS SAECULARIS E TERTIO ORDINE S. DOMINICI. SUPER DUBIO
incipit_latin: In Neapolitana civitate, fecunda Servorum Dei altrice, e nobili prosapia, ortus est Placidus Baccher die 5 Aprilis a. 1781 eodemque die baptizatus est
image_title_latin: Simulacrum Beatissimae Virginis (Immaculatae Conceptionis)
church_or_sanctuary: Ecclesia « Gesù Vecchio »
notes: Decree on the heroic virtues of Ven. Placido Baccher; coronation mentioned only in passing: '...atque erga Beatissimam Virginem, cuius immaculati conceptus doctrinam, ante dogmaticam definitionem, strenue defendit, cuius etiam simulacrum in sua Ecclesia veneratum, a Vaticano Capitulo corona decorandum curavit'. No date; the image is the one venerated in the church 'Gesù Vecchio' in Naples of which Baccher was rector. Passage printed_page 153; decree opens on p. 152.

rubric_latin: AD EMUM P. D. RODRIGUUM S. R. E. CARD. VILLENEUVE, ARCHIEPISCOPUM QUEBECENSEM, QUEM LEGATUM MITTIT AD CONVENTUM MARIALEM AD SANCTUARIUM B. MARIAE VIRGINIS GUADALUPENSIS MEXICOPOLI CELEBRANDUM.
incipit_latin: Mater spei et gratiae Deipara Virgo cum ubique terrarum sacraria, ubi perpeti benignitate filiis alumnisque suis cuiuslibet generis solamina largitur
image_title_latin: B. Virginis Mariae Guadalupensis effigies
church_or_sanctuary: Templum Guadalupense
notes: Letter deputing Card. Villeneuve as Legate to the Marian Congress (NOT to a coronation); it attests the earlier coronation in passing: 'cum quinquagesimus feliciter plenus annus decurrat, ex quo B. Virginis Mariae effigies aureo serto redimita est'. Coronation year 1895 is computed from the fiftieth year running in 1945, not stated verbatim; day/month not given. Legate field left null because the deputation is for the congress, not the crowning. Passage printed_page 255; letter opens on p. 254.

rubric_latin: CHRISTIFIDELIBUS DATUS DIE XII MENSIS OCTOBRIS A. MCMXLV, OB MARIALEM CONVENTUM AD SANCTUARIUM B. MARIAE V. GUADALUPENSI MEXICOPOLI COADUNATIS
incipit_latin: Venerables Hermanos y amados hijos que, reunidos en torno a la persona de Nuestro dignisimo Cardenal Legado, conmemorais los cincuenta anos de la coronacion canonica de la Virgen de Guadalupe
image_title_latin: B. Maria V. Guadalupensis
church_or_sanctuary: Sanctuarium B. Mariae V. Guadalupensis (the Basilica, 'la Basilica, recien restaurada')
notes: Radio message for the Marian congress marking the fiftieth anniversary of the canonical coronation of the Virgin of Guadalupe: 'conmemorais los cincuenta anos de la coronacion canonica de la Virgen de Guadalupe' and 'Hace hoy cincuenta anos ... cuando sobre aquella frente angelical resplandecio la aurea corona'. Coronation date derived from 'today fifty years ago' relative to the act date 12 October 1945. Body is in Spanish, so incipit_latin holds the Spanish opening verbatim (accents lost in OCR). The Cardinal Legate is not named in the text. The act begins on this page (264); the same act continues to p. 267, where a further papal act is recorded separately.

rubric_latin: CHRISTIFIDELIBUS DATUS DIE XII MENSIS OCTOBRIS A. MCMXLV, OB MARIALEM CONVENTUM AD SANCTUARIUM B. MARIAE V. GUADALUPENSI MEXICOPOLI COADUNATIS
image_title_latin: B. Maria V. Guadalupensis
church_or_sanctuary: Sanctuarium B. Mariae V. Guadalupensis (the Basilica)
notes: Same act as AAS-37-1945-ocr#g264 (act begins on p. 264; this passage carries pp. 266-268). Pius XII, speaking in the first person to the congress gathered round his Cardinal Legate, says: 'Nos, a quien la admirable disposicion de la Divina Providencia confio ... el sagrado tesoro de la divina sabiduria en la tierra ... Nos colocamos hoy de nuevo sobre tus sienes la corona, que pone para siempre bajo tu poderoso patrocinio la pureza y la integridad de la santa fe en Mejico y en todo el continente americano'. This is a re-crowning (a new crown placed 'de nuevo') declared by the Pope by radio while an unnamed Cardinal Legate presided in person, not a first canonical coronation and not a coronation performed by the Pope's own hand; classified papal_personal_coronation because the Pope himself states he places the crown. The source never uses a word for 'image', naming only the devotional title.

rubric_latin: NUNTIUS RADIOPHONICUS A BEATISSIMO PATRE, DIE XIII MENSIS MAII A. MCMXLVI, LUSITANIAE CHRISTIFIDELIBUS DATUS, SOLLEMNIA CELEBRANTIBUS AD SANCTUARIUM B. MARIAE V. A FATIMA, AUREA CORONA NOMINE SUMMI PONTIFICIS REDIMITAE.
image_title_latin: B. Maria V. a Fatima

rubric_latin: AD EMUM P. D. BENEDICTUM TIT. SANCTAE MARIAE IN VALLICELLA S. R. E. PRESBYTERUM CARDINALEM ALOISI MASELLA, QUEM LEGATUM MITTIT AD CORONAM APPONENDAM SIMULACRO B. MARIAE V. DE FATIMA.

The coronation itself is recorded in the papal radio message of 13 May 1946, AAS 38 (1946) pp. 264-267, rubric 'NUNTIUS RADIOPHONICUS ... SOLLEMNIA CELEBRANTIBUS AD SANCTUARIUM B. MARIAE V. A FATIMA, AUREA CORONA NOMINE SUMMI PONTIFICIS REDIMITAE' ('por mão do Nosso Cardeal Legado, acabamos de coroar a Imagem taumaturga'). Diocese (Leiria) not named in either text.

rubric_latin: SANCTUS NICOLAUS BARENSIS, EP. ET CONF., CIVITATIS AC DIOECESIS RIOIENSIS, IN REPUBLICA ARGENTINA, PRIMUS AC PRAECIPUUS PATRONUS CAELESTIS CONSTITUITUR.

rubric_latin: AD TITULUM AC DIGNITATEM BASILICAE MINORIS EVEHITUR TEMPLUM B. MARIAE V. A SACRATISSIMO ROSARIO IN URBE « TALPA », DIOECESIS TEPICENSIS, EXSTANS

MARIAE V.'; repaired to 'TEMPLUM B. MARIAE V.'. The vernacular title (Nuestra Senora del Rosario de Talpa) is not given in the text, so the field is left null. rubric_latin: AD TITULUM AC DIGNITATEM BASILICAE MINORIS EVEHITUR TEMPLUM B. MARIAE V. A SACRATISSIMO ROSARIO IN URBE « TALPA », DIOECESIS TEPICENSIS, EXSTANS.

rubric_latin: ECCLESIA PAROECIALIS, GODII IN ARCE MANTUANAE DIOECESIS EXTANS, DEO IN HONOREM B. MARIAE V. VULGO « MADONNA DELLA SALUTE » DICATA, BASILICIS MINORIBUS ACCENSETUR.

image_title_latin: Beata Maria Virgo vulgo « Madonna della Salute » (olim « del terraglio »)
church_or_sanctuary: Ecclesia paroecialis B. Mariae Virginis « Madonna della Salute »
legate: Adeodatus Ioannes Piazza, S.R.E. Cardinalis, Patriarch of Venice
notes: Basilica Minor act recording a coronation carried out in the Pope's name: 'ditissimo fulget diademate Eidem sollemniter imposito Nostro Nomine die iv mensis Novembris superioris anni a Dilecto Filio Nostro Adeodato Ioanne S.R.E. Presbytero Cardinali Piazza, Venetiarum Patriarcha' — and later 'auctoritate Nostra, per similes Apostolicas Litteras die xxix mensis Octobris eiusdem anni sub anulo Piscatoris datas, aurea corona gemmata ... sollemniter redimita est fictilis perantiqua Imago'. 'superioris anni' relative to the act (15 Aug 1946) gives 4 Nov 1945; the enabling Apostolic Letters are dated 29 Oct 1945. Terracotta image found within the walls of the castle of Godium in 1702, popularly 'del terraglio'. Passage printed_page was 447; act begins on printed p. 445. 'Godium' is Castel Goffredo (Mantua) — identification inferred from 'Godii in arce ... in ripa Mincii ... Gonzaga Marchionum'.

rubric_latin: AD DIGNITATEM ET HONOREM BASILICAE MINORIS EVEHITUR ECCLESIA PAROECIALIS DEO IN HONOREM S. MARTINI DICATA ET IN CIVITATE POSITA, CUI NOMEN VULGO « HAL », INTRA FINES ARCHIDIOECESIS MECHLINIENSIS.

rubric_latin: ECCLESIA COLLEGIALIS B. MARIAE V., VULGO DICTA « DE SAN JUAN DE LOS LAGOS », INTRA FINES ARCHIDIOECESIS GUADALAJARENSIS, HONORIBUS BASILICAE MINORIS INSIGNITUR.

rubric_latin: TEMPLUM IN HONOREM B. MARIAE VIRGINIS, MATRIS DESERTORUM, DEO VALENTIAE IN HISPANIA DICATUM, PRIVILEGIIS BASILICAE MINORIS HONESTATUR.

rubric_latin: BASILICAE MINORIS HONORIBUS DECORATUR ECCLESIA CATHEDRALIS VIRDUNENSIS, IN GALLIA.
incipit_latin: Mirabile itidemque haud commune privilegium vetustae Virodunensi Ecclesiae Cathedrali, in Gallia, eminentissimus Deus largitus est
image_title_latin: Marianum Simulacrum, sub nomine Dominae Nostrae « de Prodigiis » seu « de Viroduno »
church_or_sanctuary: Ecclesia Cathedralis Virodunensis
notes: Basilica Minor act for Verdun cathedral; the coronation clause falls on printed p. 491, but the act opens on p. 490, so aas_page is the act's start page. Coronation clause: 'Marianum praesertim Simulacrum, quod ibidem magna devotione colitur, per Venerabilem Fratrem Angelum Iosephum Roncalli, Mesembrianum titularem Archiepiscopum, Apostolicum in Gallia Nostrum Nuntium, postridie Kalendas Iunias superiore anno, corona auro gemmisque distincta redimitum fuit.' Crowned not by a deputed Legate but by the Apostolic Nuncio to France, Angelo Giuseppe Roncalli (later John XXIII), hence 'legate' left null. coronation_date derived: 'postridie Kalendas Iunias' = 2 June; 'superiore anno' relative to the act's Datum (8 Sept 1947) = 1946 — verify. OCR of the rubric reads 'VIRDU-NENSIS' (line-break); correct form is presumably VIRODUNENSIS. Vernacular title is a rendering of the Latin 'Dominae Nostrae de Prodigiis seu de Viroduno'; not given in the text.

Passage printed_page was 542; act begins on printed p. 541. Vernacular title supplied as the Italian form of 'Maria gratiarum'.

image_title_latin: Beatissima Virgo a « Valleviride »

Crowned by concession of the Vatican Chapter, not by a papal act. The year is not stated; the surrounding narrative places it in 'superiore anno' relative to the Datum of 25 March 1949, hence 1948 — verify. The candidate passage is keyed to printed p. 175; the act begins on p. 174, which is cited here. OCR rubric reads 'VALLEYTRIDE' (repaired to VALLEVIRIDE).

rubric_latin: ECCLESIA PAROECIALIS DEO IN HONOREM « NOSTRAE DOMINAE » DICATA, IN CIVITATE « GRAY » ARCHIDIOECESIS BISUNTINAE POSITA, PRIVILEGIIS BASILICAE MINORIS HONESTATUR.

rubric_latin: BEATA MARIA VIRGO, « MADONNA DEL PONTELUNGO » NUNCUPATA, CIVITATIS AC DIOECESIS ALBINGANENSIS PATRONA CAELESTIS DECLARATUR EIUSDEMQUE FESTUM CERTA DIE STATUITUR.

church_or_sanctuary: Templum Beatae Mariae Virginis a « Ponte Longo »
notes: Patron-declaration act. The only crowning statement is 'Hoc quippe Simulacrum, septies usque adhuc, maxima supplicum turba stipante, corona redimitum, coli atque observari numquam desiit' — the image has been crowned seven times so far; NO papal authority, date or agent is named, so this may not be a canonical papal coronation. Flagged for human check. The image is a 1502 triptych panel painting of the Virgin with the Divine Infant holding the keys of Albenga. Passage printed_page was 592; act begins on printed p. 591.

rubric_latin: BEATA MARIA VIRGO « A MIRACULIS », IN AEDE LOCI « CASALBORDINO » VENERATA, TOTIUS THEATINAE ARCHIDIOECESIS PRAECIPUA PATRONA CONSTITUITUR.

The shrine lies in the diocese of Vasto, while the patronage granted is over the whole Archdiocese of Chieti (Theatina).

rubric_latin: ECCLESIA SANCTI MATERNI, IN OPPIDO « WALCOURT » DIOECESIS NAMURCENSIS EXSTANS, BASILICAE MINORIS TITULO AC PRIVILEGIIS COHONESTATUR.

notes: Basilica Minor act; coronation attested in passing on printed p. 269: « expleto LXXV anno a quo hoc signum auctoritate Pii PP. IX, fel. mem., Decessoris Nostri, aurea redimitum est corona ». The year is not stated outright: 1875 is derived from the 75 years said to have elapsed as of this act (Datum 13 May 1950) — verify. The candidate passage is keyed to printed p. 269; the act begins on p. 268, which is cited here. `pope` is the pope of the act (Pius XII); the crowning itself was by authority of Pius IX.

rubric_latin: AD DIGNITATEM ET HONOREM BASILICAE MINORIS EVEHITUR PAROECIALIS ECCLESIA S. MARGARITAE, V. ET M., IN CIVITATE « SANTA MARGHERITA LIGURE », INTRA FINES CLAVARENSIS DIOECESIS EXSTANS.

rubric_latin: ECCLESIA DEO IN HONOREM B. MARIAE V. DICATA, IN OPPIDO « LA GUERCHE DE BRETAGNE » IN GALLIA POSITA, INTRA RHEDONENSIS ARCHIDIOECESIS FINES, TITULO BASILICAE MINORIS ORNATUR.

church_or_sanctuary: Ecclesia paroecialis et collegialis B. Mariae Virginis, La Guerche-de-Bretagne
legate: Emmanuel Caelestinus S. R. E. Cardinalis Suhard, then Archbishop of Reims, later of Paris
notes: Basilica Minor act; the clause on printed p. 725 reads: « ... quae a desideratissimo S. R. E. Presbytero Cardinali Emmanuele Caelestino Suhard, tunc Rhemensi postea Parisiensi Archiepiscopo, anno MCMXXXVII sollemni est pompa redimita ». Note that 'corona' / 'diademate' is not expressed — 'redimita' is used absolutely — so that this is a coronation is a reading of the standard AAS formula and should be verified. The vernacular title is a normalisation of the Latin 'de la Guerche' given in the text. The candidate passage is keyed to printed p. 725; the act begins on p. 724, which is cited here.

rubric_latin: TEMPLUM IN HONOREM B. MARIAE V. IN CAELUM ASSUMPTAE DEO CONSECRATUM, IN OPPIDO « LUGO » IMOLENSIS DIOECESIS HONORIBUS BASILICAE MINORIS INSIGNITUR.

image_title_latin: signum Almae Deiparae
church_or_sanctuary: Ecclesia B. Mariae V. in Caelum Assumptae (Basilica Minor), Lugo
notes: Basilica Minor elevation; attests 'Pius Pp. IX, Decessor Noster, olim loci illius Episcopus, imaginem, tot laudibus ornatam, anno MDCCCLVI, aureo diademate iussit redimiri' — i.e. crowned by order of Pius IX in 1856. The image was translated to the new church in 1943 ('anno MCMXLIII', OCR 'MCMXL i n').

rubric_latin: AD EMUM P. D. FRIDERICUM, EPISCOPUM TUSCULANUM, S. R. E. CARDINALEM TEDESCHINI, PATRIARCHALIS BASILICAE VATICANAE ARCHIPRESBYTERUM, SACRI CONSILII PETRIANAE FABRICAE PRAEFECTUM EUNDEMQUE SUMMI PONTIFICIS DATARIUM, LEGATUM DELECTUM AD SACRA SOLLEMNIA IN LUSITANIA AD SIMULACRUM B. VIRGINIS MARIAE DE FATIMA CELEBRANDA.
incipit_latin: Proximo Octobri mense, postquam Congressus Marialis ex omnibus nationibus Ulyssipone in Lusitania habitus fuerit, Anno Sacro, quem ad universum catholicum orbem extendimus
image_title_latin: imago Nostrae Dominae de Fatima
church_or_sanctuary: Sanctuarium Fatimanum
notes: Letter deputing Card. Federico Tedeschini as Legate for the closing solemnities of the Holy Year at Fatima — NOT for a coronation; the crowning is mentioned retrospectively on printed p. 781: « quique eandem sollemni ritu quinque abhinc annos coronandam quoque decrevimus ». 'quinque abhinc annos' from the Datum (24 Sept 1951) gives 1946; the year is not stated outright. `legate` left null because Tedeschini was deputed for the solemnities, not to crown. Diocese not named in the act; Leiria supplied from the place name — verify. The candidate passage is keyed to printed p. 781; the act begins on p. 780, which is cited here.

rubric_latin: ECCLESIA BEATAE MARIAE V. IN CAELUM ASSUMPTAE SACRA IN MONTE « CREA » INTRA CASALENSIS DIOECESIS FINES, BASILICAE MINORIS TITULO AC PRIVILEGIIS COHONESTATUR.
incipit_latin: In summo colle « Crea » nuncupato, ex quo omnem Montis Ferrati et Casalensis dioecesis regionem conspicias, nobile exstat templum
image_title_latin: Assumptio Dei Genetricis, a Gulielmo Caccia, quem et « Moncalvo » appellant, coloribus expressa
church_or_sanctuary: Templum B. Mariae Virginis in caelum Assumptae in monte « Crea »
notes: Basilica Minor act; coronation attested in passing on printed p. 179: « quae imago die v mensis Augusti, anno MDCCCLXÌXXX, sollemni ritu aurea redimita est corona ». The year is OCR-damaged — raw form 'MDCCCLXÌXXX', read here as MDCCCLXXXX = 1890 (1880 would require two spurious characters); needs human verification. The crowned object is the altarpiece painting of the Assumption by Guglielmo Caccia 'il Moncalvo'. No authorising authority is named.

rubric_latin: BEATA MARIA VIRGO DE MONTE CARMELO CIVITATIS ET DIOECESIS TRICARICENSIS PATRONA CAELESTIS AEQUE PRINCIPALIS CUM SANCTO POTITO DECLARATUR.
incipit_latin: Religionem Beatae Mariae Virginis Carmelitidis in animis Christifidelium dioecesis Tricaricensis altius accepimus insedisse, praesertim postquam Eius imago
image_title_latin: Beata Maria Virgo de Monte Carmelo
notes: Patron declaration; attests 'postquam Eius imago, inter populi gestientis vota, anno MCMXXXVIII aureo diademate sit redimita'. No church named for the image. OCR page headers in the passage are garbled ('266', '366' for 265, 266); the act begins on printed page 264, confirmed against txt/AAS-44-1952-ocr.txt page markers.

rubric_latin: PAROECIALE TEMPLUM LOCI « TONGRE-NOTRE-DAME » DIOECESIS TORNACENSIS TITULO AC PRIVILEGIIS BASILICAE MINORIS DITATUR.
incipit_latin: Almam Dei hominumque Matrem Mariam Christifideles pagi « Tongre-Notre-Dame » vulgo appellati et continentis quoque regionis accepimus religiosis venerari obsequiis.
image_title_latin: Durateum signum Beatae Mariae Virginis, seculo XI exsculptum
church_or_sanctuary: Paroeciale templum loci « Tongre-Notre-Dame »
legate: Bishop of Tournai (unnamed), acting in the name of Leo XIII
notes: Basilica Minor act; coronation attested in passing on printed p. 363: crowned 8 September 1881 in the name of Leo XIII by the Bishop of Tournai (« a Tornacensi Antistite aurea redimitum est corona »); the crown having later been sacrilegiously removed, the image was crowned again on 1 June 1949 by Abp. Ferdinando Cento, Apostolic Nuncio in Belgium (« diademate impie sublato ... regio eiusmodi insigni die i mensis Iunii, anno MCMXLIX, iterum revinxit »). The vernacular title is the place-name form given in the act rubric; verify.

rubric_latin: AD EMUM P. D. BENEDICTUM EPISCOPUM PRAENESTINUM S. R. E. CARDINALEM ALOISI MASELLA, PATRIARCHALIS BASILICAE LATERANENSIS ARCHIPRESBYTERUM, SACRAE CONGREGATIONIS DE DISCIPLINA SACRAMENTORUM PRO-PRAEFECTUM, QUINQUAGESIMUM SACERDOTII ANNUM IMPLETURUM.
incipit_latin: Persuavi animi iucunditate accepimus, praenobilis sedis istius Praenestinae clerum fidelemque populum, egregio praeeunte Episcopo suffraganeo, concordi studere consilio
image_title_latin: simulacrum Beatae Mariae Virginis de Fatima
legate: Benedictus S. R. E. Cardinalis Aloisi Masella
notes: Jubilee letter to Card. Aloisi Masella; the coronation is mentioned only retrospectively on printed p. 467: « Peculiarem quoque benevolentiam Nos tibi significavimus, quum ad coronam simulacro Beatae Mariae Virginis de Fatima apponendam Legatum Nostrum renuntiavimus ». No date given for the crowning. The Datum on p. 468 is OCR-corrupt ('die xviii mensis Maii, anno MDCCCCIII'); the pontifical year ('quarto decimo') fixes it as 1952, so 1952-05-18 — verify. Country inferred from 'de Fatima'.

rubric_latin: AD EMUM P. D. EMMANUELEM TIT. SANCTI LAURENTII IN LUCINA S. R. E. PRESB. CARDINALEM ARTEAGA Y BETANCOURT, ARCHIEPISCOPUM SANCTI CHRISTOPHORI DE HABANA, QUEM LEGATUM RENUNTIAT AD IMAGINEM NOSTRAE DOMINAE DE COROMOTO CORONA EXORNANDAM.
incipit_latin: Intra fines dioecesis Barquisimetensis, in Venezuelana Republica sitae, celebre admodum exstat Sanctuarium Beatae Mariae Virginis sub populari titulo « de Coromoto »
image_title_latin: Nostra Domina de Coromoto
church_or_sanctuary: Sanctuarium de Guanare (Basilica Minor)
legate: Manuel Arteaga y Betancourt, Cardinal, Archbishop of San Cristóbal de La Habana
notes: The batch passage itself is the volume's chronological index on printed p. 906, which points to the act on p. 722 ('quem Legatum renuntiat ad imaginem Nostrae Dominae de Coromoto corona exornandam 722'); the same act is indexed again at p. 942. aas_page is therefore the act's page (722), not the index page. Rubric, incipit, Datum and details taken from the act text at AAS 44 (1952) 722-723 in the full volume file. Act: '...perinsignem illam imaginem sollemni ritu proximo Septembri mense coronandam per Legatum Nostrum censuimus... ut in Sanctuario de Guanare venerandam imaginem Nostrae Dominae de Coromoto veluti manibus Nostris sacra exornes corona.' coronation_date = September 1952 ('proximo Septembri mense'); the volume also records a papal radio message of 12 Sept 1952 to the Venezuelans celebrating the coronation (p. 739). OCR of the act gives 'Guanare de los Oospes' (= Guanare de los Cospes) and 'Berquisimetensis' alongside 'Barquisimetensis'. Spanish form of the title taken from the radio message text at p. 739 ('Nuestra Señora de Coromoto').

rubric_latin: NUNTIUS RADIOPHONICUS CHRISTIFIDELIBUS VENEZUELAE DATUS, SOLLEMNIA IN HONOREM B. MARIAE VIRGINIS DE COROMOTO CELEBRANTIBUS.
incipit_latin: Venerables Hermanos y amados hijos, católicos venezolanos, que en la linda Guanare asistís conmovidos a la solemne coronación de vuestra Excelsa Patrona, Nuestra Señora de Coromoto
image_title_latin: B. Maria Virgo de Coromoto
church_or_sanctuary: Santuario Nacional de Nuestra Señora de Coromoto (Basilica Minor)
notes: Radio message of Pius XII broadcast to Venezuela on the day of the coronation; the footnote reads 'Habita die 12 Septembris mensis a. 1952', which is the delivery date (there is no Datum line) and also the date of the ceremony. The text never uses a word for 'image': it speaks of the devotional title, the people 'colocándole en las sienes una preciosa corona' at 'la solemne coronación de vuestra Excelsa Patrona, Nuestra Señora de Coromoto'. It is not itself the granting act: the papal Legate was deputed by the Litterae at AAS 44 (1952) 722 ('AD IMAGINEM NOSTRAE DOMINAE DE COROMOTO CORONA EXORNANDAM', dated 30 July 1952, Card. Emmanuel Arteaga y Betancourt, Archbishop of Havana), hence retrospective_attestation. The message names the Legate only as 'Nuestro dignísimo Legado', so legate is left null; church_or_sanctuary, diocese_latin and diocese_modern are taken from that companion act at p. 722 (this passage says only 'el gran Santuario Nacional' at Guanare, Venezuela). Rubric OCR reads 'VENEZUELAS' for 'VENEZUELAE'. Incipit is the Spanish salutation, the act having no Latin body.

rubric_latin: BEATA MARIA V. « DEL PUEBLITO » CIVITATIS QUERETARI, IN MEXICO, PATRONA CAELESTIS AEQUE PRINCIPALIS AC SANCTUS IACOBUS MAIOR APOSTOLUS CONFIRMATUR.
incipit_latin: Maximo Nos afficimur gaudio quotiescumque comperimus Beatissimam semperque Virginem Dei Genetricem Mariam, in Qua, post Deum inter tot quibus premimur undique angustiis, plenam ponimus spem ac fidem Nostram
image_title_latin: Imago Beatae Mariae Virginis, vulgo « del Pueblito »
church_or_sanctuary: Templum eiusdem appellationis (« del Pueblito »), entrusted to the Friars Minor
legate: Marcianus Tinajero y Estrada, Episcopus Queretarensis (acting 'Nostro nomine et auctoritate')
notes: Patron-confirmation act reporting in detail the coronation of 17 October 1946, carried out by the Bishop of Querétaro in the Pope's name and authority under Litterae Apostolicae given sub anulo Piscatoris on 7 October 1943 ('die VII mensis Octobris anno MCMXXXXIII datarum'). Present at the rite: Abp Aloysius Martínez of Mexico, Chargé d'Affaires. The act's own Datum line is cut off in the passage ('Datum ex Arce Gand...') so act_date is null. The act begins on printed page 806 (passage indexed at 807), verified against the page markers in txt/AAS-44-1952-ocr.txt.

rubric_latin: BEATAE MARIAE V. VULGO « DEI LÀTTANI » DICTA, TITULO « REGINA MUNDI » HONESTATA, DIOECESIUM CALVENSIS ET THEANENSIS CAELESTIS PATRONA CONFIRMATUR.
incipit_latin: Vitae huius iactati procellis atque tenebris offusi, Christifideles oportet ad Almam Deiparam fidentibus animis confugiant, quae, ex providentis Dei consilio
image_title_latin: Beata Maria Virgo vulgo « dei Làttani » dicta, titulo « Regina mundi » honestata
church_or_sanctuary: Templum Dei Genetricis « dei Làttani »
legate: Clemens S. R. E. Cardinalis Micara, Bishop of Velletri, Pro-Prefect of the Sacred Congregation of Rites
notes: Patron-declaration act; coronation attested in passing on printed p. 149: « postquam die vi mensis Augusti, anno MCML, per Venerabilem Fratrem Nostrum Clementem Sanctae Romanae Ecclesiae Cardinalem Micara ... Imago illa, inter populi gestientis vota, Nostro nomine et auctoritate, aurea redimita est corona ». The act names no town, only the two dioceses, so locality is left null. Country inferred from the Italian dioceses of Calvi and Teano.

rubric_latin: BASILICAE MINORIS TITULO AC DIGNITATE AFFICITUR ECCLESIA B. MARIAE V. IN CAELUM ASSUMPTAE, IN MONTE « PLAIN » INTRA ARCHIDIOECESIS SALISBURGENSIS FINES.
incipit_latin: Gementium Solatrix eademque ad caelestem gloriam Assumpta, Beata Maria Virgo in Templo, supra amoenum montem « Plain », quem vocant, prope Salisburgum posito, religiosis ornatur obsequiis
image_title_latin: Deiparae Simulacrum in monte « Plain »
church_or_sanctuary: Ecclesia B. Mariae V. in Caelum Assumptae in monte « Plain » (Basilica Minor), entrusted to Benedictine monks
notes: Basilica Minor elevation; attests the image was 'Benedicti Pp. XIV, Decessoris Nostri, fel. rec., nomine et auctoritate, aureo diademate redimita'. The year is only indicated relatively: the image was restored in 1732 and crowned 'sex fere lustris expletis' (after nearly six lustra, i.e. c. 30 years), which would give c. 1762 — inconsistent with Benedict XIV (d. 1758); coronation_date left null for human check. Country Austria inferred from 'prope Salisburgum' / Archdiocese of Salzburg (not stated in the passage).

rubric_latin: BEATA MARIA VIRGO A MISERICORDIA TOTIUS DIOECESIS INTERAMNENSIS CAELESTIS PATRONA AEQUE PRINCIPALIS CUM SANCTO VALENTINO, P. M., DECLARATUR.
incipit_latin: Quae Mater constituta est generis humani, Beata Maria Virgo, pie exorata, mortalibus aerumnosis misericordiae sinum aperit eosque studiosa complectitur caritate.
image_title_latin: Beata Maria Virgo a Misericordia
church_or_sanctuary: chapel of the cathedral (Templum principis) of Terni; the image is a painting attributed to Carlo Maratta
legate: Nicolaus S. R. E. Protodiaconus Cardinalis Canali
notes: Patron-declaration act; coronation attested in passing on printed p. 178: « factum est ut, anno millesimo nongentesimo tricesimo septimo, ex Petriani Canonicorum Collegii consulto, Dilectus Filius Noster Nicolaus ... Cardinalis Canali ... Simulacrum aureo redimirei diademate » (read: redimiret). Crowned by decree of the Vatican Chapter, not by a papal act. The vernacular title is a rendering of the Latin 'a Misericordia' — verify. The candidate passage is keyed to printed p. 178; the act begins on p. 177, which is cited here.

rubric_latin: BEATA MARIA V. VULGO « NOTRE-DAME DU REMPART » INVOCATA, TOTIUS CIVITATIS NAMURCENSIS PATRONA CAELESTIS AEQUE PRINCIPALIS CUM SANCTO ALBANO RENUNTIATUR.
incipit_latin: Vetus est apud Namurcenses Beatae Mariae Virginis cultus et religio, quandoquidem primum in eorum oppido exstructum Templum Deiparae nomine fuit dedicatum
image_title_latin: Domina Nostra ad moenia
notes: Patron declaration; attests 'Quam insignem Effigiem, superiore bello, quod per orbem flagraverat, confecto, Namurcensium tum Antistes, rec. mem. Pii Pp. XI, Decessoris Nostri, nomine et auctoritate, aurea corona, inter populi plaudentis vota, redimivit'. The crowning was done by the then Bishop of Namur (unnamed) in the name and by the authority of Pius XI, after the end of the (first) world war — so between 1922 and 1939; no year given. Country Belgium inferred from Namur/Namurcensis (not stated in the passage). Statue described as 'Beatae Mariae Virginis ab origine Immaculatae'.

rubric_latin: AD EMUM P. D. AUGUSTUM ALVARUM TIT. SANCTI ANGELI IN FORO PISCARIO S. R. E. PRESB. CARDINALEM DA SILVA, ARCHIEPISCOPUM SANCTI SALVATORIS IN BRASILIA, QUEM LEGATUM DELIGIT AD CONVENTUM EUCHARISTICUM E TOTA NATIONE BRASILIANA INDICTUM ATQUE AD SIMULACRO NOSTRAE DOMINAE DE NAZARETH IN BASILICA URBIS BELEMENSIS DE PARA CORONAM IMPONENDAM.
incipit_latin: Comperimus sane perlibenter, in urbe Belemensi de Para, Conventum Eucharisticum e tota natione Brasiliana, proximo Augusto mense, sollemniter celebratum iri
image_title_latin: simulacrum Nostrae Dominae de Nazareth
church_or_sanctuary: Basilica Nostrae Dominae de Nazareth
legate: Augustus Alvarus Cardinalis da Silva, Archiepiscopus Sancti Salvatoris in Brasilia (Legatus a Latere)
notes: Explicit faculty: 'tibi facultatem damus, ut Nostram gerens personam, simulacro Nostrae Dominae de Nazareth, quod in Basilica eiusdem nominis piissime colitur, veluti manibus Nostris coronam sollemniter imponas'. Coronation to take place during the national Eucharistic Congress in August 1953. The Datum year is OCR-mangled as 'MDCCCCVIII'; 'Pontificatus Nostri quinto decimo' and the volume year fix it as MDCCCCLIII = 1953. Vernacular title (Nossa Senhora de Nazaré) not given in the Latin text. The volume index (p. 912) repeats this: 'Corona aurea redimatur simulacrum Nostrae Dominae de Nazaret, in Basilica Belemensi de Para, 545'.

rubric_latin: BASILICAE MINORIS HONORIBUS PRIVILEGIISQUE DECORATUR ECCLESIA PAROECIALIS DEO IN HONOREM B. MARIAE VIRGINIS DICATA ET IN LOCO « ARCACHON » ARCHIDIOECESIS BURDIGALENSIS POSITA.
incipit_latin: Exstat in Gallia, intra Burdigalensis archidioecesis fines, urbs quaedam non ita frequens, vulgato nomine « Arcachon » appellata
image_title_latin: Deiparae ab « Arcachon » Effigies
church_or_sanctuary: Ecclesia paroecialis Nostrae Dominae de « Arcachon » (Basilica Minor)
notes: Basilica Minor elevation; attests 'Cum Deiparae ab « Arcachon » Effigies, per Litteras Apostolicas sub anulo Piscatoris Pii PP. IX, fel. rec., Decessoris Nostri, anno MDCCCLXX datas, aurea corona esset redimita'. 1870 is the year of the granting Litterae of Pius IX; the actual crowning ceremony date is not given. The image is a small alabaster statue of the BVM with the Infant Jesus found by the Franciscan Thomas Illyricus in the early 16th c. Vernacular form 'Notre-Dame d'Arcachon' rendered from the Latin 'Nostrae Dominae de Arcachon'. Act begins on printed page 714 (passage indexed at 715).

rubric_latin: AD EMUM P. D. EMMANUELEM TIT. SANCTORUM MARCELLINI ET PETRI S. R. E. PRESB. CARDINALEM GONÇALVES CEREJEIRA, PATRIARCHAM LISBONENSEM, QUEM LEGATUM DELIGIT AD CONGRESSUM MARIALEM E TOTA LUSITANIA, AUGUSTAE BRACARUM AD SANCTUARIUM « MONTE DO SAMEIRO » CELEBRANDUM.
incipit_latin: Iucundo admodum animo accepimus, proximo Iunio mense, Augustae Bracarum, in perillustri et prisca Lusitaniae septemtrionalis civitate, ad Sanctuarium celeberrimum « Monte do Sameiro »
image_title_latin: Deiparae Immaculatae simulacrum
church_or_sanctuary: Sanctuarium « Monte do Sameiro »
notes: Legate letter for the Portuguese national Marian Congress; the Legate (Card. Gonçalves Cerejeira) is deputed to preside at the Congress, NOT to crown, so this is a retrospective attestation only: 'praeclarumque Deiparae Immaculatae simulacrum ... Romae egregia arte confectum et a Pio Pp. IX ... sacro ritu lustratum, quinquaginta abhinc annos aurea corona ... est feliciter redimitum'. Coronation year 1904 is computed from 'quinquaginta abhinc annos' relative to the act date (1954); not stated verbatim. The statue was made in Rome and blessed by Pius IX. OCR of the rubric in the passage reads 'MONTE DO SAMURO' and 'CONCALVES CERKJEIRA'; corrected from the body text ('Monte do Sameiro') and standard spelling.

rubric_latin: ECCLESIA IN HONOREM B. MARIAE V. A VISITATIONE, IN OPPIDO WERLA INTRA FINES PADERBORNENSIS ARCHIDIOECESIS CONSECRATA, BASILICIS MINORIBUS ACCENSETUR.
incipit_latin: Quam omnes gentes ex eiusmet vaticinio ferunt laudibus, Virgini Mariae hospitae consecratum Templum, Werlae intra fines archidioecesis Paderbornensis situm
image_title_latin: Imago Beatae Mariae Virginis (olim « Sanctae Mariae ad pratum » Susatii)
church_or_sanctuary: Ecclesia B. Mariae V. a Visitatione (Basilica Minor), entrusted to the Franciscans
notes: Basilica Minor elevation; attests 'Iuvat quoque memorare egregium hoc Simulacrum anno MDCCCCXI, magna adstante populi multitudine, aureo diademate esse redimitum'. The 13th-c. carved image was formerly venerated at Soest ('Susatium', Aedes « Sanctae Mariae ad pratum ») and translated to Werl in 1661. Country Germany explicit from the mention of Konrad Adenauer, head of the West German government. Act begins on printed page 479 (verified against page markers).

rubric_latin: AD EMUM P. D. VALERIUM TIT. S. SILVESTRI IN CAPITE S. R. E. PRESB. CARDINALEM VALERI, PRAEFECTUM S. CONGREGATIONIS DE RELIGIOSIS, QUEM LEGATUM MITTIT AD CONVENTUM MARIALEM E TOTA CANADENSI REGIONE AD SANCTUARIUM B. MARIAE V. INDICTUM, « CAP-DE-LA-MADELEINE » NUNCUPATUM, IN TRIFLUVIANENSI DIOECESI.
incipit_latin: Permagnus profecto exstat amor in catholica Canadensium natione studiumque vehemens divinae religionis, quam maiores eorum primum et maxime ex Gallia, tum ex Hibernia, mox denique aliunde auspicato advecti sunt
image_title_latin: perinsigne Virginis simulacrum, Nostrae Dominae de Cap
church_or_sanctuary: Sanctuarium Nostrae Dominae de Cap, « Cap-de-la-Madeleine »
legate: Valerius Cardinalis Valeri, Praefectus S. Congregationis de Religiosis
notes: Explicit mandate: 'ut in sanctuario Nostrae Dominae de Cap, in Trifluvianensi dioecesi de Canada sito, perinsigne Virginis simulacrum nomine Nostro Nostraque auctoritate aurea corona exornes'. The crowning was to take place at the Canadian national Marian Congress in August 1954 ('proximo mense Augusto ... et simulacrum Mariae Virginis, quod in eo religiosissime colitur, sollemni ritu coronabitur' — OCR 'coronantur'). Vernacular form 'Notre-Dame du Cap' rendered from the Latin 'Nostrae Dominae de Cap'. This same letter also appears at the end of passage AAS-46-1954-ocr#479.

rubric_latin: AD EMUM P. D. ADEODATUM IOANNEM EPISCOPUM SABINEN. ET MANDELEN. S. R. E. CARDINALEM PIAZZA, SACRAE CONGREGATIONIS CONSISTORIALIS A SECRETIS, QUEM LEGATUM MITTIT AD CONVENTUM MARIALEM E TOTA BRASILIA IN URBE SANCTI PAULI INDICTUM.
incipit_latin: Quarto volvente saeculo a nobilissima Sancti Pauli in Brasilia civitate condita, consilium initum est pro collatis beneficiis sollemnes Deo reddendi gratiarum actiones
image_title_latin: augustum simulacrum Nostrae Dominae « da Conceiçâo Aparecida », Brasiliae Patronae
notes: Legate letter for the Brazilian national Marian Congress at São Paulo; the Legate (Card. Piazza) is deputed to preside at the Congress, not to crown, so this is a retrospective attestation: 'simulque quinquaginta implentur anni, ex quo augustum simulacrum aurea corona redimitum est Nostrae Dominae « da Conceiçâo Aparecida », Brasiliae Patronae'. Coronation year 1904 computed from 'quinquaginta implentur anni' relative to the act year 1954; not stated verbatim. The shrine's own locality/diocese is not named — only that the cult had its cradle in the Archdiocese of São Paulo. OCR 'Conceiçâo' for 'Conceição'.

rubric_latin: AD EMUM P. D. CAIETANUM TIT. SANCTAE CAECILIAE S. R. E. PRESB. CARDINALEM CICOGNANI, S. CONGREGATIONIS SACRORUM RITUUM PRAEFECTUM, AB INITO SACERDOTIO QUINQUAGESIMUM ANNUM IMPLENTEM.
incipit_latin: Celebranti feliciter tibi, quattuor abhinc annos, quinque ab inito episcopatu lustra, existimationem ac benevolentiam Nostram palam significavimus, praecipua tua erga Ecclesiam merita
image_title_latin: insigne Virginis simulacrum de Copacabana
church_or_sanctuary: sanctuary overlooking Lake Titicaca (« cuius sanctuarium lacui Incarum imminet »)
legate: Caietanus S. R. E. Cardinalis Cicognani (then Nuncio in Bolivia, acting as Legatus extraordinarius)
notes: Jubilee letter to Card. Gaetano Cicognani; the coronation is mentioned only retrospectively on printed p. 528: « In Bolivia autem, ubi Nuntius nominatus fuisti, dum saeculum celebrabatur, ex quo res publica in libertatem vindicata erat, Sanctae Sedis Legatum extraordinarium egisti et insigni Virginis simulacro de Copacabana ... auream coronam imposuisti ». The year is not stated; the act places it during the centenary of Bolivian independence (i.e. 1925) — left null rather than computed. Locality 'Copacabana' is taken from the image's title and the description of the lakeside sanctuary; vernacular title is a normalisation. Country is explicit ('In Bolivia').

rubric_latin: BEATA MARIA V. « A PRAESENTATIONE » URBIS ET ARCHIDIOECESIS NATALENSIS PRAECIPUA PATRONA CONFIRMATUR.
incipit_latin: Quae mortalibus, huius iactatis saeculi fluctibus, constituta est amplissimum praesidium, Beatam Mariam Virginem, ad Templum deductam, sacrorum administri et Christifideles
image_title_latin: simulacrum Beatae Mariae Virginis a Praesentatione
legate: Marcolinus de Souza Dantas, Archbishop of Natal (commissioned to impose the crown in the Pope's name)
notes: Patron-confirmation act that also grants the coronation: « ... confirmaremus simulque simulacrum Deiparae aureo sineremus diademate redimiri », and then « Natalensi Archiepiscopo, quem diximus, eas partes committimus ut, die per se ipsum statuendo, memoratae imagini ... auream coronam, Nostro nomine atque auctoritate, imponat ». The date of the crowning is left to the Archbishop, hence coronation_date null. The wooden image is said to have been found by fishermen about two hundred years earlier. Vernacular title is a rendering of 'a Praesentatione'; country inferred from the archdiocese of Natal — verify.

rubric_latin: AD VENERABILES FRATRES PATRIARCHAS, ARCHIEPISCOPOS, EPISCOPOS ALIOSQUE LOCORUM ORDINARIOS PACEM ET COMMUNIONEM CUM APOSTOLICA SEDE HABENTES: DE REGALI BEATAE MARIAE VIRGINIS DIGNITATE EIUSQUE FESTO INSTITUENDO.
incipit_latin: Ad Caeli Reginam, inde a primis Catholicae Ecclesiae saeculis, supplices preces ac laudis pietatisque cantus christianus populus adhibuit
image_title_latin: prodigialis Mariae Virginis imago, quae Fatimae colitur
notes: Encyclical 'Ad caeli Reginam'. The act opens on printed p. 625; the coronation clause falls on p. 627, so aas_page is the act's start page (which here also equals the passage's printed_page). Clause: '...radiophonicum nuntium, quem ad Lusitanorum populum transmisimus, cum prodigialis Mariae Virginis imago, quae Fatimae colitur, aureo diademate redimita fuit' (OCR renders 'colitur' as 'eolito'). Footnote 3 cites A.A.S. 38 (1946) p. 264 — the radio message accompanying the 1946 crowning at Fátima — but this passage states no date, so coronation_date is null. Country inferred from 'ad Lusitanorum populum' + 'Fatimae'; no diocese or sanctuary named.

rubric_latin: Summus Pontifex, die primo Novembris mensis a. MCMLIV in Basilica Vaticana, adstantibus Emis Patribus Cardinalibus atque plurimis Excmis PP. Sacrorum Antistitibus, coram christifidelium multitudine, antequam imaginem B. M. V., quae « Salus Populi Romani » appellatur, aurea corona redimiret, sollemniter proclamans novum festum liturgicum Beatae Mariae Virginis Caeli terraeque Reginae, haec verba fecit:
incipit_latin: Le testimonianze di omaggio e di devozione verso la Madre di Dio, che l'Universo cattolico ha moltiplicate nei mesi trascorsi
image_title_latin: imago B. M. V. quae « Salus Populi Romani » appellatur
notes: Pius XII crowned the icon 'Salus Populi Romani' with a golden crown himself, in the Vatican Basilica, on 1 November 1954, immediately after proclaiming the new feast of the BVM Queen of heaven and earth. The heading, printed as an editorial rubric in italics, is the source of all details; the body of the address is in Italian, so incipit_latin is in fact Italian. The passage does not say where the image is normally kept (S. Maria Maggiore), so church_or_sanctuary is left null. OCR 'MGMLIV'/'Etfhis' corrected to 'MCMLIV'/'Emis'. Filed under ALLOCUTIONES, item II.

rubric_latin: AD EMUM P. D. CLEMENTEM S. R. E. CARDINALEM MICARA, EPISCOPUM VELITERNUM EUNDEMQUE SUMMI PONTIFICIS IN URBE VICARIUM: OB FELICEM AC SALUTAREM EXITUM ANNI MARIALIS.
incipit_latin: Cum Marialis Annus proxime exeat, quem Encyclicis datis Litteris indiximus (« Fulgens Corona » ; A. A. S. 1953 pag. 577 sq.)
image_title_latin: prisca Deiparae Virginis imago, quae « salus populi Romani » dicitur
church_or_sanctuary: Basilica Liberiana (S. Mariae Maioris)
notes: Pius XII states he himself crowned the image: « cum priscam Deiparae Virginis imaginem, quae ‹salus populi Romani› dicitur ... Nobis licuit aurea redimire corona ». The coronation clause falls on printed page 709; the act (Epistula VII to Card. Micara) begins on printed page 708, which is cited here as aas_page. The church is not named in the coronation clause itself but the same letter twice names the Basilica Liberiana as the site of the Marian Year opening/closing.

rubric_latin: CHRISTIFIDELIBUS INSULARUM PHILIPPINARUM OB CONVENTUM MARIALEM IN MANILENSI URBE COADUNATIS.
incipit_latin: Venerables Hermanos y amados hijos que, en la ciudad de Manila, clausuráis el II Congreso Mariano Nacional de las Islas Filipinas
notes: Papal radio message to the Philippine national Marian congress: « esa preciosa corona, que ceñiréis a sus sienes en el mismo día centenario de la Definición dogmática » — i.e. 8 Dec 1954, the centenary of Ineffabilis Deus. OCR reads « Nuestra Señora de Oaysasay »; best reading is Caysasay. The message does not state that the coronation was granted by papal authority, so evidence_type is a passing attestation only. Coronation clause on printed page 721; the radio message begins on printed page 718, cited here as aas_page. Date is from the footnote « Datus die 5 Decembris mensis a. 1954 ».

rubric_latin: BEATA MARIA V., « DE PONTE » APPELLATA, PATRONA CAELESTIS AEQUE PRINCIPALIS CUM S. IUVENALE CIVITATIS AC DIOECESIS NARNIENSIS DECLARATUR.
incipit_latin: Viam vitae insistentes Christifideles tot inter pericula et acerbitates, recto haud labuntur itinere et ad locum petitum, sempiternam dicimus beatitatem, feliciter perveniunt
image_title_latin: Simulacrum Almae Deiparae de Ponte
church_or_sanctuary: Aedes ad viam Flaminiam iuxta veterem pontem Augusti (built in imitation of the Holy House of Loreto), served by the Salvatorians
notes: Patron declaration; attests 'Simulacrum Almae Deiparae de Ponte ... a Carolo Maria Cardinali Sacripante, anno millesimo septingentesimo quinquagesimo quarto, auctoritate Petriani Canonicorum Collegii, est aureo diademate inter acclamantis populi vota redimitum' — crowned in 1754 by Cardinal Carlo Maria Sacripante on the authority of the Vatican Chapter. A commemorative liturgical feast on 5 May was afterwards instituted with the approval of Pius IX. The image (BVM holding the Divine Child) was found in 1714. Vernacular form 'Madonna del Ponte' rendered from the Latin 'de Ponte'. Act begins on printed page 758 (passage indexed at 759).

rubric_latin: AD REVMUM P. MC CABE PATRITIUM, MISSIONALIUM A SS. CORDE IESU SUPREMUM MODERATOREM, OB VERTENS SAECULUM AB EADEM CONGREGATIONE CONDITA.
incipit_latin: Cum percepimus te sodalesque tuos in eo esse, ut fauste primum explendum saeculum, ex quo religiosum Institutum Missionalium a SS. Corde Iesu conditum fuit, celebraretis
image_title_latin: icon Deiparae Dominae a SS. Corde Iesu
church_or_sanctuary: urbana aedes sacra Deiparae Dominae a SS. Corde Iesu
notes: Clause: « ex augusto religionis ritu, quo in urbana aede sacra Deiparae Dominae a SS. Corde Iesu eiusdem iconi aureum imposituri estis sertum » — an imminent, not yet performed, crowning. « Urbana aedes » is taken as the Roman church of the Missionaries of the Sacred Heart (the letter says « cum Romae vos festum coetum agetis »); the church is not named outright, hence confidence medium. No papal grant of the coronation is stated in this letter.

rubric_latin: ECCLESIA PRINCIPALIS B. MARIAE V. A SACRATISSIMO ROSARIO, IN LOCO FATIMA LEIRIENSIS DIOECESIS POSITA, BASILICAE MINORIS TITULO HONORIBUSQUE DECORATUR.
incipit_latin: Luce superna caliginosum saeculum illustranti, Beatae Mariae Virgini sacra est augusta Aedes Fatimae, in Lusitanorum finibus, ubi eadem Deipara, e Rosarii nomine nuncupata, olim se dedit conspiciendam.
image_title_latin: Beata Maria Virgo a Sacratissimo Rosario (Imago Deiparae a Fatima)
church_or_sanctuary: Ecclesia principalis B. Mariae V. a Sacratissimo Rosario (Basilica of Our Lady of the Rosary)
notes: Basilica Minor elevation act; states in passing 'sive cum Imago Deiparae aureo diademate, Nostro nomine et auctoritate, anno scilicet MCMXLVI, redimiretur' - crowned 1946 in the Pope's name and by his authority; the crowning Legate is not named in the act. Country explicit ('in Lusitanorum finibus'). The act rubric and body begin on printed page 210.

rubric_latin: BEATA MARIA V. « DOMINA NOSTRA A GRATIIS IN FOLGARIA » PRAECIPUA CAELESTIS PATRONA ELIGITUR OMNIUM SOLEIS OBLONGIS PER NIVES PROLABENTIUM EX ITALIA, QUI « SCIATORI » VULGO APPELLANTUR.
incipit_latin: Quae « abiit in montana » (Cf. Luc. I, 39), castis visceribus portans Divinum Redemptorem, Beatae Mariae Virginis honori recte constituta sunt editis in iugis vel alpinis camporum spatiis domicilia religionis
image_title_latin: Domina Nostra a gratiis in Folgaria
church_or_sanctuary: Aedes B. Mariae Virgini opiferae sacra (church entrusted to the Friars Minor Capuchin)
legate: Angelus Iosephus S. R. E. Presb. Cardinalis Roncalli, Venetiarum Patriarcha
notes: Patron-declaration act; attests 'Mariano, qui proxime praeteriit, Anno; quo vertente Deiparae Imago eo in Templo exculta, auctoritate Petriani Canonicorum Collegii, per ... Cardinalem Roncalli, Venetiarum Patriarcham, aurea est diademate redimita.' Crowning was by authority of the Vatican Chapter (not a papal legation), executed by Card. Roncalli during the Marian Year that had just ended (Dec 1953 - Dec 1954); coronation year given as 1954 by inference from 'Anno Mariano qui proxime praeteriit' - verify exact date. Rubric OCR reads 'POLGARIA' (= Folgaria). Act begins on printed page 379.

rubric_latin: BEATA MARIA V. « A REMEDIO » TOTIUS ARCHIDIOECESIS ARBORENSIS PATRONA AEQUE PRINCIPALIS CUM S. ARCHELAO MARTYRE INSTITUITUR.
incipit_latin: Ex quo Beatissima Virgo Maria, a remedio vulgo appellata et Arboreae pie exculta, aurea fuit corona redimita, pietas erga eandem hanc Dei hominumque Matrem
image_title_latin: Beatissima Virgo Maria a Remedio
church_or_sanctuary: Deiparae Templum (Arboreae)
notes: Patronage act opens by recalling « aurea fuit corona redimita »; no year and no crowning authority stated. Sardinia is named in the act (« non solum e Sardinia insula sed e continente etiam terra »), so the country is secure; the exact locality of the sanctuary is not given.

rubric_latin: AD EMUM P. D. PAULUM AEMILIUM TIT. SANCTAE MARIAE ANGELORUM S. R. E. PRESB. CARDINALEM LÉGER, ARCHIEPISCOPUM MARIANOPOLITANUM QUEM LEGATUM DELIGIT AD CORONAM AUREAM IMPONENDAM SIMULACRO S. IOSEPH, SPONSI B. M. V.
incipit_latin: Praeterito quidem anno, praeclarum templum Sancto Ioseph dicatum, quod in nobilissima exstat sede Marianopolitana, tuis precibus libenter indulgentes, ad Basilicae Minoris honorem ac dignitatem evehere benigne decrevimus.
image_title_latin: Simulacrum Sancti Ioseph, Sponsi B. M. V.
church_or_sanctuary: Oratorium Sancti Ioseph (Saint Joseph's Oratory), templum sodalibus a Sancta Cruce concreditum
legate: Paulus Aemilius S. R. E. Presb. Cardinalis Léger, Archiepiscopus Marianopolitanus
notes: Papal letter deputing Card. Léger as Legate to impose the golden diadem 'Nostris veluti manibus'; occasioned by the 50th anniversary of the church's foundation. Coronation date not stated in the act. The same act is indexed at AAS 47 (1955) 600 in passages AAS-47-1955-ocr#874 and #906 (index entries, not separately recorded).

rubric_latin: TEMPLUM DEO IN HONOREM B. MARIAE V. IMMACULATAE GENEVAE CONSECRATUM HONORIBUS BASILICAE MINORIS INSIGNITUR.
incipit_latin: Nominis Catholici in urbe Geneva revigescentis signum perhibetur esse Templum, quod paulo post sollemniter pronunciatum dogma Immaculati Beatae Mariae Virginis Conceptus exstructum fuit
image_title_latin: statua Immaculatae Deiparae
church_or_sanctuary: Templum B. Mariae V. Immaculatae Genevae (Basilica Minor)
notes: Clause: « Quod Simulacrum ... anno millesimo nongentesimo trigesimo septimo, Episcoporum, Sacerdotum e prioribus, populi fidelis astante corona, auro diademate, Nostro nomine et auctoritate, fuit redimitum ». The statue is the one Pius IX kept in his apartment and donated to this church. « Nostro nomine et auctoritate » is written by Pius XII of a 1937 event (reigning pope then Pius XI): read as ‘in the name and by the authority of this Apostolic See’.

rubric_latin: AD TITULUM ET DIGNITATEM BASILICAE MINORIS EVEHITUR ECCLESIA B. MARIAE V. DE RUPE, SEU « DE LAS LAJAS » INTRA FINES DIOECESIS PASTOPOLITANAE.
incipit_latin: Templum perdecorum loci amoenitate atque structurae genere conspicuum, in quo Imago Beatae Virginis in saxo depicta, ideoque « de Rupe » appellata, pie excolitur
image_title_latin: Beata Maria Virgo de Rupe
church_or_sanctuary: Templum B. Mariae V. de Rupe (sanctuary of Las Lajas)
notes: Basilica Minor elevation; attests 'praeclara Eius Imago, anno millesimo nongentesimo quinquagesimo secundo ... auctoritate Petriani Canonicorum Collegii, aureo diademate fuit redimita' - crowned 1952 by authority of the Vatican Chapter. Country explicit ('Reipublicae Columbianae'). The act rubric and opening are on printed page 68 (per the volume index); passage page marker is 69.

rubric_latin: BEATA MARIA V. A SACRATISSIMO ROSARIO IN PRAECIPUAM CAELESTEM PATRONAM CIVITATIS ET DIOECESIS ROSARIENSIS, IN REPUBLICA ARGENTINA, ELIGITUR.
incipit_latin: Quae nobis rettulit Dilectus Filius Noster Antonius S. R. E. Presbyter Cardinalis Caggiano, Episcopus Rosariensis, in Republica Argentina, maximo Nos gaudio affecerunt.
image_title_latin: Beata Maria Virgo a Sacratissimo Rosario
church_or_sanctuary: prima paroecia / ecclesia paroecialis B. Mariae V. a Ssmo Rosario (the 1731 parish church of Rosario)
notes: Patron-declaration act; attests 'anno MCMXLI Ven. Canonicorum Collegium Patriarchalis Basilicae Nostrae S. Petri in Vaticano ... sacram Imaginem ... aureo gemmisque ornato diademate redimiendam decreverit' - i.e. the Vatican Chapter DECREED the crowning in 1941; the date of the crowning itself is not given, so coronation_date left null. The image venerated is the 1773 replacement of the older statue. Country explicit ('in Republica Argentina'). Act begins on printed page 119.

rubric_latin: TEMPLUM B. MARIAE V. DE MONTE, IN SUBURBIO BOMBAYENSIS URBIS EXSTANS, BASILICIS MINORIBUS ACCENSETUR, AC INSUPER BOMBAYENSI EMO ORDINARIO FACULTAS COMMITTITUR CORONANDI IMAGINEM B. MARIAE V. IN EODEM ASSERVATAM.
incipit_latin: Perfugium salutis et quasi propugnaculum Fidei perhibetur esse Templum Deiparae sacrum et in amoeno colle positum, unde Bombayam urbem et maris vastissimum aequor prospicias
image_title_latin: Imago Beatae Mariae Virginis de Monte
church_or_sanctuary: Templum B. Mariae V. de Monte (Basilica Minor)
legate: Valerianus Gracias, S. R. E. Cardinalis, Archiepiscopus Bombayensis
notes: Reached from the back-of-volume analytic index entry « Coronatio. Imaginis B. M. V. de Monte, in suburbio Bombayensi, 252 » (index page 897); the act itself was retrieved and is cited at its own printed page 252. Grant: « ... aureo diademate, Nostro nomine et auctoritate, redimiri sineremus », with execution committed to the Archbishop of Bombay: « Bombayensi Ordinario ... eas partes committimus ut die per se ipso deligendo, Imagini Beatae Mariae Virginis de Monte ... auream coronam, Nostro nomine et auctoritate, imponat ». The Archbishop is deputed as executor, not formally styled Legatus; date of crowning left to him.

rubric_latin: TEMPLUM B. MARIAE V., PLACENTINA IN URBE, « SANTA MARIA DI CAMPAGNA » APPELLATUM, BASILICAE MINORIS TITULO AC PRIVILEGIIS COHONESTATUR.
incipit_latin: Placentia, urbs ampla, non uno commendatur Templo artificiosis operibus nobili populique concursibus celebrato
image_title_latin: signum Beatae Mariae Virginis (in templo « Santa Maria di Campagna »)
church_or_sanctuary: Santa Maria di Campagna
legate: Franciscus S. R. E. Cardinalis Borgongini-Duca
notes: Basilica Minor elevation; attests the image was crowned 'anno millesimo sexcentesimo secundo, iterumque hoc vertente anno, aureo diademate a Purpurato Ecclesiae Patre Francisco Borgongini-Duca, quem nuper defunctum deflevimus, Nostro nomine et auctoritate'. Two crownings: 1602 (authority not specified) and a re-crowning in the current year, i.e. 1954, by Card. Borgongini-Duca in the Pope's name (he died 4 Aug 1954, so before that date). Act dated 3 Nov 1954 (Datum line taken from the full volume text, beyond the passage excerpt; confirmed by the volume index). Diocese name 'Placentina' supplied from 'Placentina in urbe'/'Piacentini Archiepiscopi-Episcopi Adiutor'; country Italy inferred - hence medium confidence.

rubric_latin: CHRISTIFIDELIBUS AEQUATORIS NATIONIS, OB SOLEMNEM CORONAE INDUCTIONEM SIMULACRO B. MARIAE VIRGINIS PERDOLENTIS, IN URBE QUITENSI COADUNATIS.
incipit_latin: Amadísimos hijos, — católicos ecuatorianos y, más en especial, católicos quiteños — que con suma devoción y entusiasmo colocáis hoy una corona sobre las sienes de vuestra « Dolorosa del Colegio »
image_title_latin: simulacrum B. Mariae Virginis Perdolentis
notes: Papal radio message delivered on the day of the crowning (« colocáis hoy una corona sobre las sienes »); footnote « Datus die 22 Aprilis mensis a. 1956 ». The rubric itself records the solemn imposition of the crown. Cross-listed in the volume's analytic index s.v. « Coronatio ... B. M. V. Perdolentis, in urbe Quitensi, 292 » (p. 897). The message does not name the church or state a papal grant.

rubric_latin: BEATA VIRGO MARIA « A BONO IESU », VULGO « MADONNA DEL BUON GESÙ » APPELLATA, UNA CUM S. IOANNE BAPTISTA, PRAECURSORE DOMINI ET MARTYRE, PATRONA CAELESTIS CIVITATIS ET DIOECESIS FABRIANENSIS CONSTITUITUR.
incipit_latin: Magno afficimur gaudio cum fere quotidie Nobis compertum sit vota, quae in indicendo Anno Mariano primo exeunte saeculo a definito dogmate Immaculatae Conceptionis
image_title_latin: Beatissima Virgo Maria a Bono Iesu
notes: Clause: « Capitulum Vaticanum ... aureis coronis tam Divini Infantis quam eius Sanctissimae Matris capita redimiri sua auctoritate decreverit : quod die VIII Septembris, anno MDCCCXCVIII feliciter factum est ». Both the Infant Jesus and the Virgin were crowned in the one rite. The image is a painting kept « in suo parvo sed ornatissimo sacello », not named. Coronation clause on printed page 366; the act begins on printed page 365, cited here as aas_page.

rubric_latin: BASILICAE MINORIS HONORIBUS AC PRIVILEGIIS CUMULATUR ECCLESIA PAROECIALIS ET COLLEGIALIS B. MARIAE V. IMMACULATAE IN OPPIDO « SEMINARA », MILETENSIS DIOECESIS.
incipit_latin: Quamquam labentibus annis multa cadunt in ruinas pietatis civilisque cultus monumenta, attamen constans est christiana traditio unaque fides.
image_title_latin: Mater Pauperum (Tabula Beatae Mariae Virginis ab Oriente translata)
church_or_sanctuary: Ecclesia paroecialis et collegialis B. Mariae V. Immaculatae
notes: Basilica Minor elevation; attests the ancient panel image 'ante quinquaginta annos auctoritate Petriani Canonicorum Collegii aureo diademate redimita' - crowned by authority of the Vatican Chapter about fifty years before the 1955 act, i.e. c. 1905; no explicit year given, so coronation_date left null. Country Italy inferred from 'Bruttiorum urbe' / Miletensis dioecesis; act begins on printed page 444.

rubric_latin: ECCLESIA B. MARIAE V. «DE GUADALUPE», INTRA FINES TOLETANAE ARCHIDIOECESIS EXSTANS, TITULO BASILICAE MINORIS EXORNATUR.
incipit_latin: Augusta Virgo Deipara, quam « de Guadalupe » vulgo appellant, religiosissima est, ut omnes norunt, apud Hispaniae gentes
image_title_latin: Beata Maria Virgo de Guadalupe
church_or_sanctuary: Templum B. Mariae Virginis de Guadalupe (Monasterium)
notes: Basilica Minor act stating in passing that the Apostolic See 'anno MDCCCCXXVIII eius Imaginem aureo diademate, augusto Ecclesiae ritu, siverit redimiri'. The coronation clause falls on printed p. 492; the act opens on printed p. 491, which is used as aas_page. This is the Spanish Guadalupe in Extremadura (archdiocese of Toledo), not the Mexican one.

rubric_latin: AD TITULUM ET DIGNITATEM BASILICAE MINORIS EVEHITUR ECCLESIA PAROECIALIS S. CRUCIS IN OPPIDO, VULGO « TORRE DEL GRECO » APPELLATO, EXSTANS, NEAPOLITANAE ARCHIDIOECESIS.
incipit_latin: Salutiferae Crucis nomine insigne Templum curiale oppidi, quod, intra fines archidioecesis Neapolitanae, ad radices Vesuvii montis « pampineis viridis umbris » positum, « Torre del Greco » vulgo dicitur, non modicis laudibus praedicatur.
image_title_latin: Imago Beatae Mariae Virginis primae labis expertis
church_or_sanctuary: Ecclesia paroecialis S. Crucis (Santa Croce)
notes: Basilica Minor elevation; attests 'Imaginem Beatae Mariae Virginis primae labis expertis, quae, auctoritate Petriani Canonicorum Collegii aureo diademate redimita, ibidem asservatur' - crowned by authority of the Vatican Chapter, no year given. Country Italy inferred (Vesuvius / Neapolitan archdiocese named); act begins on printed page 724.

rubric_latin: BEATA MARIA V. SUB NOMINE « NUESTRA SEÑORA DE LA MISERICORDIA » IN ECCLESIA PAROECIALI LOCI « CANET DE MAR » VENERATA, PATRONA CAELESTIS DECLARATUR UNIVERSAE REGIONIS, QUAE « COMARCA DEL MARESMA » APPELLATUR, INTRA FINES GERUNDENSIS DIOECESIS.
incipit_latin: Quae a Christianis « Mater Misericordiae » fidenti animo est appellata, numquam eorum fefellit spem, sed potius materni Cordis sui thesauros quam maxime ostendit.
image_title_latin: Beata Maria semper Virgo a Misericordia
church_or_sanctuary: Sanctuarium B. Mariae semper Virginis a Misericordia / ecclesia paroecialis loci « Canet de Mar »
notes: Patron-declaration act; attests 'aureo diademate, quod, sacrae Imagini anno MCMVII impositum, illius honori, eodem peracto bello, est reiectum' (crown imposed 1907, restored after the civil war), and mentions the 'quinquagesimi a peracta Marialis Iconis coronatione anniversarii' - the 1957 act marks the 50th anniversary of the coronation. Authority of the 1907 coronation is not stated in the act. Rubric OCR 'LICI' repaired to 'LOCI'; OCR 'Marialis leonis' read as 'Marialis Iconis'. Country explicit ('in Hispania').

rubric_latin: TITULO AC PRIVILEGIIS BASILICAE MINORIS DITATUR SANCTUARIUM B. MARIAE V. DE OROPA, INTRA FINES BUGELLENSIS DIOECESIS.
incipit_latin: Reginam ac Dominam montis Oropae totiusque continentis vallis in Pedemontana regione Deiparam Virginem Mariam ab omnibus haberi, nemo est qui ignoret
image_title_latin: Imago (Simulacrum) B. Mariae V. de Oropa
church_or_sanctuary: Sanctuarium B. Mariae V. de Oropa (prima sacra Aedes / Mariale Sacellum)
notes: Basilica Minor elevation; the coronation is attested only indirectly, through the papal grant recorded here: Pius IX on 11 July 1857 granted a proper Mass and Office 'in die anniversaria Coronationis Imaginis B. M. V. de Oropa'. The year and authority of the crowning itself are not stated - needs human check. Country Italy inferred from 'in Pedemontana regione'; act begins on printed page 951.

rubric_latin: B. MARIAE V. IN URBE SANCTAE FIDEI DE GUANAJUATO, INTRA DIOECESIS LEONENSIS FINES, BASILICAE MINORIS TITULO AC DIGNITATE AFFICITUR.
incipit_latin: Eximiis laudibus praedicatur Templum paroeciale, Almae Deiparae sacrum, quo urbi Mexicanae, quae Sancta Fides de Guanajuato appellatur, non modicum accrescit decoris atque ornamenti.
image_title_latin: Simulacrum Beatae Mariae Virginis primae labis nesciae
church_or_sanctuary: Ecclesia paroecialis B. Mariae Virginis (Templum dedicated 1671)
notes: Basilica Minor elevation; attests 'Sanctus Pius PP. X, Decessor Noster, imm. me., concessit ut Simulacrum aurea corona redimiretur' - a coronation granted by St Pius X (1903-1914), with no year given, in the same act by which he named the Virgin, together with St Ignatius Loyola, principal Patron of the city. Country explicit ('urbi Mexicanae'). Act begins on printed page 1002.

rubric_latin: BASILICAE MINORIS HONORIBUS AC PRIVILEGIIS DECORATUR ECCLESIA BEATAE MARIAE VIRGINI « A REMEDIO » DICATA, ARBORENSIS ARCHIDIOECESIS.
incipit_latin: Templa Dei, quae, magno pietatis studio circumfusa, amplitudinis non minus quam artis operibus ditata, singulari Christifidelium frequentia celebrantur
image_title_latin: Beata Maria Virgo « a remedio »
church_or_sanctuary: Ecclesia (Sanctuarium) Beatae Mariae Virginis « a remedio »
legate: Fridericus S. R. E. Cardinalis Tedeschini, Episcopus Tusculanus, Patriarchalis Basilicae Petrianae Archipresbyter
notes: Basilica Minor act mentions the crowning in passing: « Simulacrum, aurea corona, per Nosmet benedicta, a Venerabili Fratre Nostro Friderico S. R. E. Cardinali Tedescumi ... sollemniter redimitum ». Crown blessed by Pius XII himself, imposed by the Cardinal. OCR gives the surname as « Tedescumi » (= Tedeschini) and the act number as « n » (= II). Coronation date not stated; the act notes the image was declared principal Patron of the archdiocese in the Marian Year 1954. Sardinia named explicitly.

rubric_latin: BEATA MARIA VIRGO IMMACULATA, SUB TITULO « DE SAN JUAN DE LOS LAGOS » PRAECIPUA CAELESTIS PATRONA TOTIUS ARCHIDIOECESIS GUADALAIARENSIS, IN MEXICANA NATIONE, CONSTITUITUR.
incipit_latin: Ad peculiari studio conspiciendam Christifidelium maximam devotionem summumque amorem in Genitricem Dei Nos impellit flagrans religio
image_title_latin: Beata Maria Virgo Immaculata, sub titulo « de San Juan de los Lagos »
image_title_vernacular: Nuestra Señora de San Juan de los Lagos
church_or_sanctuary: Templum B. M. V. « de San Juan de los Lagos » (collegiate church, raised to Basilica Minor 1 May 1947)
notes: Patron-declaration act states in passing: « quos inter Sanctus Pius X pontificiam Iconi coronae impositionem benigne concessit. Simulacri caput tribus fuit redimitum coronis, quarum prima pluribus fulget adamantibus ». Year of the crowning not stated. aas_page = 302, where the act (rubric + incipit) begins; the batch passage is paginated 303. Text as printed says the collegiate title was obtained « anno MCCCCXXIII » from Pius XI — an obvious OCR/print error for 1923.

rubric_latin: BASILICAE MINORIS HONORIBUS AC PRIVILEGIIS AFFICITUR ECCLESIA PAROECIALIS B. M. V. IN CAELUM ASSUMPTAE IN OPPIDO V. « SANTA MARIA IN VICO », ACERRARUM DIOECESIS.
incipit_latin: Haud raro accidit ut sacrum quoddam Simulacrum, praesertim si vetustum, si ex oriente adductum, novae pietatis initium fiat atque religionis
image_title_latin: Beatae Mariae Virginis Simulacrum (B. M. V. in Caelum Assumpta)
church_or_sanctuary: Ecclesia paroecialis B. M. V. in Caelum Assumptae (sacellum with the wooden Byzantine-style 12th-cent. statue)
notes: « laudatum Mariale Simulacrum, aurea corona anno MCMXHI [MCMXIII] Sancti Pii Pp. X nomine et auctoritate sollemniter redimitum ». OCR of the year reads MCMXHI = MCMXIII (1913). Town spelled « Santa Maria in Vico » in the rubric, « Santa Maria a Vico » in the body.

rubric_latin: BASILICAE MINORIS HONORIBUS AC PRIVILEGIIS CUMULATUR CATHEDRALIS ECCLESIA VOLATERRANA, B. MARIAE V. IN CAELUM ASSUMPTAE CONSECRATA.
incipit_latin: Volaterrae, urbs Etruriae, cum rerum gestarum memoria obscuraeque antiquitatis vestigiis insignes sunt tum Templo principe, Deiparae sideribus receptae sacro, nobilitantur
image_title_latin: Simulacrum Beatae Mariae Virginis
church_or_sanctuary: Cathedralis Ecclesia Volaterrana (B. M. V. in Caelum Assumptae)
notes: Recorded inside a Basilica Minor act: « simulacrum Beatae Mariae Virginis ... quod Pius PP. IX ... aureo diademate redimivit », and again « ob revolutum saeculum ab Imagine illa Beatae Mariae Virginis per Pium PP. IX aurea corona honestata Volaterris indicta sunt ». Pius IX crowned it personally. Exact year not given; since the centenary celebrations were being announced in an act dated 30 Nov 1957, the crowning was c. 1857 — not stated in the text, so left null.

rubric_latin: BEATA MARIA VIRGO, VULGO APPELLATA « NUESTRA SEÑORA DE AGUA SANTA DE BAÑOS », PRAECIPUA PATRONA SACRARUM MISSIONUM AD ETHNICOS REGIONUM ORIENTALIUM REIPUBLICAE AEQUATORIANAE ELIGITUR EIUSQUE SIMULACRUM CORONA REDIMITUR.
incipit_latin: Salutari fonti Alma Deipara non perperam comparatur, quippe quae, submisse invocata, ex inexhausto misericordiae suae penu munera in mortales, aerumnis pressos, dilargiatur
image_title_latin: Beata Maria Virgo « Nuestra Señora de Agua Santa de Baños »
image_title_vernacular: Nuestra Señora de Agua Santa de Baños
church_or_sanctuary: Templum B. M. V. « Nuestra Señora de Agua Santa de Baños » (served by the Dominicans)
legate: Carolus Maria S. R. E. Cardinalis de la Torre, Archiepiscopus Quitensis (in person or through a bishop delegated by him)
notes: Grant of coronation: « eidem Purpurato Patri, Quitensi Archiepiscopo, eas partes committimus, ut Imagini ... auream coronam ipse vel per sacrorum Antistitem a se ad hoc delegatum, Nostro nomine et auctoritate imponat ». Act date and page confirmed by the volume's chronological index (incipit « Salutari fonti », 1957 Mart. 3, p. 464 — same batch, AAS-50-1958-ocr#1035). The diocese of the shrine is not named (only the Archbishop of Quito as petitioner/executor). The crowning was actually carried out on 13 Dec 1959 — see AAS 52 (1960) 52.

rubric_latin: ECCLESIA COLLEGIALIS « NOSTRAE DOMINAE DE OCOTLAN » APUD TLAXCALLENSEM CIVITATEM, INTRA ANGELORUM ARCHIDIOECESIS FINES IN MEXICO, TITULO BASILICAE MINORIS ORNATUR.
incipit_latin: Quo Christifidelium pietatem impensius exacueret et amplificaret, Romanus Pontifex excultoribus Templis magisque religiosis ac frequentioribus decus addere solebat
image_title_latin: Beata Maria Virgo « de Ocotlan »
church_or_sanctuary: Ecclesia collegialis B. M. V. « de Ocotlan »
notes: Only an indirect mention: « Quinquagesimi vero anni a Canonicorum Collegio constituto nec non a peracta ipsius Marialis Imaginis coronatione faustam nactus occasionem ». The act is dated 22 Nov 1957, so the crowning fell c. 1907, but no year, authority or minister is stated in the text. aas_page = 558, where the act begins (the batch passage is paginated 559); confirmed by the volume index.

rubric_latin: BEATA MARIA V., VULGO « DE LA ENCINA » APPELLATA, PRAECIPUA PATRONA CAELESTIS RENUNTIATUR OPPIDI « PONFERRADA » ET TOTIUS REGIONIS « EL BIERZO », IN ASTURICENSI DIOECESI.
incipit_latin: Haud aliter ac multae in Hispania regiones, illa quoque « El Bierzo » vulgo nuncupata atque intra Asturicensis dioecesis fines posita, suum celebre religioneque frequens Mariale possidet Sanctuarium
image_title_latin: Beata Maria Virgo « de la Encina »
church_or_sanctuary: Ecclesia paroecialis (Sanctuarium) B. M. V. « de la Encina »
notes: « Anno insuper MCMVIII, quo Marialis ipsa Imago aurea fuit redimita corona, idem Patrocinium supra totam Bergidensem regionem ab omnibus vel publice est renuntiatum »; the act was occasioned by the 50th anniversary of that solemn rite. Rubric prints « PONPERRADA » (OCR/print error for Ponferrada). Crowning authority/minister not named.

rubric_latin: BEATA MARIA V. SUB TITULO « AUXILIUM CHRISTIANORUM » IN INSULA S. GEORGII, VENETIARUM PATRIARCHATUS, VENERATA, EIUSDEM INSULAE PATRONA CAELESTIS PROCLAMATUR.
incipit_latin: Marianae pietatis ac disciplinae monasticae sedes pervetus et admodum insignis in Venetiarum insula exstare perhibetur, quae a Sancto Georgio nomen accepit
image_title_latin: Beata Maria Virgo « Auxilium Christianorum »
image_title_vernacular: Maria Ausiliatrice (Madonna del soccorso dei Cristiani)
church_or_sanctuary: Templum coenobii Sancti Georgii Maioris (San Giorgio Maggiore), O.S.B.
locality: Isola di San Giorgio Maggiore, Venice
notes: « ... atque, quod diximus, simulacrum anno MDCCCLXXXXIII aureo diademate sollemni ritu esse decoratum » = 1893. Crowning authority/minister not named. The statue was placed in the church on the 25th anniversary of Lepanto. Vernacular title is my rendering of the Latin « Auxilium Christianorum »; not given in the text.

rubric_latin: ECCLESIA SANCTISSIMAE TRINITATIS IN URBE ET ARCHIDIOECESI CRACOVIENSI TITULO BASILICAE MINORIS EXORNATUR.
incipit_latin: Sanctorum terra vere appellanda videtur Polonia, Petrianae Cathedrae addictissima atque contra ethnicos et Crucis inimicos firmissimum munimentum
image_title_latin: Antiqua Effigies Beatae Mariae Virginis a Rosario (Imagini Mariae sanctae Nivalis Romae asservatae similis)
church_or_sanctuary: Ecclesia Sanctissimae Trinitatis, Ordinis Fratrum Praedicatorum (Rosary chapel)
notes: « Decursu temporis ipsa Virginis Effigies pluries aurea fuit redimita corona: novissime autem, anno MCMXXI, astantibus Poloniae Primate nec non Archiepiscopis, Episcopis et Abbatibus fidelibusque prudentibus, bo. me. Adamus Stephanus Sapieha, tunc temporis Archiepiscopus Cracoviensis ac postea a Nobis inter Purpuratos Patres ascitus, eam pretioso diademate sollemni ritu coronavit. » Crowned more than once; the 1921 rite was performed by Abp (later Cardinal) Adam Stefan Sapieha. Papal authority is not expressly stated for the 1921 rite. Polish vernacular title supplied by me, not in the text.

rubric_latin: LEONENSIS. PAROECIALE TEMPLUM DOMINAE NOSTRAE DE GUANAJUATO, IN CIVITATE LEONENSI, AD GRADUM ET DIGNITATEM COLLEGIALIS AEDIS EVEHITUR.
incipit_latin: Cum venerabilis Frater Emmanuel Martin del Campo et Padilla, dioecesis Leonensis Episcopus, ab hac Apostolica Sede enixe poposcerit ut paroeciale templum Dominae Nostrae de Guanajuato
image_title_latin: Sacra Imago Dominae Nostrae de Guanajuato
church_or_sanctuary: templum Dominae Nostrae de Guanajuato (Basilica Minor, now Collegiata)
notes: The act assigns a choral feast « die uno et tricesimo mensis Maii, incidente die anniversario Coronationis Sacrae Imaginis Dominae Nostrae de Guanajuato », thus attesting the image was crowned on a 31 May; the year and the crowning authority are not stated. Country from « Apostolicum in Mexicana Ditione Delegatum » in the same act. Coronation clause on printed page 929; the constitution begins on printed page 928, cited here as aas_page.

rubric_latin: AD DIGNITATEM ET HONOREM BASILICAE MINORIS EVEHITUR ECCLESIA SANCTAE MARIAE A CRUCE DIOECESIS CREMENSIS.
incipit_latin: Sedes religionis Marialis praecipua dioecesis Cremensis perhibetur esse templum Sanctae Mariae a Cruce, multiplici sane laude commendatum
image_title_latin: Simulacrum Beatae Mariae Virginis (Sancta Maria a Cruce)
church_or_sanctuary: Templum Sanctae Mariae a Cruce
