notes: Generic retrospective mention: « Suis etiam muneribus Romani Pontifices hoc pietatis domicilium auxerunt, simulacrum Beatae Mariae Virginis aurea corona redimiri sinentes, peculiares illi tribuentes Indulgentias ... ». No date, pope or minister given. The text names only the diocese (« intra fines Cremensis dioecesis »), not the town, so locality left null; Italy is explicit (« publicis Italiae monumentis annumeraretur »). Vernacular title is the Italian form of the Latin dedication.

rubric_latin: PAROECIALIS ECCLESIA DEO IN HONOREM BEATAE MARIAE VIRGINIS IN CAELUM ASSUMPTAE CONSECRATA IN URBE « MORELLA », DERTOSENSIS DIOECESIS, BASILICAE MINORIS TITULO HONORIBUSQUE AUGETUR.
incipit_latin: Pietatis monumentum singularis opusque factum arte eximia templum esse perhibetur Augustae Deiparae sideribus receptae sacrum, quo urbs « Morella », intra fines posita Dertosensis dioecesis, insignitur
image_title_latin: Imago Deiparae quae vulgo a « Vallivana » appellatur
church_or_sanctuary: Ecclesia paroecialis B. M. V. in Caelum Assumptae, Morella (« Santa María la Mayor »)
notes: Only: « Eodem in templo piissime excolitur, praesertim statis temporibus, imago miraculis illustris ac diademate redimita Deiparae, quae vulgo a 'Vallivana' appellatur. » The text says the image is crowned but does NOT state papal authority, date or minister — needs human verification before being counted as a papal coronation. Spain is explicit (« in publicis monumentis nationis Hispanicae »).

rubric_latin: BASILICAE MINORIS HONORIBUS PRIVILEGIISQUE AFFICITUR ECCLESIA, QUAE VULGO « GESÙ VECCHIO » APPELLATUR, NEAPOLI EXSTANS.
incipit_latin: Parthenopen urbem praeclaram augusta Virgo, singulari ducta studio amoris, elegisse videtur, ubi non solum unum, sed plura constitueret domicilia pietatis
image_title_latin: Signum Beatae Mariae Virginis a prima labe immunis
church_or_sanctuary: Ecclesia Sanctissimi Nominis Iesu, vulgo « Gesù Vecchio »
notes: « Iuvat quoque memorare id anno MDCCCXXVI, auctoritate Vaticani Canonicorum Collegii, aurea corona esse redimitum » — crowned 1826 by authority of the Vatican Chapter. The act adds that Pius IX celebrated before the image at Naples on 9 Sept 1849. Statue set up for public veneration by Ven. Placido Baccher. aas_page = 34, where the act begins (batch passage paginated 35). This act also appears at the end of passage AAS-51-1959-ocr#33.

rubric_latin: BASILICAE MINORIS HONORIBUS AC PRIVILEGIIS AFFICITUR ECCLESIA BEATAE MARIAE VIRGINIS NEMORENSIS, SEU V. « MADONNA DEL BOSCO », IN OPPIDO « IMBERSAGO », MEDIOLANENSIS ARCHIDIOECESIS.
incipit_latin: Fortiter suaviterque ad ineundas religionis semitas immo et sacerdotii Divinam Misericordiam Nos a teneris annis impulisse, iuvat nunc grato animo meminisse
image_title_latin: Durateum Beatae Mariae Virginis Nemorensis simulacrum
church_or_sanctuary: Sanctuarium B. M. V. Nemorensis, « Madonna del Bosco »
notes: « quod Nosmet Ipsi, inter Patres Cardinales asciti ac Venetiarum Patriarcham agentes, anno MCMLIV, pro desideratissimo Hildefonso Alfredo S. R. E. Presbytero Cardinali Schuster, tunc Archiepiscopo Mediolanensi, graviter infirmo, aurea corona sollemni ritu coronavimus. » John XXIII crowned it himself, but in 1954, as Cardinal Patriarch of Venice, standing in for the ailing Card. Schuster — i.e. before his election, so classify with care.

rubric_latin: TITULUS AC PRIVILEGIA BASILICAE MINORIS CONFERUNTUR ECCLESIAE PAROECIALI BEATAE MARIAE VIRGINIS DE GAUDIO (« NOTRE DAME DE JOIE »), IN PAGO « PONTIVY » DIOECESIS VENETENSIS.
incipit_latin: Gaudii nuntia in hac lacrimarum valle ob vitae suae mysteria Beatissima Virgo Maria ab Ecclesia ac toto populo christiano semper habita est
image_title_latin: Pervetusta Beatae Mariae Virginis de Gaudio Icon
church_or_sanctuary: Ecclesia paroecialis B. M. V. de Gaudio (Notre-Dame de Joie)
notes: « ante pervetustam Beatae Mariae Virginis de Gaudio Iconem, auctoritate Decessoris Nostri Pii PP. XII, fel. rec., anno MCMLI, aurea redimitam corona ». Crowned 1951 by the authority of Pius XII; minister not named. Brittany/France explicit (« in Britannia Minori », « Gallici pagi »).

rubric_latin: BASILICAE MINORIS TITULO AC DIGNITATE DECORATUR ECCLESIA B. MARIAE V. « DEL QUINCHE » IN PAGO VULGO APPELLATO « DEL QUINCHE », ARCHIDIOECESIS QUITENSIS.
incipit_latin: Mariani cultus sedes eximia esse perhibetur templum, quod in pago « Del Quinche », uti appellant, intra Quitensis archidioecesis fines est positum
image_title_latin: Imago Beatae Mariae Virginis « Del Quinche »
church_or_sanctuary: Templum B. M. V. « Del Quinche » (Congregation of the Oblates of the Most Holy Hearts of Jesus and Mary)
notes: « praeclara imagine eiusdem Deiparae Virginis, quae, auctoritate Petriani Canonicorum Collegii, anno MDCCCCXXXIII aureo diademate est redimita » — crowned 1933 by authority of the Vatican Chapter. Act date and page confirmed by the volume's chronological index (incipit « Mariani cultus », 1959 Maii 2, p. 694 — same batch, AAS-51-1959-ocr#940).

rubric_latin: BEATA MARIA VIRGO VULGO APPELLATA « NUESTRA SEÑORA DE EL SOTO » IN PRAECIPUAM PATRONAM REGIONIS « DE TORANZO » ELIGITUR ET EIUSDEM IMAGO CORONA REDIMITUR.
incipit_latin: Potiora inter pietatis domicilia dioecesis Santanderiensis locum obtinet templum Beatae Mariae Virgini, Dominae Nostrae a nemore, sacrum
image_title_latin: Beata Maria Virgo a nemore, seu « Nuestra Señora de El Soto »
church_or_sanctuary: Templum (cum coenobio) B. M. V. « Nuestra Señora de El Soto », Carmelitis Discalceatis creditum
legate: Iosephus Eguino Trecu, Episcopus Santanderiensis (Santanderiensis Ordinarius)
notes: Coronation grant: « Santanderiensi Ordinario ... eas partes committimus, ut die suo arbitrio deligendo, post Missarum sollemnia, iuxta ritum formulamque praescriptam, imagini eiusdem Deiparae Virginis ... auream coronam, Nostro nomine et auctoritate imponat. » Date of the coronation itself left to the Ordinary, so not stated. Rubric prints the vernacular title twice inconsistently (« de El Soto » / « del El Soto »). Act date and page confirmed by the volume index (incipit « Potiora inter », 1959 Maii 23, p. 805 — same batch, AAS-51-1959-ocr#940).

rubric_latin: CHRISTIFIDELIBUS AEQUATORIANAE REIPUBLICAE, B. MARIA VIRG. A ROSARIO V. « DE AGUA SANTA DE BAÑOS » CORONA REDIMITA ET MISSIONUM IN ORIENTALI AEQUATORIANI TERRITORII PLAGA REGINA RENUNTIATA.
incipit_latin: Como el niño al regazo de su madre, así habéis acudido, amadísimos fieles del Ecuador, a las plantas de Nuestra Señora del Rosario de Agua Santa de Baños
image_title_latin: Beata Maria Virgo a Rosario, vulgo « de Agua Santa de Baños »
image_title_vernacular: Nuestra Señora del Rosario de Agua Santa de Baños
church_or_sanctuary: Santuario de Agua Santa (entrusted to the Dominicans)
legate: unnamed « Cardenal Legado » (« Nuestro amadísimo Cardenal Legado »)
notes: Papal radio message delivered on the day of the crowning itself (footnote « Die 13 Decembris mensis a. 1959 »; listed in the volume index under NUNTII RADIOPHONICI, 1959 Dec. 13, p. 52). Text in Spanish: « habéis subido hoy a su trono para poner en las sienes de María Santísima una corona real ». Executes the grant of Pius XII, Litt. Ap. « Salutari fonti » of 3 March 1957, AAS 50 (1958) 464. The Cardinal Legate is not named in the message; the 1957 grant had committed the crowning to Card. Carlos María de la Torre, Abp of Quito. OCR of the incipit reads « al ragazo » for « al regazo » — silently repaired.

rubric_latin: BASILICAE MINORIS HONORIBUS PRIVILEGIISQUE DECORATUR ECCLESIA B. MARIAE V. PERDOLENTIS, VULGO « NUESTRA SEÑORA DE LA SOLEDAD » APPELLATAE, IN URBE ET ARCHIDIOECESI ANTEQUERENSI EXSTANS.
incipit_latin: Religionis domicilium praeclarum esse perhibetur templum Beatae Mariae Virgini « a Solitudine », quae dicitur, sacrum in urbe et archidioecesi Antequerensi
image_title_latin: imago Almae Deiparae a Solitudine
church_or_sanctuary: templum B. Mariae V. Perdolentis (Basilica Minor)
notes: Clause: « Sanctus Pius PP. X, Decessor Noster imm. mem., concessit, ut idem simulacrum suo nomine et auctoritate aurea redimiretur corona; quod sollemne die xviii mensis Ianuarii, anno MDCCCCIX, inter plaudentis populi vota, sacrorum Antistitum e Mexicana dicione astante coetu, peractum est ».

rubric_latin: BEATA MARIA V., « DE LA CABEZA » VULGO APPELLATA, PRAECIPUA APUD DEUM PATRONA UNA CUM S. EUPHRASIO, EP. ET CONF., UNIVERSAE DIOECESIS GIENNENSIS CONSTITUITUR.
incipit_latin: Studium et cultus Beatae Mariae Virginis, quae « de la Cabeza » Hispanico appellatur sermone, a multo iam tempore animos tenent Illiturgitanorum
image_title_latin: Beata Maria Virgo « de la Cabeza »
church_or_sanctuary: montanum sacrarium on the mount called « la Cabeza »
notes: Patron declaration that recalls in passing that the Chapter of St Peter's ('Petrianae Basilicae Canonicorum Collegium'), at the request of Bishop Juan Manuel Laguarda Fenollera and in the time of St Pius X, granted 'ut ... Mariale simulacrum aurea corona redimiretur'; no coronation year given. The image, found in 1227 ('anno MCCXXVII') on the mountain, lost its diadem in the Spanish Civil War and a more precious crown was prepared to replace it. Act begins on printed page 383 (passage page-marker is 384). Datum reads 'die XXVII mensis Novembris, anno MDCCCCLVHII' — read as MDCCCCLVIIII = 1959, confirmed by 'Pontificatus Nostri secundo'. Locality Illiturgis = Andújar (identification supplied).

rubric_latin: CATHEDRALIS ECCLESIA PREMISLIENSIS LATINORUM BASILICAE MINORIS TITULO HONORIBUSQUE AUGETUR.
incipit_latin: Romanorum Pontificum beneficio solet templis, quae religione, structurae genere, artificiosis operibus valde commendantur, peculiaris honor adiungi.
image_title_latin: signum Dei Genetricis (Beata Maria Virgo, Regina Poloniae)
church_or_sanctuary: cathedralis ecclesia Premisliensis Latinorum, S. Ioanni Baptistae ac B. Mariae Virgini Reginae Poloniae sacra
notes: Basilica Minor elevation stating 'signum Dei Genetricis, aureo diademate anno MDCCLXVI ornatum'. Crowning authority not named. Country Poland inferred from the see name Premisliensis Latinorum (Przemyśl) and the title 'Regina Poloniae'.

rubric_latin: BASILICAE MINORIS TITULO EXORNATUR CATHEDRALIS ECCLESIA VALENTINA IN VENEZUELA.
incipit_latin: Urbi Valentiae in Venetiolae finibus, non modicum perhibetur decus accrescere principe templo, Opiferae Matri caelesti dicato, quippe quod antiquitate sit religiosum
image_title_latin: imago Beatae Mariae Virginis de Succursu
church_or_sanctuary: cathedralis ecclesia Valentina
notes: Basilica Minor elevation stating 'quae anno MCMX, auctoritate Sancti Pii PP. X, Decessoris Nostri, aureo diademate est redimita'. Act begins on printed page 885 (passage page-marker is 886). Vernacular title 'Nuestra Señora del Socorro' supplied as the standard rendering of 'de Succursu'.

rubric_latin: Beata Maria Virgo de Monte Carmelo praecipua Patrona dioecesis Papantlensis eligitur.
incipit_latin: Peculiari studio pietatis excoli perhibetur a Christifidelibus dioecesis Papantlensis Beata Maria Virgo de Monte Carmelo, cuius praeclara imago, in ipsa episcopali sede proposita
image_title_latin: Beata Maria Virgo de Monte Carmelo
church_or_sanctuary: the episcopal see church of Papantla ('in ipsa episcopali sede proposita')
notes: Patron declaration stating 'Quod simulacrum ... anno MDCCCCXXXXVIII, auctoritate Pii PP. XII, Decessoris Nostri imm. mem., aureo diademate fuit redimitum' (MDCCCCXXXXVIII = 1948). Country Mexico inferred from the see name Papantlensis; not stated in the passage. Vernacular title supplied as the usual rendering of 'de Monte Carmelo'.

rubric_latin: In Basilica Liberiana habita christifidelibus Urbis, in festo Immaculatae Conceptionis Beatae Mariae Virginis.
image_title_vernacular: L'Immacolata Concezione (mosaic in the Cappella del Coro)
church_or_sanctuary: Basilica of St Peter in the Vatican, Cappella del Coro (on the site of Sixtus IV's chapel of the Immaculate Conception)
notes: John XXIII recalls that Pius IX himself crowned this mosaic image ('il Pontefice Pio IX, con incomparabile solennità, incoronò l'8 dicembre 1869') at the opening of Vatican Council I, and that Pius X renewed the act with a richer crown on 8 December 1904, which the future John XXIII witnessed as a young priest. Act is an allocution delivered in the Liberian Basilica (St Mary Major) on 8 Dec 1960 but the crowned image described is the St Peter's Cappella del Coro mosaic. Act begins on printed page 30; attestation on p. 34. Body in Italian, no Latin incipit.

rubric_latin: Titulus ac privilegia Basilicae Minoris ecclesiae cathedrali Caesenatensi conferuntur.
incipit_latin: Merito praedicatur templum princeps Caesenas, quod saeculo xiv Romanico, uti appellant, architectandi genere exstructum, amplitudine molis commendatur et cultu multiplici.
image_title_latin: imago Beatae Mariae Virginis, eodem in templo exculta
church_or_sanctuary: cathedralis ecclesia Caesenatensis
notes: Basilica Minor elevation stating that Pius VI, on his return from Vienna, personally crowned the image: 'quorum priorem, Vindobona reducem, imaginem Beatae Mariae Virginis, eodem in templo excultam, aureo diademate redimivisse'. No year given (Pius VI's return from Vienna was 1782, not stated in the text). This is therefore a retrospective attestation of a personal papal coronation. Country Italy inferred from Caesena/Cesena; not stated.

rubric_latin: Beata Maria Virgo « Afrorum Domina » praecipua Patrona totius archidioecesis Algeriensis declaratur.
incipit_latin: Praefervidum erga intaminatam Dei Genetricem amorem etiam in repositis terris inter omnes constat vigere. Iam inde antiquitus in regione Algeriensi
image_title_latin: statua Beatae Mariae Virginis, « Afrorum Domina »
church_or_sanctuary: the basilica of Notre-Dame d'Afrique (sanctuarium Mariale Icosii, raised to Basilica Minor by Pius IX in 1876)
notes: Patron declaration stating 'Anno MDCCCLXXVI Decessor Noster ven. mem. Pius Pp. IX ecclesiam ... ad Basilicae Minoris honorem et dignitatem evexit, et statuam Beatae Mariae Virginis aurea corona, suo nomine et auctoritate, redimiri iussit'. OCR renders the year as 'm d c c c l x x v ï' = MDCCCLXXVI (1876). The bronze statue was given by the Children of Mary of Lyons and blessed by the first bishop of Algiers in 1840 ('anno MDCCCXXXX'). Pius XII/John XXIII text also records that John XXIII himself visited the shrine on 19 March 1950.

rubric_latin: Beata Maria Virgo, vulgo « de Izamal » appellata, praecipua caelestis Patrona archidioecesis Yucatanensis declaratur.
incipit_latin: Luce collustrans superna saeculum caliginosum, Beata Maria Virgo, Dei Parens augusta, gloria generis humani, utpote primae et alius cuiusvis labis immunis
image_title_latin: Imago Beatae Mariae Virginis de Izamal
notes: Clause: « Idcirco Pius Pp. XII, Decessor Noster fel. rec., concessit, ut praeclara eius Imago sua auctoritate, anno MCMXLIX, redimiretur diademate aureo ». Country confirmed within the act (« in tota dicione Mexicana », Apostolic Delegate in Mexico).

rubric_latin: Basilicae Minoris honoribus decoratur ecclesia Beatae Mariae Virginis a Gratiis Brixiae consecrata.
incipit_latin: Meritis celebratur praeconiis Brixianum templum Beatae Mariae Virginis a Gratiis, quod antiquitate, mole, structurae genere artificiosisque operibus est admodum insigne
image_title_latin: Imago Almae Deiparae, Beata Maria Virgo a Gratiis
church_or_sanctuary: ecclesia Beatae Mariae Virginis a Gratiis (Santa Maria delle Grazie)
notes: Basilica Minor elevation stating 'Hoc Simulacrum, aureo diademate anno MDCCCLXXXVI auctoritate Petriani Canonicorum Collegii redimitum'. Country Italy inferred from Brixia/Brescia and 'Insubris regionis'; not stated. Vernacular title supplied as the usual rendering of 'a Gratiis'.

rubric_latin: Beata Maria Virgo a Gratiis, vulgo « Madonna delle Grazie » nuncupata, una cum S. Aemygdio, urbis ac dioecesis Asculanae in Piceno praecipua Patrona renuntiatur.
incipit_latin: Ex quo, anno scilicet proxime praeterito, praeclara Imago Beatae Mariae Virginis a Gratiis, quae in sacrario apud Basilicam cathedralem Asculanam in Piceno asservatur
image_title_latin: Beata Maria Virgo a Gratiis
church_or_sanctuary: sacrarium apud Basilicam cathedralem Asculanam in Piceno
notes: Patron declaration opening 'Ex quo, anno scilicet proxime praeterito, praeclara Imago ... auctoritate Petriani Canonicorum Collegii, aureo diademate fuit redimita'. Coronation year 1960 derived from 'anno proxime praeterito' relative to the act date. The Datum line is OCR'd 'die XXVIII mensis Aprilis, anno m c m x x i' — MCMXXI is an OCR corruption of MCMLXI (1961), confirmed by 'Pontificatus Nostri tertio' and the volume year. Country Italy inferred from Asculum in Piceno; not stated.

rubric_latin: Ecclesia Beatae Mariae V. de Guadalupe, loci « La Ceiba de Guadalupe », in archidioecesi et urbe S. Salvatoris in America, privilegiis Basilicae Minoris honestatur.
incipit_latin: Guadalupana Virgo praeclaram habet sedem constitutam in Sancti Salvatoris in America archidioecesi, ecclesiam dicimus loci, vulgari sermone « La Ceiba de Guadalupe » vocitati.
image_title_latin: imago Beatae Mariae Virginis de Guadalupe
church_or_sanctuary: ecclesia seu sacrarium Beatae Mariae Virginis de Guadalupe, « La Ceiba de Guadalupe »
locality: La Ceiba de Guadalupe, San Salvador
notes: Basilica Minor elevation stating 'anno MCMLIII Petriani Canonicorum Collegii concessu et auctoritate aureo diademate redimita'. Act begins on printed page 87 (passage page-marker is 88). Shrine served by the Clerics Regular of Somascha.

rubric_latin: Titulo ac privilegiis Basilicae Minoris Sanctuarium B. Mariae Virg. ab Elevatione, dioecesis Ambatensis, exornatur.
incipit_latin: Fide invicta administri sacrorum populusque regionis, quae Ambatensi nunc dioecesi continetur, sacrarium Beatae Mariae Virgini ab Elevatione dicatum aedificarunt
image_title_latin: Imago Almae Deiparae ab Elevatione
church_or_sanctuary: Sanctuarium Beatae Mariae Virginis ab Elevatione
notes: Basilica Minor elevation stating that the image, after the Virgin was made patroness of the diocese by Pius XII in 1952 ('anno MCMLII'), was crowned 'auctoritate Petriani Canonicorum Collegii, duobus annis post' — i.e. 1954. The Datum line is OCR'd 'die xxvim mensis Aprilis, anno MCMLXI'; the day is illegible (most likely XXVIII = 28 April 1961), so act_date left null. Country Ecuador explicit ('Apostolici in Aequatoriana Republica Nuntii'; Archbishop of Quito). Previous church collapsed in the 1949 earthquake ('anno MCMXLIX').

rubric_latin: Titulo ac privilegiis Basilicae Minoris ecclesia dicata Beatae Mariae Virgini, Omnium Gratiarum Conciliatrici, Sultanae Africae, in oppido « Lodonga », Aruaensis dioecesis, condecoratur.
incipit_latin: Beatissimam Virginem Mariam cunctas haereses interemisse in universo mundo iure meritoque canit Ecclesia: quod quidem iis omnibus qui ad Regnum Christi in dissitas regiones dilatandum forti animo decertant
image_title_latin: ligneum Mariale simulacrum, Beata Maria Virgo Omnium Gratiarum Conciliatrix, « Sultana » seu « Domina Africae »
image_title_vernacular: Our Lady Queen of Africa, Lodonga
church_or_sanctuary: ecclesia oppidi « Lodonga », consecrated 1954 and dedicated to B.M.V. Omnium Gratiarum Conciliatrix
notes: Basilica Minor elevation stating 'cuius simulacrum aurea corona, a Pio Pp. XII, fel. rec., proximo Decessore Nostro, pie lustrata, fuit redimitum' — the golden crown was blessed by Pius XII; the year of the crowning is not given (the church was consecrated 'anno MCMLIV'). Church served by the Comboni Missionaries ('Congregatio Filiorum S. Cordis Iesu'). Vernacular title is a rendering of 'Sultana seu Domina Africae'; verify local usage.

rubric_latin: Beata Maria Virgo, vulgo « dei Rocciamelone » nuncupata, una cum Sancto Iusto Martyre, aeque principalis totius Segusiensis dioecesis caelestis Patrona eligitur.
incipit_latin: In Alpium Cottiarum concava valle, impendentibus undique montibus, urbs exstat Segusium, cui multae frequentesque negotiationes
image_title_latin: Beata Maria Virgo dei Rocciamelone
church_or_sanctuary: sacellum in vertice montis Rocciamelone
notes: Clause: « Quae verba laetum omen ac signum iudicamus aurei diadematis quo, Apostolicae Sedis auctoritate, Coeli Regina est redimita ». No year given; the context is the bronze statue set up on the summit of Rocciamelone at the end of the 19th century. Coronation clause on printed page 427; the act begins on printed page 426, cited here as aas_page.

rubric_latin: Beata Maria Virgo « a Miraculis » praecipua caelestis Patrona oppidi v. « Morbio Inferiore », Luganensis dioecesis, declaratur.
incipit_latin: Deiparam Virginem Mariam maternum auxilium suis fidelibus saepenumero ostendisse, omnibus constat.
image_title_latin: Beata Maria Virgo « a Miraculis »
church_or_sanctuary: Marialis aedicula adjoining the parish church of Morbio Inferiore (ancient fresco, 'vetustam Beatae Mariae Virginis udo illitam effigiem')
notes: Patronage act; the coronation is mentioned in passing: the faithful had a golden crown made 'quae postea amplissimi Petriani Canonicorum Collegii Decreto, anno MCMXXVII, Mariae Virginis capiti fuit sollemniter imposita' — i.e. crowned by decree of the Vatican Chapter in 1927. The coronation clause falls on printed page 771; the act opens on page 770, which is cited here as aas_page. Country (Switzerland) inferred from the diocese of Lugano; not stated in the text. Vernacular title not given in the passage.

rubric_latin: E.mo P. D. Ioanni Baptistae S. R. E. Cardinali Montini, Archiepiscopo Mediolanensi, qui in oppido v. « Imbersago » interfuit sollemnibus, quibus statua aenea Ioanni Pp. XXIII posita est in sacra Aede B. Mariae Virg. v. « Madonna del Bosco » appellatae.
incipit_latin: Con soave pensiero l'animo si volge al Santuario della Madonna del Bosco, che soffuse su la Nostra infanzia un ineffabile sorriso di cielo
church_or_sanctuary: Santuario della Madonna del Bosco
notes: Letter in Italian to Card. Montini. John XXIII recalls: 'il 29 agosto 1954, con la cerimonia della solenne incoronazione della sacra effigie, ivi venerata, che Ci fu dato di compiere in nome e per procura del Cardinale Arcivescovo Schuster'. IMPORTANT for a checker: the writer (then Patriarch of Venice, not yet Pope) performed the crowning as proxy for Cardinal Schuster, Archbishop of Milan; the text does NOT state papal or Vatican Chapter authority for the coronation, so 'papal_personal_coronation' is used only in the literal sense that the reigning Pope personally performed it. Rubric OCR reads « Imfoersago » — repaired to « Imbersago ». Diocese (Milan) inferred from the addressee and from Card. Schuster; country inferred from Brianza/Lombardy. The letter opens on printed page 850; the coronation clause falls on page 851.

rubric_latin: E.mo P. D. Ioanni Baptistae S. R. E. Cardinali Montini, Archiepiscopo Mediolanensi, qui in oppido v. « Imbersago » interfuit sollemnibus, quibus statua aenea Ioanni Pp. XXIII posita est in sacra Aede B. Mariae Virg. v. « Madonna del Bosco » appellatae.
image_title_latin: B. Mariae Virg. v. « Madonna del Bosco » appellatae
church_or_sanctuary: Santuario della Madonna del Bosco
notes: The Pope recalls 'la cerimonia della solenne incoronazione della sacra effigie, ivi venerata, che Ci fu dato di compiere in nome e per procura del Cardinale Arcivescovo Schuster' on 29 August 1954 — i.e. the crowning was performed by Angelo Roncalli (then Patriarch of Venice, not yet Pope) as proxy for Cardinal Ildefonso Schuster, Archbishop of Milan, the day before Schuster's death. Hence retrospective_attestation, not papal_personal_coronation. OCR of the rubric reads 'Imfoersago'; read as 'Imbersago'. Act begins on printed page 850; passage page 851. Body in Italian, no Latin incipit.

rubric_latin: Beata Maria Virgo « a Quercu » principalis caelestis Patrona declaratur convallis « Nure » vulgo appellatae, intra fines Placentinae dioecesis.
incipit_latin: Amicum sidus in huius saeculi fluctibus exasperato mari omnibus lucet, augusta videlicet Maria: hanc si mortales intuentur, a recto cursu nequaquam aberrant
image_title_latin: Beata Maria Virgo a Quercu
church_or_sanctuary: sanctuary of the Madonna della Quercia in the town of Bettola (Val Nure)
notes: Patron declaration stating 'Petrianum vero Canonicorum Collegium die XX mensis Februarii anno MCMXX indulsit, ut eiusdem Caelestis Virginis imago ibidem asservata aureo diademate sollemni ritu redimiretur'. 1920-02-20 is the date of the Vatican Chapter's indult, not necessarily of the ceremony, so only the year is recorded here. Country Italy inferred from the diocese of Piacenza / Val Nure; not stated. Vernacular title supplied as the usual rendering of 'a Quercu'.

rubric_latin: Titulus ac privilegia Basilicae Minoris paroeciali ecclesiae Beatae Mariae Virginis a Mercede, in urbe Guayaquilensi, conferuntur.
incipit_latin: Guayaquilensis incolae urbis, quae portus praecipuus est Aequatorianae Dicionis, ad templum Beatae Mariae Virginis de Mercede veluti ad portum salutis ac perfugium animarum solent confluere
image_title_latin: imago Dei Genetricis Mercedoniae
church_or_sanctuary: ecclesia paroecialis Beatae Mariae Virginis a Mercede
notes: Basilica Minor elevation stating 'Pius Pp. XII, Decessor Noster rec. mem., eandem imaginem sua auctoritate aureo diademate redimiri, datis Apostolicis sub anulo Piscatoris Litteris die VIII mensis Septembris anno MCMXLVII, concessit'. The date 1947-09-08 is that of the Apostolic Letters granting the coronation, not necessarily of the ceremony. Act begins on printed page 87 (passage page-marker is 88). Church served by the Mercedarians.

rubric_latin: Ecclesia paroecialis urbis v. d. « Piekary » ad dignitatem Basilicae Minoris evehitur.
incipit_latin: Augustissimis Poloniae templis iure meritoque videtur esse accensenda ecclesia paroecialis, quae in urbe v. Piekary, intra Silesiae fines, exsurgit
image_title_latin: mirifica Beatissimae Mariae Virginis imago
church_or_sanctuary: ecclesia paroecialis urbis Piekary (built 1846)
notes: Basilica Minor elevation stating 'Nostra demum aetate, Pii Pp. XI permissu ... imago, quam diximus, aureo diademate est redimita'. No year given; only that it was by permission of Pius XI (1922-1939). The act also recalls King John Sobieski praying before the image on his way to Vienna.

rubric_latin: Titulo ac privilegiis Basilicae Minoris honestatur paroecialis ecclesia B. Mariae Virg. a Nazareth in urbe v. « Sestri Levante » appellata, dioecesis Clavarensis.
incipit_latin: Communi consensu celebratur urbs Segesta Tigulliorum, quam, « Sestri Levante » vulgo nuncupatam et amoeno in litore positam, Ligustinum alluit mare
image_title_latin: imago Christi Cruci affixi
church_or_sanctuary: paroecialis ecclesia Beatae Mariae Virginis a Nazareth
notes: Basilica Minor elevation stating 'Leo Pp. XIII, Decessor Noster, inditam eam effigiem, anno MCMIII, per Legatum aurea corona ritu sollemni redimivit' (OCR 'inditam' = 'inclitam'). The crowned image is a crucifix, not a Marian image; the Legate is not named. Act begins on printed page 320 (passage page-marker is 321). Country Italy inferred from Sestri Levante / Chiavari; not stated.

rubric_latin: Titulus ac privilegia Basilicae Minoris Sanctuario B. Mariae Virg. « de Lluch », in Maioricensis dioecesis finibus, conferuntur.
incipit_latin: Gloria et praesidium Balearum Insularum merito praedicatur Beata Maria Virgo « de Lluch », cuius venusta imago in Maioricensi templo, saeculo XIII eius honori exstructo, perpetuis impensisque obsequiis colitur.
image_title_latin: Beata Maria Virgo « de Lluch »
church_or_sanctuary: Sanctuarium (Collegium Sanctae Mariae) Beatae Mariae Virginis « de Lluch »
notes: Basilica Minor act; the coronation is mentioned in passing: 'Leo Pp. XIII, qui inditam imaginem illam per Legatum aureo diademate redimivit' (OCR 'redimi vit'; 'inditam' probably for 'inclitam'). No coronation year and no Legate name given; Leo XIII reigned 1878-1903. Locality 'Lluc' taken from the sanctuary's own epithet; country inferred from 'Balearum Insularum' / dioecesis Maioricensis, not stated in the act. Vernacular form of the title not given beyond « de Lluch ».

rubric_latin: Titulus ac privilegia Basilicae Minoris cathedrali ecclesiae Materanensi tribuuntur.
incipit_latin: Mateola, antiqua regum sedes, urbs rerum gestarum memoria illustris, praeclarior vero religione, quam priscis acceptam temporibus per hominum aetates impigre coluit, egregium pietatis domicilium merito praedicatur
image_title_latin: imago Beatae Mariae Virginis, cui olim appellatio « a Matera » vel « ab episcopio » adiciebatur
church_or_sanctuary: Cathedralis (metropolitana) ecclesia Materanensis, Beatae Mariae Virgini et Sancto Eustachio sacra
notes: Basilica Minor act. Coronation stated: 'anno MDCCCXLIII, auctoritate Petriani Canonicorum Collegii, aureo diademate fuit redimita' (Vatican Chapter, 1843). The act begins on printed p. 324 (rubric and incipit visible in the adjoining passage AAS-55-1963-ocr#323); the coronation sentence itself is on p. 326, which is the passage's printed_page. Incipit taken verbatim from p. 324 ('Mateola' OCR 'Mateola/Mateóla'). Country inferred from the see of Matera, not stated in the act.

rubric_latin: Titulus ac privilegia Basilicae Minoris cathedrali ecclesiae Moronensi conferuntur.
incipit_latin: Terrena in peregrinatione constituti cives Moronenses honori Beatae Mariae Virginis, a prima labe immunis, quam a « felici itinere » vulgo appellant ac ducem habent ad caelestem, quo contendimus, patriam, monumentum praeclarum atque spectabile in urbe sua erexerunt
image_title_latin: vetusta Imago almae Deiparae a « felici itinere » (Immaculata Conceptio Beatae Mariae Virginis)
church_or_sanctuary: Cathedralis ecclesia Moronensis (Immaculatae Conceptioni B. M. V. « del Buen Viaje » sacra)
notes: Basilica Minor act recording John XXIII's own earlier grant: 'id simulacrum aureo diademate sivimus, Nostra auctoritate, redimiri, Apostolicis Litteris die xix mensis Decembris anno MCMLX sub Piscatoris anulo datis' — i.e. the faculty was granted by Apostolic Letters of 1960-12-19; the date of the coronation ceremony itself is not stated, so coronation_date left null. Country not stated in the act; inferred from the see of Morón (Bishop Michael/Miguel Raspanti) - please verify.

rubric_latin: Titulo ac privilegiis Basilicae Minoris honestatur ecclesia Beatae Mariae Virgini in Caelum Assumptae sacra, vulgo « Madonna del Monte » seu « Conadomini » appellata et in urbe Calatayeronio posita.
incipit_latin: Praesidium decusque urbis Calatayeronii esse perhibetur templum Beatae Mariae Virginis in Caelum Assumptae sacrum, quod a Monte, cui est impositum, vulgo solet vocari
image_title_latin: simulacrum Beatae Mariae Virginis quod « Conadomini » appellant
church_or_sanctuary: Ecclesia Beatae Mariae Virginis in Caelum Assumptae, vulgo « Madonna del Monte » seu « Conadomini »
notes: Basilica Minor act. Coronation mentioned only as an anniversary: 'Revoluto vero quinquagesimo anno ex quo simulacrum Almae Deiparae, cui nomen « Conadomini », aureo diademate fuit redimitum' — the 50th year since the crowning, which with an act of 1963 implies c. 1913, but no year is stated, so coronation_date left null. No crowning authority named. Diocese spelled 'Calatayeronensis' in the OCR (for Calatagironensis/Caltagirone); bishop named 'Franciscus Fasola'. Act begins on printed p. 911; the coronation sentence is on p. 912 (the passage's printed_page). Country inferred, not stated.

rubric_latin: Titulus ac privilegia Basilicae Minoris ecclesiae paroeciali Sancti Andreae Apostoli in urbe « Viareggio » conferuntur.
incipit_latin: Quae hodie quasi ocellus Tyrrhenae orae vulgo praedicatur, urbs « Viareggio » fuit antea propugnaculum barbarorum incursionibus oppositum, ac vicus quem humiles incolebant piscatores.
image_title_latin: simulacrum Virginis Perdolentis
church_or_sanctuary: Ecclesia paroecialis Sancti Andreae Apostoli (Ordo Servorum Mariae)
notes: Basilica Minor act. Coronation stated: 'Virginis simulacrum, Petriani Canonicorum collegii auctoritate coronatum' (Vatican Chapter), with no year given. Diocese taken from 'attenta commendatione Ordinarii Lucensis'. The act begins on printed p. 913 (the coronation sentence is on p. 914); passage printed_page is 912. Country inferred, not stated.

rubric_latin: Beata Maria Virgo, « la Virgen de los Treinta y Tres » vulgo appellata, principalis Patrona eligitur Reipublicae Uruquarianae.
incipit_latin: Nobilis Uruquarianorum terra, pratorum viriditate collibusque molliter sinuatis peramoena, de antiqua gloriatur marianae sede pietatis
image_title_latin: parvum Beatae Mariae Virginis simulacrum, ex ligno exsculptum, Floridensis Virgo
image_title_vernacular: la Virgen de los Treinta y Tres
church_or_sanctuary: Templum princeps (cathedralis ecclesia) urbis Floridensis
notes: Act declaring the image Patron of Uruguay; it attests the papal coronation grant in passing: 'utpote qui, facta anno superiore licentia idem simulacrum aurea corona redimiendi' — the faculty was given 'the previous year', i.e. 1961 relative to this 1962 act; no explicit date, so coronation_date left null. Rubric and act start (p. 946) confirmed from the volume text.

rubric_latin: Titulo ac privilegiis Basilicae Minoris cathedralis ecclesia Floridensis honestatur.
incipit_latin: Floridense templum princeps sedes pietatis praedicatur totius dioecesis incolarum, quin etiam Uruquarianae nationis, siquidem ibi asservatur atque excolitur imago Beatae Mariae Virginis, a « Triginta Tribus viris » appellatae
image_title_latin: imago Beatae Mariae Virginis a « Triginta Tribus viris » appellatae
image_title_vernacular: la Virgen de los Treinta y Tres
church_or_sanctuary: Cathedralis ecclesia Floridensis
notes: Basilica Minor act. Coronation attested: 'hoc non ita pridem, Nostra auctoritate, fuit aureo diademate redimitum' (by John XXIII's authority, 'not long ago' - no date given). Same image as the 1962 patronage act at AAS 55 (1963) 946. Act begins on printed p. 956; passage printed_page is 957.

rubric_latin: Beata Maria Virgo, vulgo a « Fontenova » appellata, principalis caelestis Patrona dioecesis Pisciensis eligitur.
incipit_latin: Novus veluti fons in huius saeculi desertis spatiis exiit, cum aerumnoso humano generi data est, summo Dei miserentis beneficio, pientissima Mater ac certissimum salutis perfugium, Beata Virgo Maria.
image_title_latin: Alma Deipara a « Fontenova » appellata
church_or_sanctuary: Templum paroeciale oppidi « Monsummano Terme »
notes: Patronage act attesting the crowning: '... et anno MDCCiixxxn aureo diademate est redimita'. The OCR form 'MDCCiixxxn' resolves to MDCCLXXXII = 1782 on the pattern used elsewhere in this OCR ('MDCCCiiXXXViin' = MDCCCLXXXVIII); a checker should confirm the year against the printed page. No crowning authority named. Act date OCR 'MCMLÍXIII' = MCMLXIII (1963), Pontificatus Nostri primo. Country inferred, not stated.

rubric_latin: Titulo ac privilegiis Basilicae Minoris cathedralis ecclesia Marianensis decoratur.
incipit_latin: Erga almam Deiparam pietatis sedes inclita esse perhibetur cathedralis ecclesia Marianensis, quippe ubi vetus nobilisque imago eius, quae est « decor Carmeli », impensis populi excolatur obsequiis.
image_title_latin: vetus nobilisque imago Beatae Mariae Virginis, quae est « decor Carmeli »
church_or_sanctuary: Cathedralis (metropolitana) ecclesia Marianensis, B. M. V. in caelum Assumptae consecrata
notes: Basilica Minor act. Coronation attested: 'ac paulo post effigies ipsa, nomine et auctoritate eiusdem Summi Pontificis [Ioannis Pp. XXIII], inter potestatum, cleri, fidelium vota et plausus, aureo diademate redimita' — crowned in the name and by the authority of John XXIII, shortly after he declared her Patron of the city; no date and no Legate named. Vernacular title not given (Latin only, « decor Carmeli »). Country inferred from 'Civitatis, cui nomen « Minas Gerais »', not stated.

rubric_latin: Beata Maria Virgo, « Scala Paradisi » appellata, principalis Patrona, et S. Conradus Confalonieri, Confessor, Patronus aeque principalis totius Netensis dioecesis constituuntur.
incipit_latin: Scandere caelum datur hominibus, qui Beatae Mariae Virgini se devovent eiusque ductu vitam degunt cum virtute.
image_title_latin: imago Beatae Mariae Virginis a « Scala Paradisi » nuncupatae, vetusta, in rupe depicta
church_or_sanctuary: Sanctuarium Beatae Mariae Virginis « Scala Paradisi » prope urbem Netum
notes: Patronage act attesting the crowning: 'imago illa, auctoritate Petriani Collegii Canonicorum, anno MCMXXXI, aureo diademate fuit redimita' (Vatican Chapter, 1931). Act date OCR 'MCMUXIII' = MCMLXIII. Country inferred, not stated. Vernacular form of the title supplied from the Latin epithet - verify.

rubric_latin: Beata Maria Virgo, a Septem Doloribus appellata, totius regionis Ciminiae principalis Patrona renuntiatur.
incipit_latin: Quae regio monte silva ac lacu distinguitur, Ciminia commune quoddam marialis religionis domicilium habet constitutum sacris illis iurisdictionibus quae circa sunt.
image_title_latin: effigies Beatae Mariae Virginis a Septem Doloribus (Mater Dolorosa)
church_or_sanctuary: Pervetustum coenobium (ecclesia abbatialis) Sancti Martini ad Montem Ciminum
diocese_latin: Abbatia nullius Sancti Martini ad Montem Ciminum (Viterbiensis et Tuscanensis)
diocese_modern: San Martino al Cimino abbey nullius / Viterbo
notes: Patronage act attesting the crowning: 'Siquidem anno MCMXXXVIII effigies illa fuit aureo diademate redimita', and 'quinto et vicesimo exeunte anno postquam praedicta imago est coronata' (25th anniversary, consistent with 1938 + 25 = 1963). No crowning authority named. Country inferred from the sees named (Viterbo, Civita Castellana, Nepi/Sutri), not stated.

rubric_latin: Ad E.mum P. D. Iosephum Mariam Sanctae Romanae Ecclesiae Presb. Cardinalem Bueno Monreal, Archiepiscopum Hispalensem, cum effigies B. Mariae Virg., vulgo « de Nuestra Señora de la Esperanza Macarena », ea in urbe aureo diademate fuit redimita.
image_title_latin: effigies B. Mariae Virg., vulgo « de Nuestra Señora de la Esperanza Macarena »
image_title_vernacular: Nuestra Señora de la Esperanza Macarena
church_or_sanctuary: Basílica de la Macarena (the temple recently built for her, per the text)
notes: Papal written message sent for the coronation day ('Hoy fiesta de María Reina ... se adorna con corona de oro y pedrería la imagen'); rubric confirms 'aureo diademate fuit redimita'. Act begins on printed page 598; the passage's printed_page is 599. Body in Spanish, no Latin incipit.

rubric_latin: Beata Maria Virgo a gratiis constituitur Patrona principalis dioecesis Thelesinae seu Cerretanae, una cum Sancto Antonio de Padua, Confessore et Ecclesiae Doctore.
incipit_latin: « Quaeramus gratiam, et per Mariam quaeramus », ait Sanctus Bernardus, suavissimus vitae spiritualis praeceptor ac Deiparae Virginis praeco eximius
image_title_latin: imago almae Deiparae a gratiis nuncupatae
church_or_sanctuary: Sacrarium Beatae Mariae Virginis a gratiis in urbe episcopali dioecesis Thelesinae seu Cerretanae (templum saeculo XVI excitatum)
notes: Patronage act attesting the crowning: 'Quod simulacrum, anno MDCCCXCIII aureo diademate sollemni ritu redimitum' (1893); no crowning authority named. The sanctuary is located only as 'urbis episcopalis praeclarum ornamentum' — i.e. in the episcopal city of the see of Telese/Cerreto Sannita — so locality left null rather than inferred. Vernacular title supplied from the Latin 'a gratiis'. Country inferred, not stated.

rubric_latin: Titulus ac privilegia Basilicae Minoris cathedrali ecclesiae dioecesis Sancti Ioannis a Rege tribuuntur.
incipit_latin: Religione almae Deiparae Virginis teneri perhibentur cives urbis Sancti Ioannis a Rege, quae episcopalis sedis honore a Ioanne PP. XXIII, Decessore Nostro rec. mem., anno MCMLX est donata.
image_title_latin: imago Beatae Mariae Virginis a Columna
church_or_sanctuary: Cathedralis ecclesia dioecesis Sancti Ioannis a Rege, B. M. V. a Columna consecrata
notes: Basilica Minor act. Coronation attested: '... nomine et auctoritate Pii PP. XII, item Decessoris Nostri, est aureo diademate redimita' — crowned in the name and by the authority of Pius XII (r. 1939-1958); no date and no Legate named. Country and the Portuguese form of the title inferred (bishop Delphinus Ribeiro Guedes, see of São João del-Rei, Minas Gerais); not stated in the act.

rubric_latin: Titulo ac privilegiis Basilicae Minoris ecclesia Beatae Mariae Virginis Septem Dolorum in oppido v. « Sastin », intra Tyrnaviensis Administrationis Apostolicae fines, decoratur.
incipit_latin: Quam pulchra, immortalis, frugifera ac triumphis assuefacta Fides, a Christo Domino nobis indita, sit, per varie tentatos ac vexatos populos clare comprobatur.
image_title_latin: pervetustum Beatae Mariae Virginis Dolorosae simulacrum (Virgo Perdolens seu a septem Doloribus)
church_or_sanctuary: Sanctuarium Beatissimae Virginis Mariae Septem Dolorum in oppido « Sassinio »
notes: Basilica Minor act. Coronation grant attested: 'Anno praesertim MDCCCLXIV, trecentesimo ab ipsa condita ecclesia, Servus Dei Pius Pp. IX, Decessor Noster, praeter nonnullas Indulgentias, Marialis simulacri coronationem concessit et largitus est' — Pius IX granted the coronation in 1864 (the year the grant was made; the ceremony's date is not given). OCR forms: 'MDCCCLX i v' = MDCCCLXIV; place 'Sassinii'/'Sassinio', vulgo 'Sastinkse Straze' = Šaštínske Stráže (Šaštín-Stráže). Incipit OCR 'triumphis assuefa Fides' repaired to 'assuefacta'. Act begins on printed p. 457; passage printed_page is 458. Country explicit ('Slovachiae'); vernacular title supplied, verify.

rubric_latin: URBIS. Templum Ss.mi Cordis Iesu ad Castrum Praetorium diaconia fit
incipit_latin: Almae Urbis templa, quae vel antiquitate excellerent artisque praestantia vel illustrium sanctorumque virorum memoria, consueverunt Romani Pontifices singularibus privilegiis atque honoribus afficere.
image_title_latin: effigies Beatae Mariae Virginis Auxiliatricis
church_or_sanctuary: Templum Ss.mi Cordis Iesu ad Castrum Praetorium
notes: Apostolic Constitution erecting the church as a cardinalitial deaconry; it attests in passing: 'in eaque, exstans ibique venerata effigies Beatae Mariae Virginis Auxiliatricis rite a Canonicis patriarchalis Basilicae S. Petri aurea corona redimita est' (crowned by the canons of the Vatican Basilica), with no date given. Act begins on printed p. 485; the coronation sentence runs onto p. 486 (the passage's printed_page). Vernacular title supplied from the Latin.

rubric_latin: Ad Em.mum P. D. Hildebrandum tit. S. Sebastiani ad Catacumbas S. R. E. Presb. Cardinalem Antoniutti, Sacri Consilii Religiosis Ordinibus Sodalitatibusque praepositi Praefectum, quem Legatum mittit, ut Caebuae celebritatibus praesideat, quarto saeculo volvente ex quo Evangelium in Insulis Philippinis primum est annuntiatum.
incipit_latin: Aurora, praenuntia felicis successus, ante quattuor saecula Ecclesiae in Insulis Philippinis illuxit, cum Evangelium ibi primum est annuntiatum.
image_title_latin: statua Iesu Infantis
legate: Hildebrandus Antoniutti, S.R.E. Cardinalis, Praefectus Sacri Consilii Religiosis Ordinibus Sodalitatibusque praepositi
notes: The letter lists among the fourth-centenary celebrations at Cebu 'Eucharisticus e tota Natione Conventus et coronatio statuae Iesu Infantis, in anteriore quadam expeditione eum in locum allatae', and deputes Card. Antoniutti as Legate 'ut Nostram veluti gerens personam, piis coetibus aliisque caerimoniis praesideas'. The text does NOT explicitly commission him to perform the coronation — he is sent to preside over the celebrations of which it forms part; a checker should verify. Coronation year 1965 taken from the celebration year (letter dated 25 March 1965); no date is given in the text. Sanctuary not named (the Augustinian church at Cebu is implied by 'sacram aedem, quasi matricem ceterarum'). Archbishop of Cebu named: Iulius Rosales. Vernacular title (Santo Niño) not in the text.

rubric_latin: Titulus ac privilegia Basilicae Minoris ecclesiae metropolitanae Rosariensi tribuuntur.
incipit_latin: Marialis nomine ac pietate merito praedicatur urbs perfrequens et industria, utpote quae, « Rosarium » appellata, Beatam Mariam Virginem a Rosario conditricem suam habeat atque patronam.
image_title_latin: imago Beatae Mariae Virginis a Sacratissimo Rosario
church_or_sanctuary: Metropolitana (cathedralis) ecclesia Rosariensis, B. M. V. a Sacratissimo Rosario consecrata
notes: Basilica Minor act. Coronation attested of the second (substitute) image: 'Pro qua effigie post aliquid temporis altera fuit substituta, quae, magis in dies fidelium obsequiis ornata, anno MCMXLI aureo diademate est redimita' (1941); no crowning authority named. Country inferred (the act mentions the image was originally brought 'ex urbe Sanctae Fidei' = Santa Fe, and Pius XII declared her Patron of city and diocese in 1954); not stated. Vernacular title supplied from the Latin.

rubric_latin: Titulus ac privilegia Basilicae Minoris tribuuntur ecclesiae Beatae Mariae Virginis a Rosario (v. « Notre-Dame-du-Cap »), in Trifluvianensi dioecesi in Canadia.
incipit_latin: Evangelicum illud effatum « Oportet semper orare » (Lc. 18, 1) a Sancto Dominico etiam Mariali Rosario aptatum esse videtur
image_title_latin: Simulacrum Beatae Mariae Virginis a Rosario
church_or_sanctuary: Sanctuarium/ecclesia « Notre-Dame-du-Cap » apud oppidum « Cap-de-la-Madeleine »
legate: Valerius S. R. E. Presbyter Cardinalis Valeri (Valerio Valeri) — for the 1954 coronation only
notes: Basilica Minor act attesting TWO coronations of the same image: 'Duabus insuper praedicti Simulacri coronationibus, anno MCMIV, quinquagesimo ab edicto dogmate, nec non, per manus desideratissimi Dilecti Filii Nostri Valerii S. R. E. Presbyteri Cardinalis Valeri, anno MCMLIV, centesimo eiusdem promulgati mysterii, rite peractis' — 1904 (50th anniversary of the definition of the Immaculate Conception) and 1954 (centenary), the latter performed by Cardinal Valerio Valeri. coronation_date holds the first (1904); the second (1954) is recorded here in the notes and in the legate field. Church entrusted to the Missionary Oblates of Mary Immaculate. Country explicit ('in dicione Canadensi').

rubric_latin: Beata Maria Virgo, « Nuestra Señora del Rosario de las Lajas » vulgo appellata, principalis Patrona dioecesis Ipialensis eligitur.
incipit_latin: Tutela caelestis virtutis sacras iuvat diciones firmari, quae quasi arbores novellae in feraci catholicae Ecclesiae agro conseruntur.
image_title_latin: Nostra Domina SS. Rosarii, « de las Lajas » seu a rupe appellata
image_title_vernacular: Nuestra Señora del Rosario de las Lajas
notes: Patronage act; coronation attested in passing: 'ut enim praeclara imago anno MCMLII, auctoritate Petriani Canonicorum Collegii, pretioso diademate est redimita, ita duos post annos aedes ipsa ad dignitatem Basilicae Minoris ... est evecta'. The image is painted on rock ('marialis imago in saxo depicta'); the church is not named in the act. Country explicit ('intra fines Columbianae Civitatis').

rubric_latin: Rosa Aurea Basilicae Beatae Mariae Virginis a Guadalupe, intra fines archidioecesis Mexicanae positae, tribuitur asservanda.
incipit_latin: Flores edens et spargens, sive olim, uti ferunt, cum prodigialem praesentiam suam testatam voluit, sive continenter, cum caelestia munera ... supplicibus dilargitur
image_title_latin: Beata Maria Virgo Guadalupensis
church_or_sanctuary: Basilica Beatae Mariae Virginis a Guadalupe (Tepeyac)
notes: Golden Rose act; coronation attested in passing: 'Leonem Pp. XIII concessisse, ut venusta imago, qua Deipara, appellatione illa insignis, exprimitur, suo nomine et auctoritate aureo diademate redimiretur'. Year of the coronation not given here (see AAS 62 (1970) 681, 75th anniversary in 1970). Address form: 'Venerabili Fratri Michaeli Dario Miranda et Gómez, Archiepiscopo Mexicano'; the Golden Rose was to be delivered by Card. Carlo Confalonieri (bearer, not a coronation legate).

rubric_latin: Titulus ac privilegia Basilicae Minoris Sanctuario Mariali, quod a « Sacro Monte di Viggiano » appellatur et intra Potentinae-Marsicensis dioecesis fines est situm, deferuntur.
incipit_latin: Lucanae genti universae carissimum constat esse sacrarium, quod in finibus Potentinae et Marsicensis dioecesis exsurgit
image_title_latin: Beatissima Dei Genetrix a « Sacro Monte di Viggiano »
church_or_sanctuary: Sanctuarium Mariale « Sacro Monte di Viggiano »
notes: Basilica Minor act. Coronation attested in passing: 'hunc ipsum in annum, quindecim revolutis lustris, coronati Leonis Pp. XIII auctoritate simulacri memoria incidet sollemniterque agetur' — the image was crowned by the authority of Leo XIII, and the 75th anniversary (quindecim lustra) falls in the year of the act. No explicit coronation year is given; c. 1890-1891 is implied by the arithmetic (act dated Dec 1965, anniversary 'hunc ipsum in annum') — left null deliberately, a checker should confirm. The image is a statue of the Virgin holding the Infant Jesus ('simulacrum Augustae Virginis Puerum Iesum sustinentis'). Country inferred from Lucania/Basilicata; not stated. The act opens on printed page 566; the coronation clause falls on page 567.

rubric_latin: Titulus ac privilegia Basilicae Minoris templo oppidi Iaroslaviae, Beatae Mariae Virgini Dolorosae sacro, attribuuntur.
incipit_latin: Clarissimum dederunt nomen Iaroslaviae, quod est oppidum Polonorum in finibus dioecesis Premisliensis, effigies et ecclesia
image_title_latin: Beata Maria Virgo Dolorosa
church_or_sanctuary: Dominican shrine church of B. Maria Virgo Dolorosa at Jarosław (Ordo Praedicatorum)
notes: Basilica Minor act. Coronation attested in passing: 'Eadem iam praeterita aetate a sacrorum Antistite perpulchro pretiosoque diademate fuit redimita: cuius rei memoria, duobus exactis saeculis, magna coram multitudine nuper est celebrata'. CHECKER NOTE: the text says the image was crowned by 'a sacrorum Antistite' (the bishop) and does NOT state papal or Vatican Chapter authority; included because it documents a solemnly crowned sacred image whose bicentenary of coronation had recently been celebrated (hence c. 1755-1766 — left null as not explicitly stated). Latin toponym 'Iaroslavia' = Jarosław; the text explicitly calls it 'oppidum Polonorum'.

rubric_latin: Titulo ac privilegiis Basilicae Minoris ecclesia Beatae Mariae Virginis « a Catena » in oppido Lauriniano, intra Cosentinae archidioecesis fines, decoratur.
incipit_latin: Praeclara sedes pietatis marianae perhibetur esse sacrarium Beatae Mariae Virginis « a Catena », qua oppidum Laurinianum, archidioecesis Cosentina, quin etiam tota Bruttiorum regio ... aluntur ac nobilitantur
image_title_latin: Beata Maria Virgo « a Catena »
church_or_sanctuary: sacrarium Beatae Mariae Virginis « a Catena » (new church begun 1929, entrusted to the Clerici excalceati Ss. Crucis et Passionis)
notes: Basilica Minor act; coronation attested in passing: 'imago, auctoritate Canonicorum Collegii Petrianae Basilicae Vaticanae, sollemniter aureo diademate redimita', no year given. Image dated to 1301, showing the Virgin with the Divine Infant holding a chain. 'oppidum Laurinianum' read as Laurignano (Calabria) - verify; country from 'tota Bruttiorum regio, quam Calabriam vulgo appellant'. Vernacular title (Madonna della Catena) not given in the act, so left null.

rubric_latin: Beata Maria Virgo « Peña de Francia » vulgo appellata, principalis caelestis Patrona civilis provinciae Salmantinae eligitur.
incipit_latin: Singulari pietate excoli perhibetur Beata Maria Virgo, cuius, adiecto vulgari nomine « Peña de Francia » appellatae, sedes praecipua finibus dioecesis Salmantinae continetur.
image_title_latin: Beata Maria Virgo « Peña de Francia »
image_title_vernacular: Nuestra Señora de la Peña de Francia
church_or_sanctuary: sacra aedes seu sanctuarium Beatae Mariae Virginis « Peña de Francia » (entrusted to the Order of Preachers)
notes: Patronage act; coronation attested in passing: 'Effigies denique, Pio Pp. XII Catholicam Ecclesiam regente, aureo diademate fuit, anno MCMLII, sollemniter redimita'. aas_page set to 794 (the rubric stands before the running head '795' in the passage; the passage was indexed as printed_page 795). No town named - only that the shrine lies within the diocese of Salamanca. Country explicit (Hispania).

rubric_latin: Titulo ac privilegiis Basilicae Minoris paroecialis ecclesia Beatae Mariae Virginis « de Mongui », dioecesis Duitamensis, decoratur.
incipit_latin: Sedes religionis ínclita et illustris praedicatur paroeciale templum augustae Virgini Deiparae sacrum, quod in oppidi « Mongui » vulgo appellati ac dioecesis Duitamensis non modicum vertit ornamentum.
image_title_latin: Beata Maria Virgo « de Mongui »
church_or_sanctuary: paroeciale templum Beatae Mariae Virginis « de Mongui » (completed 1760)
notes: Basilica Minor act; coronation attested in passing: 'simulacrum illud, anno MCMXXIX, aureo diademate redimiretur', and the Virgin was made diocesan patron in 1955. The image is said to have been given by Philip II of Spain. Country explicit ('e tota Columbiana Dicione'). The same act's opening also appears in passage AAS-58-1966-ocr#795.

rubric_latin: Ad universos Episcopos pacem et communionem cum Apostolica Sede habentes: de Beata Virgine Maria, Matre Ecclesiae omniumque virtutum exemplari, veneranda atque imitanda.
incipit_latin: SIGNUM MAGNUM, quod sanctus Ioannes Apostolus in caelo suspexit, Mulierem videlicet amictam sole, non immerito de beatissima Maria Virgine ... interpretatur
image_title_latin: Beata Maria Virgo Fatimensis
church_or_sanctuary: templum B. Mariae Fatimensis
notes: Not an act about a coronation: the attestation is in footnote 6 of the Apostolic Exhortation Signum magnum - 'Nuntius Radiophonicus a Pio XII, die 13 mensis Maii anno 1946, Lusitaniae christifidelibus datus, sollemnia celebrantibus ad templum B. Mariae Fatimensis, aurea corona nomine Summi Pontificis redimitae: A. A. S. 38 (1946) p. 264'. Coronation date taken as the day of those solemnities (13 May 1946) - verify. The exhortation begins on p. 465 (rubric and incipit taken from there); the footnote is on p. 466. Locality 'Fátima' inferred from 'Fatimensis'; country explicit (Lusitania).

rubric_latin: Beata Maria Virgo Domina Nostra a Pace seu « Nuestra Señora de la Paz » principalis Patrona totius Salvatorianae Reipublicae eligitur.
incipit_latin: Pacis sequestra, Beatissima Virgo Maria, nobilem sedem constitutam habere cognoscitur in maximo templo Sancti Michaelis, intra Reipublicae Salvatorianae fines.
image_title_latin: Domina Nostra a Pace
church_or_sanctuary: maximum templum Sancti Michaelis
notes: Patronage act; coronation attested in passing: 'Benedictus Papa XV ... anno MCMXX per Sacram Rituum Congregationem concessit, ut Mater Dei, cui « Reginae Pacis » nomen adiectum, urbis et dioecesis Sancti Michaelis caelestis renuntiaretur Patrona; eodemque anno est largitus, ut imago illa aureo diademate redimeretur.' 1920 is the year of the grant; the date of the crowning itself is not stated. Country explicit (Respublica Salvatoriana).

rubric_latin: Beata Maria Virgo Lauretana totius dioecesis Tigiuanaënsis Patrona principalis renuntiatur.
incipit_latin: Lauretanae Virgini prope singulariter consecrata, ob impensum in eam studium fidelium, videtur esse terra Tigiuanaënsis, in qua Nosmetipsi ... Vicariatum Apostolicum ad gradum dignitatemque dioecesis proveximus
image_title_latin: Beata Maria Virgo Lauretana
notes: Patronage act; coronation attested in passing: 'a Decessore Nostro imm. rec. Pio Pp. XII facultatem eiusdem imaginis coronandae libenter esse datam ... novimus etiam miro spectaculo fidei sollemnia id temporis in honorem Reginae Lauretanae esse peracta' - no date given for either grant or crowning. The image is kept in a village called Loreto within the then diocese of Tijuana. Country inferred from Tijuana / 'utraque California' - not stated in the act.

rubric_latin: Rosa aurea Apparitiopolitanae Basilicae B. Mariae Virg. Immaculatae, quae vulgo « Aparecida » vocatur, tribuitur.
incipit_latin: Celsissima Virgo Maria, quemadmodum pluribus locis per orbem terrarum evenisse cognoscitur, in amplissima quoque regione Brasiliensi veluti posuit pedem, ut singularis pietatis excitaret sedem
image_title_latin: Beata Maria Virgo Immaculata, vulgo « Aparecida »
church_or_sanctuary: Basilica Apparitiopolitana (church dedicated 1888, made Basilica Minor by St Pius X)
notes: Golden Rose act addressed to Card. Carlos de Vasconcellos Motta; coronation attested in passing: after mentioning the Basilica Minor title granted by St Pius X, 'Eiusdem vero Summi Pontificis auctoritate effigies illa paulo ante aureo diademate erat redimita' - year not stated. The small terracotta statue was found in the Paraíba river in 1717. Country explicit (regio Brasiliensis).

rubric_latin: Beata Maria Virgo « della Porta » appellata principalis Patrona urbis episcopalis et totius dioecesis Guastallensis, una cum Sancto Francisco Assisiensi, Patrono aeque principali, constituitur.
incipit_latin: Porta caeli ab Ecclesia merito praedicatur Beata Maria Virgo: hanc enim si sequuntur in cursu vitae terrenae, homines metam feliciter contingunt
image_title_latin: Beata Maria Virgo a porta
church_or_sanctuary: templum Beatae Mariae Virginis « della Porta » in Guastalla
notes: Patronage act; coronation attested in passing: 'Sanctus Pius Pp. X, Decessor Noster, concessit, ut imago aurea corona, suo nomine et auctoritate, redimiretur' - no year. The image, originally on a city gate, began to work wonders on 7 February 1693. OCR prints 'delia Porta' for 'della Porta' throughout (repaired here). Country inferred from Guastalla and the Italian vernacular title - not stated in the act.

rubric_latin: Titulus ac privilegia Basilicae Minoris ecclesiae conventuali, B. Mariae Virgini de Monte Carmelo in urbe Xeretio dicatae, attribuuntur.
incipit_latin: Actuosae pietatis domicilium sane licet appellari Carmelitarum Fratrum templum, quod in urbe Xeretio, intra Hispalensis archidioecesis fines, exsurgit
image_title_latin: Beata Maria Virgo de Monte Carmelo
church_or_sanctuary: ecclesia conventualis Carmelitarum Antiquae Observantiae (church of El Carmen)
notes: Basilica Minor act; coronation attested in passing: 'Marialis enim imago summae est omnibus venerationi, eademque anno MCMXXV, Patriarchalis Vaticani Canonicorum Collegii auctoritate, sollemni ritu coronata est'. Vernacular title 'Nuestra Señora del Carmen' is verbatim in the text. Locality: Latin 'urbs Xeretium', identified as Jerez de la Frontera (Carmelite friary in the archdiocese of Seville, Baetican province) — inference. Country inferred. The act opens on printed page 1119; the coronation clause falls on page 1120.

rubric_latin: Titulo ac privilegiis Basilicae Minoris Sanctuarium B. Mariae Virg. vulgo « dei Suffragio » in oppido vulgo « Grotte di Castro », dioecesis Faliscodunensis, sacrum, decoratur.
incipit_latin: Christifidelium concursibus frequentato templum Beatae Mariae Virginis, vulgo « dei Suffragio » nuncupatae, quod in oppido « Grotte di Castro », uti appellant, intra Faliscodunensis dioecesis fines est positum.
image_title_latin: Beata Maria Virgo vulgo « dei Suffragio »
church_or_sanctuary: Sanctuarium Beatae Mariae Virginis « dei Suffragio »
notes: Basilica Minor act; coronation attested in passing: 'simulacrum hoc mariale anno MDCCXXVIII, auctoritate Petriani Collegii Canonicorum, aureo diademate est redimitum' (OCR 'redimitimi'), the anniversary being kept every sixteenth year. Incipit reproduces OCR 'frequentato' (probably 'frequentatur'). 'Faliscodunensis' identified as Montefiascone (the same volumes pair it with Cornetana and Aquipendiensis); today part of the diocese of Viterbo - verify. Rubric spells the town 'Grotte di Castro', the dispositive clause 'Grotte del Castro'.

rubric_latin: Beata Maria Virgo, « Nuestra Señora de Copacabana » vulgo appellata, principalis Patrona totius Bolivianae Classis declaratur.
incipit_latin: Maria, mater Ecclesiae sollemni more in Concilio Oecumenico Vaticano II pronuntiata est, quippe quae ad gignendam augendamque vitam divinam in singulis hominum animis, materno opere continuo intendit
image_title_latin: Beata Maria Virgo de Copacabana
church_or_sanctuary: templum Beatae Mariae Virginis de Copacabana (17th cent., entrusted to the Friars Minor; made Basilica Minor by Pius XII)
notes: Patronage act (patron of the Bolivian Navy); coronation attested in passing: 'iam Praedecessores Nostri Pius XI effigiem ipsam aureo diademate redimiri et Pius XII templum titulo ac dignitate Basilicae Minoris decorari censuerunt' - no year for the crowning. Country explicit ('intra fines Bolivianae ditionis').

rubric_latin: Titulo ac privilegiis Basilicae Minoris templum S. Dominici in civitate Guatimalensi decoratur.
incipit_latin: Rosarii preces, veluti mystica serta in honorem Christi Matris contexta eidemque Deiparae acceptissima, ad caelestia impetranda dona efficacissimae semper fuerunt.
image_title_latin: Beata Maria Virgo a Rosario (Nostra Domina a Rosario)
church_or_sanctuary: templum S. Dominici, henceforth titled Nostrae Dominae a Rosario
notes: Basilica Minor act; coronation attested in passing: 'Postquam autem anno millesimo nongentesimo trigesimo quarto, praeclara imago, pretioso diademate redimita est et Beata Virgo Regina ac Patrona totius Guatimalensis dicionis declarata ...'. OCR prints 'Bosarii'/'Eosarii' for 'Rosarii' and 'Eegina' for 'Regina' (repaired here). Country explicit ('natio Guatimalensis').

rubric_latin: Universis Mexicanae Nationis christifidelibus, septuagesimo quinto exacto anno ex quo imago B. Mariae Virginis a Guadalupe aureo diademate redimita est.
image_title_latin: Beata Maria Virgo a Guadalupe
notes: Radio-television message of Paul VI for the 75th anniversary of the crowning of Our Lady of Guadalupe; the message body is in Spanish ('En el setenta y cinco aniversario de la Coronación de Nuestra Señora de Guadalupe...'), hence incipit_latin is null. Coronation year 1895 computed from the rubric ('septuagesimo quinto exacto anno') and the message date 12 October 1970 - not stated as such in the text; verify. The same event is listed in the volume indexes at pp. 876-877 and 911.

rubric_latin: Templum Beatae Mariae Virginis Reginae mundi in civitate Arcismonfina, in dioecesi Calvensi et Theanensi, titulo Basilicae Minoris decoratur.
incipit_latin: Quanto studio quantoque amore christianae aetates fuerint erga sanctissimam Christi Matrem, auxilium atque praesidium tutissimum populi christiani, id luculentissime ostendunt tum templa augusta ubique gentium structa
image_title_latin: Beata Maria Virgo Regina Mundi
church_or_sanctuary: templum Beatae Mariae Virginis Reginae Mundi
notes: Basilica Minor act. The only coronation evidence is descriptive: 'atque imaginem sanctam e petra beatissimae Matris, aurea redimita corona, quae ibi est, turbae frequentissimae petunt' - a stone image already wearing a golden crown; no crowning authority, decree or date is stated, so papal authorship of the coronation is NOT established by this passage. 'civitas Arcismonfina' read as Roccamonfina (Caserta) - verify; country inferred from the diocese of Calvi e Teano. aas_page set to 204, where the rubric and act begin (the crowned-image sentence falls on p. 205, the indexed printed_page).

rubric_latin: Templum Beatae Mariae Virginis Matris Consolationis ad dignitatem Basilicae Minoris attollitur.

notes: Basilica Minor act; coronation attested only in passing and without authority or date: 'sacram illam Beatissimae Virginis effigiem, pretioso diademate iterum iterumque cinctam, egregium iam a saeculo xvi templum contegit' - the image has been crowned more than once. rubric_latin: NORMAE CIRCA PATRONOS CONSTITUENDOS ET IMAGINES B. M. VIRGINIS CORONANDAS — II. De Coronatione Imaginis Beatae Mariae Virginis
incipit_latin: Pluries decursu temporis factum est ut populus christianus, filiali devotione permotus, ardenter peteret et obtineret coronationem alicuius Imaginis B. Mariae Virginis.
notes: General legislation, not a specific image. Issued by the Sacra Congregatio pro Cultu Divino 'de mandato Summi Pontificis' (Paul VI reigning); signed Arturus Card. Tabera, Praefectus, and H. Bugnini, a Secretis. The document heading is on printed page 276; Part I (De Patronis constituendis) runs 276-279 and is dated 19 March 1973; Part II (De Coronatione Imaginis Beatae Mariae Virginis) runs 280-281 and is dated 25 March 1973 — that is the act_date given here. Key provisions: only images of the BVM (painted or sculpted) may be crowned; if Christ is shown with her, both must be crowned; the rite is normally performed by the local Bishop per the Pontificale Romanum; coronation 'nomine et auctoritate Summi Pontificis' by a Pontifical Delegate requires that the image be of real importance to the Church, nation or region, and 'facultas coronandi conceditur per Decretum praedictae Congregationis ac per Litteras Apostolicas in forma Brevis expediendas'. Passages AAS-65-1973-ocr#738 and #739 are back-of-volume index entries pointing to this same act at page 276 and were not emitted separately. Document spans pp. 276-280+.

rubric_latin: Simulacrum B. M. Virginis vulgo « de los Remedios » in templo Naucalpanensi, in Mexico, excultum, pretioso diademate cingi sinitur.

rubric_latin: Imago Deiparae Virginis Immaculatae in sacello loci qui dicitur vulgo « Przasnysz » dioecesis Plocensis aureo redimitur serto.

rubric_latin: Simulacrum B. M. Virginis a Caritate, in urbe vulgo Huatlanta, pretioso diademate coronari sinitur.

image_title_latin: Imago Beatae Mariae Virginis a Caritate

rubric_latin: Ad E.mum P. D. Marium S. R. E. Cardinalem Nasalli Rocca di Corneliano, quem Missum Extraordinarium eligit ut celebritatibus praesideat in aede sacra B. M. V. ab Arcu appellatae apud urbem Neapolim, primo volvente saeculo ex quo eadem Deiparae imago aureo diademate redimita fuit.

image_title_latin: Beatae Mariae Virginis imago ab Arcu appellata

notes: Not a coronation act: the Pope sends a Missus Extraordinarius to preside at the centenary of the image's golden crowning. Coronation year derived from 'primo volvente saeculo' with the celebration on 8 September 1974, so the crowning was in 1874 (very likely 8 September 1874) - verify the exact day. Country Italy inferred from 'apud urbem Neapolim' (Naples); no diocese named in the act. Vernacular title rendered from the Latin 'ab Arcu appellatae'. rubric_latin: NUNTIUS TELEVISIFICAS. Episcopis et christifidelibus Cilensis Nationis datus occasione dedicationis templi nationalis votivi B. M. V. a Carmelo, loco vulgo Maipu, exeunte Anno Sancto in locali Ecclesia celebrato.
image_title_latin: B. M. V. a Carmelo
church_or_sanctuary: Templo Votivo Nacional dedicated to the Virgen del Carmen (templum nationale votivum B. M. V. a Carmelo)
notes: Televised message of Paul VI to Chile for the dedication of the national votive temple of Our Lady of Mount Carmel at Maipú. The source never says 'image': it names the devotion/title and says the Pope gave it a mantle and a crown — 'Depositamos estos votos nuestros ante la Virgen del Carmen de Maipú, a la que hemos querido también rendir nuestro homenaje con la donación de un manto y una corona, símbolos de confianza filial en su poderosa protección.' This is a papal DONATION of a crown, not a liturgical coronation rite, and the Pope was not present in person (message sent from Rome); classified papal_personal_coronation per the gap-spec rule for papal gifts of a crown, but a checker should verify whether a coronation ceremony followed. No coronation date is given. Act begins on printed page 727 (rubric there); the passage window is anchored at 729, where the crown sentence stands. Act date from the footnote '* Die 28 mensis novembris a. 1974.' Rubric printed 'NUNTIUS TELEVISIFICAS' (OCR/typo for TELEVISIFICUS). Body is in Spanish, so no Latin incipit.

rubric_latin: Nulla deinceps intermissa mora, Missam una cum omnibus Reipublicae Dominicanae Episcopis celebravit in Platea, quae ab Independentia nuncupatur, fidelium populo refertissima; postque lectum Evangelium hanc Summus Pontifex homiliam habuit
notes: THE RECORD THIS GAP PASS EXISTS FOR. Homily of John Paul II at the Mass in the Plaza de la Independencia, Santo Domingo, 25 January 1979, first stop of the Iter Apostolicum in Mexicum (AAS 71, 149 ff.; the day is headed 'Die 25 m. Ianuarii', p. 150). Spanish sentence, verbatim: 'Amad a Cristo, amad al hombre por El y vivid la devoción a nuestra querida Madre del cielo, a quien invocáis con el hermoso nombre de Nuestra Señora de la Altagracia, a la que el Papa quiere dejar como homenaje de devoción una diadema.' No word for image appears anywhere near it — the devotion is named by its title only, which is why the mechanical filter dropped it. What the source states is that the Pope wishes to LEAVE a diadem as a homage of devotion; it is not described as a formal liturgical coronation. The homily begins on printed page 155 ('postque lectum Evangelium hanc Summus Pontifex homiliam habuit'); page set to 158, where the diadem sentence stands, as cited by the coordinator. AAS does not name the sanctuary of Higüey; earlier the same day, in the cathedral of Santo Domingo, the Pope prayed 'por intercesión de Nuestra Señora de la Altagracia, cuya imagen está aquí presente' (p. 155) — the only mention of an image. Locality 'Santo Domingo' is the place of the homily, not necessarily the home of the image. Body is in Spanish, so no Latin incipit; rubric_latin is the Latin editorial narrative introducing the homily on p. 155.

rubric_latin: Mane diei 27 m. ianuarii, Polonorum civium coloniam in Mexico degentium coram admisit, antequam e Delegationis Apostolicae aedibus templum B. M. V. a Guadalupe peteret. ... Inde profectus, ad sacram aedem pervenit, sacris litaturus atque Plenario Coetui Episcoporum Latinorum Americanorum, intercedente Beatissima Dei Genetrice, initium daturus. Quae inter sacra, hanc homiliam habuit
image_title_latin: B. M. V. a Guadalupe
church_or_sanctuary: Santuario (Basilica) de Nuestra Señora de Guadalupe
notes: Found by extending the search over the surrounding pages of the same journey, as instructed; this page is NOT one of the 26 passages of batch G07 (the id follows the batch id convention for AAS-71-1979-ocr, page 177). Homily/prayer of John Paul II at the shrine of Guadalupe, 27 January 1979, at the Mass opening the III General Conference of the Latin American Episcopate. Spanish sentence, verbatim: 'Finalmente, oh Madre, recordando y confirmando el gesto de mis Predecesores Benedicto XIV y Pío X, quienes Te proclamaron Patrona de México y de toda la América Latina, Te presento una diadema en nombre de todos tus hijos mexicanos y latinoamericanos, para que los conserves bajo tu protección, guardes su concordia en la fe y su fidelidad a Cristo, Tu Hijo.' Same pattern as the Altagracia passage: the Pope presents a diadem to a devotion named by title; no formal coronation rite is described, and the words are addressed to the Virgin, not to an image (the image is mentioned separately on p. 175: 'Tu imagen en el Santuario de Guadalupe'). The homily begins on printed page 171; the diadem sentence is on p. 177. Locality 'Mexico City' is inferred — AAS names only the 'Santuario de Guadalupe' / 'templum B. M. V. a Guadalupe' in Mexico (Tepeyac is named on p. 173) — hence medium confidence. Body is in Spanish, so no Latin incipit; rubric_latin is the Latin editorial narrative of p. 171 (ellipsis marks omitted text).

rubric_latin: Ex urbe Cracovia, mane, Summus Pontifex sacram aedem adiit B. M. V., quae per vulgus « Kalwaria Zebrzydowska » appellatur, et hanc allocutionem ante templum fecit

Albina Dunajewskiego, biskupa krakowskiego, koronami papieża Leona XIII' — crowned 15 Aug 1887 by Cardinal Albin Dunajewski, Bishop of Kraków, with crowns of Pope Leo XIII. Mario Casariego, Archbishop of Guatemala, acting in the Pope's name. Country inferred from archidioecesis Vratislaviensis / Miedzygórze (Międzygórze); not named in the act. Vernacular title supplied as the standard rendering of 'B. M. V. Nivalis', not verbatim.

rubric_latin: Templum Visitationis Beatae Mariae Virginis, in dioecesi Varmiensi situm, ad dignitatem Basilicae Minoris evehitur.

No coronation date given. Act begins on printed p. 479 (running head '480 Acta Apostolicae Sedis' follows the opening); passage indexed at p. 480; volume index also cites p. 479. 'Sacra Tilia' is Święta Lipka (identification not in the text). Country from 'Polonica gens' + dioecesis Varmiensis.

rubric_latin: Imago « Dominae nostrae ab Assumptione », in dioecesi de Aguas Calientes, sacro diademate coronatur.

notes: Faculty granted to Bp Salvator Quezada Limón to crown the image in the Pope's name in his cathedral. Country explicit ('de Aguas Calientes in Mexico'). Act recalls that Pius XII raised the cathedral to Basilica Minor and that the same title is the diocese's patroness.

rubric_latin: Sinitur Imago B. M. V. vulgo « Nuestra Señora de la Esperanza » in aede S. Annae de Triana dioecesis Hispalensis, redimiri.

notes: Act begins on printed p. 607 (running head in context); passage indexed at p. 606. rubric_latin: Sinitur Imago B. M. V. quae est in pago Krypno, archidioecesis Vilnensis in Białystok, coronari.

notes: Act begins on printed p. 608 (running head in context); passage indexed at p. 606. Faculty granted to Bp Eduardus Kisiel, titular of Limata and Apostolic Administrator, or his delegate. Country explicit ('in Polonia'). Painted image ('in illo imagine picta').

rubric_latin: Conceditur facultas coronandi Imaginis B. M. V. quae colitur in cathedrali templo Opoliensi, in Polonia.

church_or_sanctuary: templum cathedrale Opoliense
notes: Petition of Bp Alfonsus Nossol of Opole; the image is to be crowned in the Pope's name and authority. Country explicit (rubric 'in Polonia'). Datum line gives no pontifical year but 'Sanctissimae Redemptionis Nostrae Iubilaeo'.

rubric_latin: Imago Beatae Mariae Virginis, quam populus titulo « Santa Maria della Purità » nuncupat, in templo monasterii Carmelitarum episcopalis urbis Nucerinae Paganorum observata, pretioso diademate redimiri sinitur « nomine et auctoritate Summi Pontificis ».

notes: Act begins on printed p. 680 (running head in context); passage indexed at p. 679. DATE DISCREPANCY: the act body reads 'die II mensis Maii', while the volume index (p. 1107) lists this act (incipit 'Christifideles Nucerini') under 11 May 1983 — possible OCR/typographical loss of an 'X'; verify. Petition of Bp Iolandus Nuzzi, letter of 16 April 1983; tercentenary celebrations that year; image given to the Carmelite nuns in the 17th century at the request of Ven. Seraphina a Deo. Country inferred from the Italian title and the see of Nocera; not named in the act.

rubric_latin: Fit potestas Romani Pontificis nomine auctoritateque redimiendi serto pretioso signum Beatae Virginis Mariae a Rosario sive a Flagello in Sancti Dominici sanctuario apud « Soriano Calabro » dioecesis Miletensis.

image_title_latin: Simulacrum Dominae Nostrae a Rosario sive a Flagello
church_or_sanctuary: Sanctuarium Sancti Dominici
legate: Marius Aloisius S. R. E. Cardinalis Ciappi, O.P.
notes: Rubric uses 'sertum' ('redimiendi serto pretioso'), the body 'pretioso diademate redimiat'. Faculty granted to Card. Mario Luigi Ciappi to crown the image 'Nostro nomine et auctoritate'. Country inferred from 'Soriano Calabro'/'regione Vibonensi'/'dioecesis Miletensis' (unambiguous but not stated), hence medium per spec rule 1. Vernacular title is a rendering of the Latin, not quoted in the text.

rubric_latin: Sinitur Archiepiscopus Messanensis nomine atque auctoritate Summi Pontificis imaginem B. M. V. a divina Providentia coronare, quae in urbe Montalbano Elicona, in eadem archidioecesi, colitur.
