image_title_latin: imago B. M. V. a divina Providentia
church_or_sanctuary: sacra aedes urbis Montalbano Elicona
notes: Rubric OCR reads 'B. M. W.'; repaired to 'B. M. V.'. Archbishop: Ignazio Cannavò. Country inferred from the Sicilian place/see (act does not name Italy).

rubric_latin: Cestochoviae, occasione oblata coronationis quattuor Imaginum Beatae Mariae Virginis.
image_title_vernacular: Obraz Matki Bożej z Brdowa (Our Lady of Brdów)
church_or_sanctuary: sanktuarium w Brdowie (sanctuary of Brdów)
notes: One of four images crowned personally by John Paul II at Jasna Góra, Częstochowa, on 19 June 1983 ('obrazie z Brdowa w Diecezji Włocławskiej'). Bishop Jan Zaręba of Włocławek is greeted. Latin diocesan name not given in the (Polish) text. Image detail on printed page 938; act begins on p. 935.

rubric_latin: Cestochoviae, occasione oblata coronationis quattuor Imaginum Beatae Mariae Virginis.
image_title_vernacular: Obraz Matki Bożej z Lubaczowa (Matka Boża Łaskawa, image of the vows of King John Casimir)
church_or_sanctuary: co-cathedral / church at Lubaczów (Apostolic Administration of Lubaczów)
diocese_modern: Lubaczów (Apostolic Administration; remnant of the archdiocese of Lviv of the Latins)
notes: One of four images crowned personally by John Paul II at Jasna Góra, Częstochowa, on 19 June 1983 ('Mam włożyć papieskie korony na skronie Jezusa i Maryi w obrazie z Lubaczowa'). Described as the image that witnessed the vows of John Casimir in the Lviv cathedral in 1656 and before which the Mother of God was first called Queen of the Polish Crown. Bishop Marian Rechowicz, Apostolic Administrator in Lubaczów, is greeted. Image detail on printed page 938; act begins on p. 935. Body in Polish, no Latin incipit.

rubric_latin: Cestochoviae, occasione oblata coronationis quattuor Imaginum Beatae Mariae Virginis.
image_title_vernacular: Obraz Matki Bożej z Zielenic (zieleniecki obraz Bogarodzicy)
church_or_sanctuary: sanktuarium w Zielenicach (sanctuary of Zielenice)
notes: One of four images crowned personally by John Paul II at Jasna Góra, Częstochowa, on 19 June 1983 ('obrazie z sanktuarium w Zielenicach, Diecezji Kieleckiej'), tied to the centenary of the diocese of Kielce. Bishop Stanisław Szymecki of Kielce is greeted. Image detail on printed pages 939-940; act begins on p. 935.

rubric_latin: Cestochoviae, occasione oblata coronationis quattuor Imaginum Beatae Mariae Virginis.
image_title_vernacular: Obraz Matki Bożej ze Stoczka Warmińskiego (Matka Pokoju / Mother of Peace)
church_or_sanctuary: sanktuarium w Stoczku Warmińskim (sanctuary of Stoczek Warmiński)
notes: One of four images crowned personally by John Paul II at Jasna Góra, Częstochowa, on 19 June 1983 ('obrazie z sanktuarium w Stoczku, Diecezji Warmińskiej'). The Pope gives thanks to 'Matka Pokoju' (Mother of Peace) for over three hundred years of protection over Warmia, and recalls that Stoczek was the place of Cardinal Wyszyński's internment 1953-1954. Bishop Jan Obłąk of Warmia is greeted. Image detail on printed pages 938-939; act begins on p. 935.

rubric_latin: In templo Sanctuario S. Annae apud Opolium habita.
image_title_vernacular: Obraz Matki Bożej z katedry opolskiej (Our Lady of Opole)
church_or_sanctuary: cathedral of Opole (image); coronation performed at the sanctuary of St Anne on Góra Świętej Anny
notes: 'Na pamiątkę mej obecności na tej ziemi pragnę za chwilę dokonać koronacji czcigodnego obrazu Matki Bożej z katedry opolskiej' — the Pope announces he is about to crown the venerable image of the Mother of God from the Opole cathedral, during the allocution at the sanctuary of St Anne (Góra Świętej Anny), 21 June 1983. Bishop Alfons Nossol of Opole is greeted. Act begins on printed page 974; announcement on p. 979. Body in Polish, no Latin incipit.

act_type: Decretum super virtutibus heroicis (Sacra Congregatio pro Causis Sanctorum)
rubric_latin: LEODIEN. Beatificationis et Canonizationis Servae Dei Eugeniae Joubert, Congregationis Sororum a S. Familia Ss. Cordis Iesu. SUPER DUBIO
image_title_latin: simulacrum B. M. V. Lapurdi

Attests that the Lourdes image was crowned by authority of Pius IX, but gives no coronation date (11 February is given as the anniversary date, which a checker should verify). Country/diocese inferred from 'Lapurdi'. Not a papal act; decree of the Congregation for the Causes of Saints, hence pope=null.

rubric_latin: Sinitur Episcopus S. Rosae de Osos, in Columbia, Imaginem B. M. V. a Misericordiis, nomine atque auctoritate Summi Pontificis coronare.

image_title_latin: Imago B. M. V. a Misericordiis
notes: Bishop: Joaquín García Ordóñez. Country explicit ('in Columbia').

rubric_latin: Imago Sacrae Familiae, in basilica Assumptionis intra fines dioecesis Vladislaviensis sita, pretioso diademate coronatur.
incipit_latin: Surreptis misere nuper impieque pretiosis corollis, quibus videlicet Sacrae Familiae Nazarethanae enitebat simulacrum in Basilica ipsa Assumptionis
image_title_latin: simulacrum Sacrae Familiae Nazarethanae
church_or_sanctuary: Basilica Assumptionis Beatae Mariae Virginis, « Kalisz »
notes: Re-crowning: the previous precious crowns had just been stolen ('sacrilegum furtum'), and Bp Ioannes Zareba obtained the faculty to impose new ones in the Pope's name. DATE DISCREPANCY: body reads 'die II mensis Martii', volume index (p. 1111) lists the act (incipit 'Surreptis misere') under 11 March 1984 — verify. Country inferred from Kalisz / dioecesis Vladislaviensis; not named in the act.

rubric_latin: Conceditur Episcopo Tarnoviensi facultas coronandi imaginem B. M. V. Nivalis et Divini Infantis, quae in Abbatia de Ciricio exstat.
incipit_latin: Polonus populus per saeculorum decursum Beatissimam Virginem Dei genetricem summo excoluit honore summaque veneratione
image_title_latin: Beata Maria Virgo Nivalis et Divinus Infans
church_or_sanctuary: Abbatia de Ciricio
notes: Faculty granted to Bp Georgius Ablewicz of Tarnów to impose the crown in the Pope's name; the act recalls that John Paul II blessed the image during his visit to Poland. DATE DISCREPANCY: body reads 'die xvi mensis Aprilis', volume index (p. 1111) lists the act (incipit 'Polonus populus') under 26 April 1984 — verify. Odd phrase in the operative clause: 'quae in Ciricio et Lezajsk colitur' (so in the text; Leżajsk is not in Tarnów diocese) — verify against the printed page. 'Abbatia de Ciricio' = the Cistercian abbey of Szczyrzyc (identification not in the text). Country explicit ('Polonus populus', 'Polona terra').

rubric_latin: Summi Pontificis nomine auctoritateque ut imagini B. M. V. a Rosario « Nuestra Señora del Rosario de Iles » diadema imponat Episcopo permittitur Ipialensi.
incipit_latin: Quantum praeteriti spatium temporis repetere potest hominum memoria, ex quo videlicet tempore plus quadringentos abhinc annos nomen est Christianum ibi conditum
image_title_latin: Imago B. M. V. a Rosario
image_title_vernacular: Nuestra Señora del Rosario de Iles
church_or_sanctuary: sacra aedes in oppido Iles
notes: Faculty to Bishop Alfonso Arteaga Yepes of Ipiales to impose 'pretiosam coronam Nostro ipsorum nomine et auctoritate'. Cedar statue ('sub cedrina ipsa forma'). Country explicit ('illius regionis Columbiae'). Also indexed in the volume's Index rerum analyticus, p. 1219.

rubric_latin: Sinitur Episcopus Lomzensis imaginem B. Virginis Mariae, quae in sacello paroeciae Pionka Koscielna excolitur, diademate coronare nomine et auctoritate Summi Pontificis.

church_or_sanctuary: sacellum paroeciae Plonka Koscielna
notes: Second act inside the same passage; the act opens on printed p. 286 (the passage's printed_page is 285). Rubric OCR reads 'Pionka Koscielna'; the body has both 'Plonka Kascielna' and 'Plonka Koscielna' — correct form Płonka Kościelna. Faculty to Bishop Iulius (Juliusz) Paetz of Łomża. Country inferred from the diocese/place name (not stated), hence medium. Vernacular title supplied as a rendering, not quoted. Also indexed at p. 1219.

rubric_latin: Simulacrum B. M. V. sub titulo « la Virgen de la Candelaria » excultae, quod intra fines archidioecesis Arequipensis in sacra aede oppidi « Chapi » asservatur, pretioso diademate redimitur.

image_title_vernacular: La Virgen de la Candelaria de Chapi

V. sub titulo «La virgen de la Candelaria» in sacra aede oppidi «Chapi» intra fines archidioecesis Arequipensis pretioso diademate redimitur, nomine et auctoritate S. P., 465'. Record built on the act itself at printed p. 465, used as aas_page. John Paul II crowned it in person during his pastoral visit: 'libentissime die II huius ipsius mensis Februarii pretioso diademate redimire vi et auctoritate Nostra Apostolica voluimus'. Act is numbered III in the OCR although the following act is numbered VI — numbering may be defective.

rubric_latin: Memoriae proditur Summum Pontificem Ioannem Paulum II die septimo et vicesimo Ianuarii, hoc anno, coronasse imaginem B. V. M. de Coromoto, in dioecesi Guanarensi.

image_title_latin: Imago B. V. M. de Coromoto
notes: Assigned passage is the Index rerum analyticus (printed p. 1219, which OCRs the diocese as 'Guaranensi'); record built on the act itself at printed p. 466, used as aas_page. 'beatissimam Virginem Mariam de Coromoto sollemnissima caerimonia coronavimus, pretioso diademate imposito ... die septimo et vicesimo mensis Ianuarii proxime elapsi'. Bishop of Guanare then Angelus Adolfus Polachini (Ángel Adolfo Polachini). Sanctuary not named in the act.

rubric_latin: De coronatione Imaginis B. M. V. « dei Carmen » quae in paroeciali templo oppiduli Paucartambo, in archidioecesi Cuschensi, colitur, a Summo Pontifice facta, intexitur historia.

image_title_latin: Imago B. M. V. « dei Carmen »
church_or_sanctuary: templum paroeciale oppiduli Paucartambo
notes: Assigned passage is the Index rerum analyticus (printed p. 1219): 'B. M. V. «dei Carmen» in oppidulo Paucartambo in archidioecesi Cuschensi, a S. P. coronatur, 707'. Record built on the act at printed p. 707, used as aas_page. The crowning itself was performed by John Paul II at Cuzco, not at Paucartambo: 'die III Februarii, hoc anno, petita gessimus, quando Cuzci ... pretiosa corona redimiimus'. Requested by Archbishop Alcides Mendoza Castro.

rubric_latin: Sinitur Episcopus Lublinensis imaginem B. M. V. titulo « Amabilis », seu « a Rosario », in loco Janów Lubelski veneratam, diademate redimire nomine atque auctoritate Summi Pontificis.

image_title_latin: Imago B. M. V. titulo « Amabilis » seu « a Rosario »
image_title_vernacular: Matka Boża Łaskawa z Janowa Lubelskiego
church_or_sanctuary: templum paroeciale loci Janów Lubelski
notes: Assigned passage is the Index rerum analyticus (printed p. 1219): 'B. M. V. titulo «Amabilis». Episcopo Lublinensi fit facultas coronandi eiusdem imaginem, 708'. Record built on the act at printed p. 708, used as aas_page. Faculty to Bishop Boleslaus (Bolesław) Pylak to impose the diadem 'sive per se sive per alium'. Country inferred from the diocese/place name (not stated in the act), hence medium; vernacular title is a rendering, not quoted in the text — a checker should verify it.

rubric_latin: Caracae, ad Christifideles congregatos habita.
church_or_sanctuary: sanctuary of Our Lady of Coromoto, Guanare (the image 'será venerada en su nueva Basílica'); coronation performed on the explanada de Montalbán, Caracas
notes: 'Hoy el Papa, Obispo de Roma, rodeado de sus hermanos los Obispos de Venezuela, va a llevar a cabo la coronación canónica de la imagen de Nuestra Señora de Coromoto, que será venerada en su nueva Basílica' (p. 832); the same act announces 'el acto solemne de coronación de la venerada imagen de Nuestra Señora de Coromoto, Patrona de todos los venezolanos' (p. 830, passage AAS-77-1985-ocr#v830). Act begins on printed page 828. Note this is a second coronation, the image having already been crowned at Guanare in 1952 (AAS 44, p. 739). Body in Spanish, no Latin incipit.

rubric_latin: Imago B. Mariae Virginis in templo loci vulgo dicti « Paco » archidioecesis Manilensis servata, pretioso diademate coronatur.

image_title_latin: Imago B. Mariae Virginis « Our Lady of Peñafrancia »
church_or_sanctuary: parish church of Paco
notes: The Pope commits to Jaime L. Card. image_title_latin: imago B. M. V. « Casimiriensis »

rubric_latin: Imago B. M. V., quae in dioecesi Pinskensi pie colitur necnon in paroeciali templo loci vulgo « Ostrozany » asservatur, pretioso diademate redimitur.

rubric_latin: Beatissimus Pater imaginem B. M. V. a Mercede, in archidioecesi Calí, quae est in Columbia, veneratam Ipse coronat.

rubric_latin: Summus Pontifex imaginem Beatae Mariae Virginis, sub titulo « Nuestra Señora de la Candelaria » in sanctuario « La Popa » veneratam, Ipse coronat.
incipit_latin: Quantum Beatissima Virgo Maria universo populo catholico cara sit qualique ab eo pietate colatur nemini ignotum, maxime cum Christi Mater et nostra alicuius gentis historiam suis interventibus manifesto signat
image_title_latin: Imago Beatae Mariae Virginis sub nomine « Nuestra Señora de la Candelaria »
church_or_sanctuary: sanctuarium « La Popa »
notes: Act begins on printed page 16 (passage printed_page is 15). The Pope crowned the image with his own hands on 6 July 1986 ('imaginem illam die sexto mensis Iulii hoc anno Nostris manibus sollemniter pretioso diademate redimiimus'). Petitioner: Carolus Iosephus Ruiseco, Archbishop of Cartagena.

rubric_latin: Beatae Mariae Virginis Immaculatae imago, quae in ecclesia paroeciali in oppido Malabon colitur, in Insularum Philippinarum finibus, diademate redimiri sinitur.
incipit_latin: Cum Nos sollicito studio Ipsi Beatissimam Virginem Mariam prosequimur, tum etiam, quotiescumque de gloria atque eiusdem laude agitur apud Christifideles augenda, operam esse dandam arbitramur
image_title_latin: Imago Beatae Mariae Virginis Immaculatae vulgo « Visita » nuncupata
church_or_sanctuary: parish church of Malabon
notes: Act begins on printed page 17 (passage printed_page is 15). The Pope commits to Jaime L. Card. Sin, Archbishop of Manila, the task of imposing the crown in his name, in person or through another; no coronation date given. Petition dated 25 June 1986, supported by Ricardo Card. Vidal of Cebu. Country explicit ('in Insularum Philippinarum finibus').

rubric_latin: Cartagenae, V expleto saeculo ab Evangelio D. N. Iesu Christi in Columbia nuntiato habita.
image_title_vernacular: Virgen de la Candelaria (Nuestra Señora de la Candelaria del Cerro de la Popa)
church_or_sanctuary: Santuario del Cerro de la Popa
notes: Spanish-language papal address, 6 July 1986 (footnote 'Die 6 m. Iulii a. 1986'): 'la Virgen de la Candelaria, cuya venerada imagen vamos a coronar solemnemente'. The crowning is announced as imminent but no date is stated for it, hence coronation_date null; it presumably took place at that celebration. Diocese name supplied in Latin form as 'Carthaginensis in Columbia' - a checker should verify.

rubric_latin: Sanctuarium vulgo nuncupatum « Madonna Consolatrice del Carpinelle », quod in oppido « Visciano » intra fines Ecclesiae Nolanae exstat, ad Basilicae Minoris dignitatem evehitur.
incipit_latin: Intra fines Nolanae dioecesis in oppido « Visciano » Sanctuarium clarum exstat vulgo nuncupatum « Madonna Consolatrice del Carpinello »
image_title_latin: byzantina imago Beatae Mariae Virginis cum Iesu Infante
church_or_sanctuary: Sanctuarium « Madonna Consolatrice del Carpinello »
notes: Basilica Minor elevation act stating 'quam Vaticanum Capitulum die xx mensis Aprilis anno MDCCCLXXXVI sollemni ritu coronavit'. The rubric spells 'Carpinelle', the body 'Carpinello'. Country inferred from Nola/Visciano.

rubric_latin: B. M. V. de Consolatione imago quae in ecclesia paroeciali vulgo « Wlodawa-Orchówek », in Poloniae finibus, colitur, diademate « nomine et auctoritate Summi Pontificis » redimitur.
incipit_latin: Saepe Nos memoria repetentes innumera beneficia in catholicam Ecclesiam indesinenter a B. V. Maria collata, pietatem nimirum erga tantam tamque munificam fidelium omnium matrem patronamque confirmari
image_title_latin: B. M. V. de Consolatione imago
church_or_sanctuary: parish church of Włodawa-Orchówek
notes: Faculty granted to Ioannes Mazur, Bishop of Siedlce, to crown the image in the Pope's name on a feast day, in person or through another; no coronation date given. Country explicit in the rubric ('in Poloniae finibus'). No vernacular title in the act; the Latin has 'B. M. V. de Consolatione'.

rubric_latin: Imago B. M. V. quae in ecclesia Sanctissimae Trinitatis in oppido « Gliwice » asservatur, pretioso diademate redimiri sinitur.
incipit_latin: Nostri Pontificatus ab initio Virginis Mariae cultum atque amorem continenter in universo christiano populo excitare et augere satagimus
image_title_latin: Imago Beatae Mariae Virginis de « Lysiec »
church_or_sanctuary: church of the Most Holy Trinity, Gliwice
notes: Act begins on printed page 514 (passage printed_page is 513); the volume index also cites it at p. 514. The task of crowning is committed to Iosephus Card. Glemp, Archbishop of Gniezno-Warsaw and President of the Polish Bishops' Conference, or a delegate; petition dated 16 Feb. 1987; no coronation date given. Country not named directly: inferred from 'Coetus Episcoporum Poloniae' and Gliwice/Opole. This act was re-printed at AAS 79 (1987) 833. No vernacular title in the act; the image is named from the place 'Lysiec' (Łysiec).

rubric_latin: Imago B. M. V. quae in ecclesia Sanctissimae Trinitatis in oppido « Gliwice » asservatur, pretioso diademate redimiri sinitur.
incipit_latin: Nostri Pontificatus ab initio Virginis Mariae cultum atque amorem continenter in universo christiano populo excitare et augere satagimus
image_title_latin: Imago Beatae Mariae Virginis de « Lysiec »
church_or_sanctuary: church of the Most Holy Trinity, Gliwice
notes: Second printing of the same act already published at AAS 79 (1987) 514: it opens fasc. N. 7 (8 July 1987) under the heading LITTERAE APOSTOLICAE with no act number, and spells the date 'die sexto et vigesimo mensis Martii' where p. 514 has 'die xxvi mensis Martii'. Duplicate of the record for p. 514. Country inferred as above. No vernacular title in the act; the image is named from the place 'Lysiec' (Łysiec).

rubric_latin: Templum vulgo nuncupatum « Notre-Dame de Hanswijk », in archiepiscopali urbe Mechliniensi extans, ad Basilicae Minoris dignitatem evehitur.
incipit_latin: Mechliniae, in Belgarum clarissima urbe, insigne exstat templum vulgo nuncupatum « Notre-Dame de Hanswijk »
image_title_latin: imago perantiqua Beatae Mariae Virginis
image_title_vernacular: Onze-Lieve-Vrouw van Hanswijk / Notre-Dame de Hanswijk
church_or_sanctuary: templum « Notre-Dame de Hanswijk »
notes: Basilica Minor elevation act stating the image was solemnly crowned by Cardinal Victor-Auguste Dechamps, Archbishop of Mechelen, on 30 July 1876 'nomine et auctoritate Pii PP. IX'. OCR 'tempulm' repaired to 'templum' in the incipit.

rubric_latin: Sinitur Archiepiscopus Caracensis Imaginem Beatae Mariae Virginis « de la Soledad », quae in urbe Caracis colitur, coronare.
incipit_latin: Quandoquidem beata Maria Virgo est Christi Mater castissima, e qua per Filium salus nostra manavit; et exemplar et imago ipsa virtutum
image_title_latin: Imago Beatae Mariae Virginis « Nuestra Señora de la Soledad »
church_or_sanctuary: church of St Francis of Assisi, Caracas
notes: Faculty granted to Iosephus Ali Card. Lebrun Moratinos, Archbishop of Caracas, or a man delegated by him, to crown the image in the Pope's name during Mass on a day of his choosing; no coronation date given. Country not named in the act: inferred from Caracas / archdiocese Caracensis. Datum 'anno MDCCCCLXXXVII' = 1987.

rubric_latin: Beatae Mariae Virginis Scapularis seu de Monte Carmelo imago quae in oppido « Czerna » colitur, in archidioecesis Cracoviensis finibus, sacro diademate redimitur.
incipit_latin: Dei Matris dilectionem et cultum quotiens profecto licet excitare in fidelium communitatibus et augere, Nos ardenti sane studio ac magna quadam laetitia perfundimur
image_title_latin: Imago Beatae Mariae Virginis Scapularis seu de Monte Carmelo
notes: Act begins on printed page 1447 (passage printed_page is 1446); confirmed by the volume index. Faculty granted to Franciscus Card. Macharski, Archbishop of Kraków, petition dated 22 Aug. 1987, to crown the image in the Pope's name in person or through another; no coronation date given. The rubric spells 'Scapularia', the body 'Scapularis'. Church not named (Carmelite shrine at Czerna). Country not named: inferred from Czerna / archdiocese of Kraków. No vernacular title in the act; the Latin has 'B. M. V. Scapularis seu de Monte Carmelo'.

rubric_latin: B. M. V. imago populari sermone « Virgen de los desamparados » appellata, quae in Sanctuario loci v. d. « El Saliente » asservatur, sacro diademate redimitur.
incipit_latin: Ministerii Nostri pontificalis ab initio Virginis Mariae cultum apud Dei plebem excitandum atque adeo augendum curavimus
image_title_latin: Imago Beatae Mariae Virginis « Virgen de los desamparados »
church_or_sanctuary: Sanctuary of El Saliente
notes: Act begins on printed page 366 (passage printed_page is 365). Faculty granted to Emmanuel O. Hervás, Bishop of Almería (petition dated 8 Oct.), or a delegate, to crown the image in the Pope's name; no coronation date given. Country not named in the act: inferred from the diocese of Almería. OCR reads 'EI Saliente' for 'El Saliente'.

rubric_latin: Fit facultas Episcopo Gorzoviensi sacram coronandi imaginem B. M. V. « Dominae patientis auditionis », quae in paroecia Rokitno eiusdem dioecesis pie colitur.
incipit_latin: Quam iucunda omnino cum animi recordatione, quam suavi simul cum pietatis adiectione ad locum simulacrum cultum revolvimur hodie
image_title_latin: imago B. M. V. « Dominae patientis exauditionis »
church_or_sanctuary: paroecia Rokitno
notes: Retrieved from txt for the AAS 80 index entry 'Dominae patientis auditionis ... 965'. The rubric reads 'patientis auditionis', the body 'patientis exauditionis'. Bishop: Józef Michalik.

rubric_latin: Sinitur Episcopus Lublinensis coronandi simulacrum B. M. V. « Dominae Nostrae Plorantis », quae pie servatur in cathedrali aede S. Ioannis.
incipit_latin: Complura inter sacella illa ac monumenta Marialia, quibus et merito Nostra patria Polonia catholica gloriatur
image_title_latin: simulacrum B. M. V. « Dominae Nostrae Plorantis »
church_or_sanctuary: cathedralis aedes Sancti Ioannis
notes: Passage printed_page is 967 but the act begins on p. 966 (rubric IV there, confirmed in txt and in the AAS 80 index); aas_page set to the act's start page. Bishop: Bolesław Pylak.

rubric_latin: Imago Beatae Mariae Victricis, quae Vratislaviae in Poloniae urbe pie colitur ibique in templo B.M.V. « in Arena » dedicato asservatur, pretioso diademate redimitur.
incipit_latin: Magno quidem honore dignissima existimanda videtur imago Beatae Mariae Victricis a saeculo XVI repetita
image_title_latin: imago Beatae Mariae Victricis
church_or_sanctuary: templum B.M.V. « in Arena » (Wrocław, NMP na Piasku)
notes: Retrieved from txt for the AAS 80 index entry 'B.M.V. Victricis ... 1101'. Petitioner: Card. Henryk Gulbinowicz.

rubric_latin: Pretioso diademate imago B. M. V. Deiparae redimitur, quae intra fines dioecesis Kaisiadorensis asservatur in paroeciali aede sacra loci « Pivasiünai » pieque excolitur.
incipit_latin: Ut Ecclesiae Kaisiadorensis memoriae proditum est, satis de peculiari venerationis cultu cognoscitur
image_title_latin: imago B. M. V. Deiparae
church_or_sanctuary: paroecialis aedes sacra loci Pivašiūnai
notes: Retrieved from txt for the AAS 80 index entry 'Pivasiünai ... 1398'. Apostolic Administrator: Vincentas Sladkevičius. Country explicit ('e regionibus Lituaniae').

rubric_latin: B. M. V. signum quod in ecclesia paroeciali loci v. d. Zakopane-Krzeptówki colitur ab Ipso Summo Pontifice pretioso diademate redimitur.
incipit_latin: Nemini quidem latet quanta dilectione quantoque filiali amore Nos ab ineunte aetate Beatam Mariam Virginem colamus
image_title_latin: B. M. V. signum
church_or_sanctuary: ecclesia paroecialis Zakopane-Krzeptówki
notes: Retrieved from txt for the AAS 80 index entry 'Ab ipso S. P. coronatur quae in loco Zakopane-Krzeptówki colitur, 1739'. The Pope crowned it himself in St Peter's Square: 'in Foro Petriano ... hoc ipso die, pridie IX anniversarii diei ab initio Pontificatus Nostri, simulacrum ... pretioso diademate coronavimus'. Coronation date taken as the Datum date (11 Oct 1987); the phrase 'pridie IX anniversarii' does not fit 11 October and should be checked. The image is a Fatima statue given by the Bishop of Leiria-Fátima to Card. Wyszyński. Petitioner: Card. Franciszek Macharski; country/diocese inferred from the Cracow archdiocese.

rubric_latin: Simulacrum B. M. V. in caelum Assumptae, quod intra fines dioecesis Sonsonensis-Rivi Nigri pie colitur ibique in templo oppidi « Marinilla » asservatur, diademate redimitur pretioso.
incipit_latin: Ut memoriae proditum est, haud licet de praecipuo venerationis cultu dubitare, quo intra fines Ecclesiae Sonsonensis-Rivi Nigri
image_title_latin: imago B. V. Mariae in caelum Assumptae
church_or_sanctuary: templum paroeciale loci « Marinilla »
notes: Retrieved from txt for the AAS 80 index entry 'Marinilla ... 1742'. Bishop: Alfonso Uribe Jaramillo. Country inferred from the see of Sonsón-Rionegro (act does not name Colombia).

rubric_latin: Beatae Mariae Virginis vulgo « La Virgen del Viejo » appellatae simulacrum, quod intra fines dioecesis Leonensis in Nicaragua excolitur, pretioso diademate redimitur.
incipit_latin: Quod est Ecclesiae Leonensis in Nicaragua memoriae proditum certisque comprobatur Curiae documentis, de peculiari venerationis cultu dubitari nequit
image_title_vernacular: La Virgen del Viejo (Nuestra Señora de El Viejo)
church_or_sanctuary: Sanctuarium eiusdem imaginis
notes: Source passage is the AAS 81 analytical index (p. 1429, s.v. 'Imagines B.M.V.'); act retrieved from txt and cited at its own page 824. Bishop: Julián Luis Barni.

rubric_latin: B.M.V. imago quae in oppido colitur Tecomán Colimensis dioecesis quamque vocant atque indigenae usurpant « Virgen de la Candelaria » Summi Pontificis nomine pretioso diademate redimitur.
incipit_latin: Principis Apostolorum obtinentes locum, erga Virginem Mariam cultum et filialem dilectionem in universo christiano populo excitare confirmareque nunquam destitimus
church_or_sanctuary: Sanctuarium oppidi Tecomán
notes: Act begins on printed p. 825 (passage printed_page is 824). Country Mexico inferred from the see of Colima and the town of Tecomán; not named in the act. Bishop José Fernández Arteaga of Colima, or his delegate, is commissioned to crown in the Pope's name.

rubric_latin: Memoriae proditur Summum Pontificem Ioannem Paulum II die undevicesimo mensis Iunii anno 1983 imaginem coronasse Beatae Mariae Virginis « Matris Pacis » in dioecesi Varmiensi.
incipit_latin: Maxima afficimur laetitia quotiescumque facultas Nobis contingit signum aliquod dandi Nostrae in Beatissimam Virginem Mariam pietatis
image_title_latin: Imago B. M. V. « Matris Pacis »
image_title_vernacular: Matka Boża Królowa Pokoju, Stoczek Warmiński
notes: Retrieved from txt for the AAS 81 index entry 'Matris Pacis, in dioec. Varmiensi, 827'. The Pope crowned the image at Jasna Góra, Częstochowa, on 19 June 1983 (one of the four images of the Częstochowa coronation address, AAS 75 p. 935). Bishop: Jan Obłąk.

rubric_latin: Memoriae proditur Summum Pontificem Ioannem Paulum II die decimo mensis Maii anno MCMXC in urbe Monterreyensi imaginem coronavisse Immaculatae Conceptionis Mariae, « Virgen Chiquita » appellatam.
incipit_latin: Imo ex pectore laetamur cum occasio Nobis datur ad Nostram pietatem in Beatissimam Virginem Mariam significandam
image_title_latin: Immaculata Conceptio Mariae
church_or_sanctuary: parish church raised to Basilica Minor by the Brief « Romanorum Pontificum » of 4 March 1989 (name not given in the act; the coronation itself took place « in Rivo Sancta Catharina urbis Monterreyensis »)
notes: The candidate passage is the volume's chronological index (printed page 1658), which points to the act at page 1512; per spec rule 5 the act's START page 1512 is used as aas_page. Full act text verified in txt/AAS-82-1990-ocr.txt at [[PDFPAGE 1512]]-1513: « ... aureo diademate, benedictione sacrato, sollemni redimiimus ritu ». No section roman numeral precedes the heading LITTERAE APOSTOLICAE, so act_number is null. Church name not stated in the act.

rubric_latin: Beata Maria Virgo titulo « Nuestra Señora de la Evangelización » invocata, Patrona apud Deum archidioecesis Limanae confirmatur.
incipit_latin: Antiquissimus sane et impensus ac praeclarissimus est quidem cultus quo Peruviani Christifideles, praesertim incolae Limani, prosequuntur Deiparam Virginem Mariam
notes: Patron-declaration act stating in passing that the Pope himself crowned the image: 'cuius veneratam imaginem - quinto decimo saeculo ab Imperatore Carolo V dono datam - Nos ipsi per primum Apostolicum Iter in eam Civitatem sollemni ritu coronavimus'. No coronation date given (the first papal visit to Peru was in Feb 1985), hence coronation_date null.

rubric_latin: B. M. V. imago quam incolae « Our Lady of the abandoned » quamque in ecclesia Manilensi Sanctae Annae veneramur Summi Pontificis nomine coronatur.
incipit_latin: Abhinc complures annos catholica fides in Philippinas insulas feliciter est invecta, quae tempore progrediente succrevit et ubere effloruit
church_or_sanctuary: ecclesia Sanctae Annae
notes: Located via the chronological index of AAS 83 (1991) at printed p. 1102; full text of the act read in the volume at p. 383. Card. Jaime Sin, Abp of Manila, or his delegate, is given the faculty of crowning the image.

rubric_latin: « Our lady of Mt. Carmel » imago quae in paroeciali basilica Manilensi Sancti Sebastiani servatur, sacro diademate coronatur.
incipit_latin: Philippinis in Insulis magno sane cum gaudio Beatam Virginem valde coli percipimus, quae autem res ad fidem confirmandam multum iuvat
church_or_sanctuary: basilica paroecialis Sancti Sebastiani
notes: Card. Jaime Sin, Abp of Manila, or his delegate, is commissioned to crown the image in the Pope's name. The act notes the statue was brought to the Philippines from abroad.

rubric_latin: Sanctuarium Beatae Mariae Virginis titulo « Maria SS.ma del Soccorso », quod in urbe Thermis Selinuntiis, vulgo « Sciacca » nuncupata, intra dioecesis Agrigentinae fines exstat, ad Basilicae Minoris gradum dignitatemque evehitur.
incipit_latin: In antiqua et praeclara quidem Siciliae urbe Thermis Selinuntiis, vulgo « Sciacca » nuncupata, intra Agrigentinae dioecesis fines posita, eminere novimus Sanctuarium
image_title_latin: simulacrum Deiparae Virginis titulo « Maria SS.ma del Soccorso »
church_or_sanctuary: Sanctuarium « Maria SS.ma del Soccorso »
notes: Basilica Minor elevation act stating 'quod die XV mensis Augusti anno MCMVII sollemni ritu coronavit Vaticanum Capitulum'. Bishop: Carmelo Ferraro. Country inferred from 'Siciliae urbe'.

rubric_latin: Imago Beatae Mariae Virginis titulo « Mirowskiej » invocatae quae in templo Ordinis Fratrum Minorum loci « Pinczow » intra fines Kielcensis dioecesis pie colitur, pretioso diademate redimiri sinitur « nomine et auctoritate Summi Pontificis ».
incipit_latin: Constat intra fines Kielcensis dioecesis in templo Ordinis Fratrum Minorum loci « Pinczow » inde a xvi saeculo Christifideles peculiari pietate venerari claram imaginem
church_or_sanctuary: templum Ordinis Fratrum Minorum
notes: Title given in the Latin text as « Mirowskiej » (Polish oblique form); vernacular nominative supplied. The image is a copy of Salus Populi Romani. Bishop Stanisław Szymecki of Kielce is empowered to crown in the Pope's name. The AAS 83 index (p. 1103) wrongly summarises this act as a basilica minor elevation.

rubric_latin: Imago Beatae Mariae Virginis titulo « Nuestra Señora del Carmen » invocatae, quae pie servatur in Sanctuario eidem dicato in Mexicana urbe « Catemaco », pretioso diademate redimiri sinitur « nomine et auctoritate Summi Pontificis ».
incipit_latin: Christifideles Mexicani dioecesis Sancti Andreae de Tuxtla finitimarumque Ecclesiarum singulari pietate colunt decoram imaginem Beatae Mariae Virginis
church_or_sanctuary: Sanctuarium B.M.V. del Carmen
notes: Bishop Guillermo Ranzahuer González (OCR 'Villelmus Ranzhauer González') of San Andrés Tuxtla is commissioned to crown in the Pope's name; his petition is dated 22 November 1991.

rubric_latin: Imago Deiparae Virginis de Fatima, quae pie servatur in templo paroeciali Beatae Mariae Virgini, Reginae Poloniae, dicato intra fines urbis Cracoviae regionis « Nowa Huta Bienczyce » appellatae, pretioso diademate redimiri sinitur « nomine et auctoritate Summi Pontificis ».
incipit_latin: Obversatur saepe ante Nostros oculos Deipara Virgo de Fatima, quam Christifideles urbis Cracoviae regionis « Nowa Huta Bienczyce » appellatae
image_title_latin: Deipara Virgo de Fatima
church_or_sanctuary: templum paroeciale B.M.V. Reginae Poloniae
notes: The Pope recalls having consecrated this parish church himself on 15 May 1977 as Archbishop of Kraków. Card. Franciszek Macharski is empowered to crown in the Pope's name; his petition is dated 20 February 1992.

rubric_latin: Beatae Mariae Virginis de Fatima simulacrum quod in templo servatur S. Petri Apostoli in urbe quam Wadowice vocant diademate redimitur.
incipit_latin: Cum Nos sollicito quidem studio Beatissimam Virginem Mariam usque prosequimur, tum etiam, quotiescumque de eiusdem gloria cultuque agitur apud fideles augendis
image_title_latin: Beata Maria Virgo de Fatima
church_or_sanctuary: templum S. Petri Apostoli
notes: The Pope states he crowned the statue himself ('sacro diademate Nos sollemniter coronavimus Ipsi') while at Wadowice during an apostolic journey to Poland; the act gives no date for the crowning, so coronation_date is null. Requested by Card. Franciszek Macharski. OCR runs words together in the incipit ('sollicitoquidem', 'Viginem'), silently repaired.

rubric_latin: Simulacrum Beatae Mariae Virginis, quae in dioecesi Onubensi pie sub titulo « Nuestra Señora de la Cinta » excolitur, merito diademate redimitur.
incipit_latin: Satis compertum habetur Christifideles Onubenses iam dudum certo venerationis cultu Beatam Mariam Virginem, vulgo « Nuestra Señora de la Cinta » appellatam, prosequi consuevisse
notes: Country Spain inferred from the see of Huelva (Onubensis); not named in the act. The act recalls that Paul VI declared her Patroness of the city of Huelva by the Letters « Praeclara Dei Genetrix » of 30 June 1964. Bishop Rafael González Moralejo is empowered to crown in the Pope's name. No church or sanctuary is named.

rubric_latin: Imago Beatae Mariae Virginis titulo « a Consolatione » invocatae, quae in ecclesia paroeciali pagi vulgo Pasierbiec appellati colitur, pretioso diademate redimiri sinitur nomine et auctoritate Summi Pontificis.
incipit_latin: Notum est Christifideles Polonici dioecesis Tarnoviensis ac propinquarum Ecclesiarum multa cum pietate colere imaginem Beatae Virginis Mariae
image_title_latin: Beata Maria Virgo a Consolatione
church_or_sanctuary: ecclesia paroecialis
notes: Bishop Józef Życiński of Tarnów is permitted to impose the crown in the Pope's name; his petition is dated 7 May 1992. Polish vernacular title supplied as the usual rendering of 'a Consolatione' - the act itself gives no vernacular form.

rubric_latin: Imago Beatae Mariae Virginis titulo « Nuestra Señora de Guadalupe de El Carrizal » invocatae, Patronae caelestis Corensis dioecesis, pretioso diademate redimiri sinitur « nomine et auctoritate Summi Pontificis ».
incipit_latin: Novimus clerum populumque Corensis dioecesis singulari colere pietate decoram imaginem Beatae Mariae Virginis titulo « Nuestra Señora de Guadalupe de El Carrizal » invocatae
image_title_vernacular: Nuestra Señora de Guadalupe de El Carrizal
notes: The act records that she was made heavenly Patroness of the diocese of Coro in 1928. Bishop Roberto Ovidio Pérez Morales (OCR 'Raimundus Ovidius') is commissioned to crown the image on a day of his choosing, in the Pope's name; his petition is dated 13 May 1992. Venezuela named indirectly ('tam dilectis Venetiolanis filiis'). No church named.

rubric_latin: Imago Matris Dei Dolorosae, quae pie servatur in paroeciali templo loci « Halcnów » intra fines Bielscensis-Zyviecensis dioecesis in Polonia, pretioso diademate sinitur redimiri « nomine et auctoritate Summi Pontificis ».
incipit_latin: Probe novimus in dilecta Polonica Natione Christifideles Bielscensis-Zyviecensis dioecesis finitimarumque regionum singulari pietate venerari antiquam et gratiosam imaginem Matris Dei Dolorosae
image_title_latin: Mater Dei Dolorosa
church_or_sanctuary: paroeciale templum loci « Halcnów »
notes: Bishop Tadeusz Rakoczy is commissioned to crown the image on a day of his choosing, in the Pope's name; his petition is dated 5 August 1992. The act notes both Polish and German faithful venerate the image. Polish vernacular title supplied as the standard rendering of 'Mater Dei Dolorosa'; not given in the act.

rubric_latin: Templum paroeciale Sancti Ioseph et Dominae Nostrae a Sacro Corde Iesu, quod in urbe Mexicopoli exstat, ad Basilicae Minoris gradum dignitatemque evehitur.
incipit_latin: Mexicopoli, in celebri atque amplissima urbe, exstat templum paroeciale Sancti Ioseph et Dominae Nostrae a Sacro Corde Iesu miris artis operibus clarum
image_title_latin: Domina Nostra a Sacro Corde Iesu
church_or_sanctuary: templum paroeciale Sancti Ioseph et Dominae Nostrae a Sacro Corde Iesu
notes: Coronation attested in passing in a Basilica Minor elevation: the image 'die xxvi mensis Septembris anno MCMXLVIII nomine et auctoritate Summi Pontificis Pii Pp. XII ... aureo diademate coronata est'. The crowning was therefore under Pius XII; the act here is by John Paul II. No vernacular title is given in the text.

rubric_latin: Imago Beatae Mariae Virginis titulo « Mater Misericordiae » invocatae, quae pie servatur in sacello cathedralis templi Bialostocensis, pretioso diademate redimiri sinitur « nomine et auctoritate Summi Pontificis ».
incipit_latin: Christifideles Bialostocenses singulari pietate colunt gratiosam imaginem Beatae Mariae Virginis titulo « Mater Misericordiae » invocatae
image_title_latin: Mater Misericordiae
church_or_sanctuary: sacellum cathedralis templi Bialostocensis
notes: Country Poland inferred from Białystok; not named in the act. The image is a copy of Our Lady of Vilnius (Ostra Brama); the Pope recalls consecrating the Białystok cathedral himself on 27 November 1977 as Archbishop of Kraków. The Archbishop of Białystok is commissioned to crown it on a day of his choosing, in the Pope's name; his petition is dated 12 December 1992. The act does not name him. Polish vernacular title supplied.

rubric_latin: Memoriae proditur Summum Pontificem Ioannem Paulum Pp. II per Apostolicam visitationem in Hispania die XIV mensis Iunii anno MCMXCIII pretioso diademate coronavisse imaginem beatae Mariae Virginis titulo « Nuestra Señora de los Milagros », quae in franciscali monasterio « de la Rábida » nuncupato pie colitur.
incipit_latin: Inter Apostolicam Nostram Visitationem in Hispania hoc anno die xiv huiusce mensis Iunii perquam libenter excipientes preces
image_title_latin: Beata Maria Virgo titulo « Nuestra Señora de los Milagros »
church_or_sanctuary: Monasterium franciscale « de la Rábida »
notes: John Paul II crowned the image himself during his apostolic visit to Spain; the act is the commemorative record. Petition of Bishop Rafael González Moralejo of Huelva, letters of 11 Jan. 1991.

rubric_latin: Imago Beatae Mariae Virginis titulo « Nuestra Señora de la Fuensanta » invocatae, quae pie colitur in Hispaniae urbe Cordium, pretioso diademate redimiri sinitur « nomine et auctoritate Summi Pontificis ».
incipit_latin: Cordubae, in antiqua et insigni Hispaniae urbe, iam a saeculo xv a fidelibus loci totiusque dioecesis peculiari veneratione colitur decora imago
image_title_latin: Beata Maria Virgo titulo « Nuestra Señora de la Fuensanta »
notes: Rubric as printed reads « in Hispaniae urbe Cordium »; the volume index and the body of the act read Corduba/Cordubae. Petition of Bishop José Antonio Infantes Florido, letters of 23 July 1993. Coronation to be performed in the Pope's name; no shrine church named in the passage.

rubric_latin: Imago Beatae Mariae Virginis Scapularis, quae pie servatur in ecclesia paroeciali Annuntiationis B.M.V., loco Tomaszów Lubelski in dioecesi Zamosciensi-Lubaczoviensi, pretioso diademate redimiri sinitur « nomine et auctoritate Summi Pontificis ».
incipit_latin: Imago illa Beatae Mariae Virginis Scapularis, quae exornat ecclesiam paroecialem Annuntiationis B.M.V, loco vulgo Tomaszów Lubelski
image_title_latin: Imago Beatae Mariae Virginis Scapularis
church_or_sanctuary: Ecclesia paroecialis Annuntiationis B.M.V.
notes: Act names the region as Polish (« illius Polonicae regionis »). Bishop Jan Śrutwa deputed to impose the crown in the Pope's name.

rubric_latin: Imago Beatae Mariae Virginis Auxiliatricis, quae pie servatur in ecclesia Sanctuarii B.M.V., loco Twardogóra in dioecesi Calissiensi, pretioso diademate redimiri sinitur « nomine et auctoritate Summi Pontificis ».
incipit_latin: In ecclesia sanctuario loci vulgo dicti Twardogóra gratiosa colitur imago B. Mariae Virginis Auxiliatricis.
image_title_latin: Imago Beatae Mariae Virginis Auxiliatricis
church_or_sanctuary: Ecclesia sanctuarii B.M.V.
notes: Country Poland inferred from the diocese of Kalisz and the place name; not stated in the act. Bishop Stanisław Napierała deputed to impose the crown.

rubric_latin: Beatae Mariae Virginis divinae Gratiae imago, quae in templo paroeciali S. Caroli Borromaei asservatur, in urbe Wratislaviensi, nomine et auctoritate Summi Pontificis coronatur.
incipit_latin: Saeculorum quidem decursu omnium ordinum fideles ad Virginem Mariam fidenti animo decurrerunt, pro comperto habentes superna se beneficia indulgenter accepturos.
image_title_latin: Beata Maria Virgo divinae Gratiae
church_or_sanctuary: Templum paroeciale S. Caroli Borromaei
notes: Country Poland inferred from the see of Wrocław; not stated in the act. Petition of Cardinal Henryk Roman Gulbinowicz, Archbishop of Wrocław.

rubric_latin: Imago Beatae Mariae Virginis Gratiarum, quae in ecclesia S. Francisci Assisiensis oppidi v.d. Wieliczka colitur, pretioso diademate redimitur.
incipit_latin: Merito invocatur a populo fideli Beata Virgo Maria, quae « mater nobis in ordine gratiae exstitit » (Lumen gentium, 61).
image_title_latin: Imago Beatae Mariae Virginis Gratiarum
church_or_sanctuary: Templum paroeciale sancto Francisco Assisiensi dicatum
notes: Country Poland inferred from Wieliczka and the archdiocese of Kraków; not stated in the act. Petition of Cardinal Franciszek Macharski, letters of 15 Dec. 1993. The act notes the Pope himself had formerly venerated the image.

rubric_latin: Imago Beatae Mariae Virginis de Perpetuo Succursu, pie servata in ecclesia paroeciali Sanctissimo Redemptori dicata, loco Podgórze, Cracoviae in regione, pretioso diademate redimiri sinitur « nomine et auctoritate Summi Pontificis ».
incipit_latin: Sacra illa paroecialis aedes Sanctissimo Redemptori dicata loco Podgórze, Cracoviae in regione, gratiosam imaginem Beatae Mariae Virginis de Perpetuo Succursu servat
image_title_latin: Imago Beatae Mariae Virginis de Perpetuo Succursu
church_or_sanctuary: Ecclesia paroecialis Sanctissimo Redemptori dicata
notes: Country Poland inferred from Kraków; not stated in the act. Cardinal Franciszek Macharski deputed to impose the crown in the Pope's name.

rubric_latin: Imago Beatae Mariae Virginis, quae sub titulo « Nuestra Señora de Monserrate » in sacrario eiusdem nominis pie colitur, pretioso diademate redimitur.
incipit_latin: Omnibus manifestum est a primordiis evangelizationis Americae Beatam Virginem Mariam vehementer ibi auxiliari, qua de causa a populo fideli prolixe colitur.
image_title_latin: Imago Beatae Mariae Virginis sub titulo « Nuestra Señora de Monserrate »
church_or_sanctuary: Sacrarium « Nuestra Señora de Monserrate »
notes: Retrieved from the act itself; the batch passage is the back-of-volume 'Index rerum analyticus' (p. 1071) which points here. Petitioner: Ulixes Aurelius Casiano Vargas, Episcopus Maiaguezensis. Country explicit ('totius Portus Divitis Nationis'). Locality NOT given in the act — 'Hormigueros' is supplied from outside knowledge of this shrine and should be verified or dropped.

rubric_latin: Beatae Mariae Virginis « de Guadalupe » imago, quae paroeciali in templo urbis « Puerto de Manzanillo » asservatur, nomine et auctoritate Summi Pontificis coronatur.
incipit_latin: Progredientibus quidem temporibus omnium ordinum fideles ad Virginem Mariam fidenti animo decurrerunt, pro comperto habentes superna se beneficia indulgenter accepturos.
image_title_latin: Beata Maria Virgo « de Guadalupe »
church_or_sanctuary: Templum paroeciale eiusdem tituli (parish church of Our Lady of Guadalupe)
notes: The act speaks of the devotion « apud Mexicanas gentes »; petition of Bishop Gilberto Valbuena Sánchez of Colima. The volume's alphabetical index cites p. 943, the chronological index and the act itself p. 942.

rubric_latin: Imago Beatae Mariae Virginis, quae pie servatur in ecclesia paroeciali B.M.V. a Sancto Rosario et Sancti Stanislai, episcopi et martyris, loco Myszków-Mrzyglód in archidioecesi Czestochoviensi, pretioso diademate redimiri sinitur « nomine et auctoritate Summi Pontificis ».
incipit_latin: Imago illa Beatae Mariae Virginis « Assumptae in Caelum Reginae Sancti Rosarii », quae exornat ecclesiam paroecialem Beatae Mariae Virgini a Sancto Rosario et Sancto Stanislao
image_title_latin: Beata Maria Virgo « Assumpta in Caelum Regina Sancti Rosarii »
church_or_sanctuary: Ecclesia paroecialis B.M.V. a Sancto Rosario et Sancti Stanislai, episcopi et martyris
notes: Country Poland inferred from the archdiocese of Częstochowa; not stated in the act. OCR renders the place as « Myszkòw-Mrzyglòd ». Archbishop Stanisław Nowak deputed to impose the crown.

rubric_latin: Imago Beatae Mariae Virginis sub titulo « Sanctissimi Rosarii », pie servata in ecclesia loco vulgo dicto Ubanon in dioecesi Calbayogana, pretioso diademate redimiri sinitur « nomine et auctoritate Summi Pontificis »
incipit_latin: Sacra illa aedes quae loco vulgo dicto Ubanon in dioecesi Calbayogana exstat, gratiosam imaginem Beatae Mariae Virginis sub titulo « Sanctissimi Rosarii » servat
image_title_latin: Beata Maria Virgo sub titulo « Sanctissimi Rosarii »
image_title_vernacular: Our Lady of the Most Holy Rosary
notes: Country Philippines inferred from the diocese of Calbayog (Samar); not stated in the act. Place name « Ubanon » as printed (possibly Obando/Ubanon — verify). Bishop Maximino T. Cruz deputed to impose the crown.

rubric_latin: Imago Beatae Virginis sub titulo « Sancta Maria, Populorum Regina » servata in ecclesia loco vulgo dicto Preval in archidioecesi Goritiensi, pretioso diademate redimiri sinitur « nomine et auctoritate Summi Pontificis »
incipit_latin: Sacra illa aedes, quae loco vulgo dicto Preval in archidioecesi Goritiensi exstat, gratiosam imaginem Beatae Virginis sub titulo « Sancta Maria, Populorum Regina » servat
image_title_latin: Beata Virgo sub titulo « Sancta Maria, Populorum Regina »
image_title_vernacular: Santa Maria Regina dei Popoli (Madonna di Preval)
notes: Country Italy inferred from the archdiocese of Gorizia; not stated in the act. The act notes veneration by faithful of various nations for five hundred years. Archbishop Antonio Vitale Bommarco deputed to impose the crown.

rubric_latin: Beatae Mariae Virginis imago, quae in Sanctuario mariali loci « Zarosice » intra fines Brunensis dioecesis pie colitur, pretioso diademate redimiri sinitur « nomine et auctoritate Summi Pontificis ».
incipit_latin: Constat Christifideles Moraviae et propinquae Slovachiae Nationis necnon finitimarum Austriae regionum peculiari veneratione colere decoram imaginem beatae Mariae Virginis
church_or_sanctuary: Sanctuarium mariale loci Žarošice
notes: OCR renders the place as « Zarosice »/« áíarosice » (Žarošice). Country inferred from Moravia and the diocese of Brno (the act names Moravia but not the state). Image venerated there since the 14th century; petition of Bishop Vojtěch Cikrle, letters of 26 Feb. 1995.

rubric_latin: Imago Beatae Virginis servata in ecclesia Exaltationi Sanctae Crucis dicata loco vulgo dicto Brzesc in dioecesi Pinskensi Latinorum, pretioso diademate redimiri sinitur nomine et auctoritate Summi Pontificis.
incipit_latin: Beata Virgo Maria divinae maternitatis dono et munere, quo cum Filio Redemptore unitur, suisque singularibus gratiis et muneribus, etiam cum Ecclesia intime coniungitur
church_or_sanctuary: Ecclesia Exaltationi Sanctae Crucis dicata
notes: Country Belarus inferred from the Latin diocese of Pinsk and the place Brzesc (Brest); not stated in the act. Cardinal Kazimierz Świątek, Apostolic Administrator of Pinsk, deputed to impose the crown. No title given for the image.

rubric_latin: Imago Mariae Sanctissimae quae in ecclesia oppidi v.d. Budslaw colitur, pretioso diademate redimitur.
incipit_latin: Purissima Virgo Maria « imago Ecclesiae est, forma et anticipatio humani generis gratia renovati, exemplar spesque certa iis omnibus qui caelestem ad Hierosolymitanam civitatem procedunt » (Orientale lumen, 6).
church_or_sanctuary: Ecclesia Beatae Mariae Virgini in caelum assumptae
notes: Country Belarus inferred from the archdiocese of Minsk-Mohilev; not stated in the act. Cardinal Kazimierz Świątek (OCR: « &wiatek ») deputed to impose the crown solemnly. Cf. AAS 88 (1996) 695, which states the crowning took place in 1995.

rubric_latin: Imago Mariae Sanctissimae quae in ecclesia paroeciali Sanctorum Apostolorum Petri et Pauli oppidi v. d. Lahiszyn colitur, pretioso diademate redimitur.
incipit_latin: Spei signum inter nova rerum adiuncta apparet Immaculata Virgo Maria, « spiritalis Mater quae pro Christi discipulis intercedit et pro cuncta humanitate » (Ut unum sint, 79)
church_or_sanctuary: Ecclesia paroecialis Sanctorum Apostolorum Petri et Pauli
notes: Country Belarus inferred from the Latin diocese of Pinsk; not stated in the act. Cardinal Kazimierz Świątek, Apostolic Administrator of Pinsk, deputed to impose the crown; his letters of 29 April 1995.

rubric_latin: Imago Beatae Mariae Virginis sub titulo « Porta Misericordiae », quae in templo Transfigurationis Domini Iaroslaviae colitur, pretioso diademate redimitur.
incipit_latin: Dei Genetrix Maria « ea quidem est quae divinae misericordiae interius percipit mysterium » (Dives in misericordia, 9)
image_title_latin: Beata Maria Virgo sub titulo « Porta Misericordiae »
church_or_sanctuary: Templum Transfigurationis Domini
notes: Country Poland inferred from Jarosław and the Ukrainian Byzantine-rite eparchy of Przemyśl; not stated in the act. Bishop Ioannes (Jan) Martyniak permitted to crown the image in the Pope's name; his letters of 28 Nov. 1994.

rubric_latin: Memoriae proditur Summum Pontificem Ioannem Paulum II per Apostolicam Visitationem in Republica Cecha die XXI mensis Maii anno MCMXCV coronavisse imaginem Beatae Mariae Virginis, quae pie colitur in Sanctuario mariali loci « Zarosice » intra fines Brunensis dioecesis.
incipit_latin: Inter Apostolicam Nostram Visitationem in dilecta Cecha Republica hoc anno, die xxi mensis Maii, in Sanctuario « Svaty Kopecek » prope urbem Olomocium perquam libenter excipientes preces...
image_title_latin: Antiqua Mater Dei-Thaumaturga Moraviae
church_or_sanctuary: Sanctuarium mariale loci « Zarosice » (Žarošice)
notes: Identified from the chronological index on p. 999-1001; rubric, incipit and date taken from the act itself at p. 146. The Pope himself crowned the image of the Virgin with the Child Jesus (kept by the Canons Regular of the Holy Cross with the Red Star) during his visit, at the Svatý Kopeček sanctuary near Olomouc; requested by Bp Vojtěch (Adalbertus) Cikrle of Brno. Country not stated in the act; inferred from the Latin diocese/place name.

rubric_latin: Sanctuarium nationale Nicaraguanum, quod beatae Mariae Virgini immaculate Conceptae dicatum, in urbe « El Viejo » intra fines dioecesis Leonensis in Nicaragua exstat, ad Basilicae Minoris gradum dignitatemque evehitur.
incipit_latin: Inter insignes sacras aedes dilectae Nicaraguanae Nationis merito recensetur templum beatae Mariae Virgini immaculate Conceptae dicatum, quod in urbe « El Viejo »...
image_title_latin: Imago Deiparae Virginis titulo Immaculatae Conceptionis
image_title_vernacular: La Inmaculada Concepción de El Viejo
church_or_sanctuary: Sanctuarium nationale Nicaraguanum (El Viejo)
notes: Basilica Minor elevation which states in passing that the image, brought in 1565, was solemnly crowned in 1747 ('volvente anno MDCCXLVII inter iubilantes cives sollemni ritu coronata est'). The act does NOT say by whose authority the 1747 crowning was done. Vernacular title supplied from the Latin.

rubric_latin: Imago beatae Mariae Virginis titulo « Mare de Déu de Paret-Delgada », quae pie colitur in Sanctuario eiusdem nominis in civitate « La Selva del Camp » intra fines Tarraconensis archidioecesis, pretioso diademate redimiri sinitur « nomine et auctoritate Summi Pontificis ».
incipit_latin: Antiqua quidem et singulari pietate colitur imago beatae Mariae Virginis titulo « Mare de Déu de Paret-Delgada » invocatae
image_title_latin: Beata Maria Virgo titulo « Mare de Déu de Paret-Delgada »
image_title_vernacular: Mare de Déu de Paret Delgada
church_or_sanctuary: Sanctuarium « Mare de Déu de Paret-Delgada »
notes: The act addresses « istis dilectis Hispaniae filiis ». Petition of Archbishop Ramón Torrella Cascante, letters of 9 Feb. 1996.

rubric_latin: Imago Beatae Mariae Virginis Dolorosae quae in ecclesia oppidi v.d. Skulsk colitur, pretioso diademate redimitur « nomine et auctoritate Summi Pontificis ».
incipit_latin: In dolorosae Christi Matris vitam « permultae et vehementes passiones confluxerunt in talem nexum et colligationem, ut non solum fidem eius inconcussam comprobarent »
image_title_latin: Sanctissima Maria Virgo Mater Dolorosa
church_or_sanctuary: Ecclesia paroecialis oppidi Skulsk
notes: Country Poland inferred from the diocese of Włocławek and the place Skulsk; not stated in the act. OCR of the quotation reads « eolli-gationem » (colligationem). Bishop Bronisław Dembowski, letters of 2 Feb. 1996.

rubric_latin: Imago beatae Mariae Virginis « Matris Adorantis », quae in cathedrali templo metropolitanae Sedis Vratislaviensis pie colitur, pretioso diademate redimiri sinitur « nomine et auctoritate Summi Pontificis ».
incipit_latin: Probe novimus Christifideles Vratislaviae civitatis totiusque archidioecesis singulari pietate colere imaginem beatae Mariae Virginis « Matris Adorantis »
image_title_latin: Beata Maria Virgo « Mater Adorans »
church_or_sanctuary: Templum cathedrale Sancto Ioanni Baptistae dicatum
notes: The act addresses « istis dilectis Polonicis filiis ». The image is said to have been given by Clement XI to Alexander Sobieski, son of King John III. Petition of Cardinal Henryk Roman Gulbinowicz, letters of 10 Feb. 1996.

rubric_latin: Memoriae proditur Summum Pontificem Ioannem Paulum II die uno et vicesimo mensis Maii anno MCMXCV, occasione data visitationis Apostolicae in urbe Olomucensi, imaginem coronavisse Beatae Mariae Virginis, quae sub titulo Matris Dei in sacra aede Visitationis loco vulgo dicto « Svaty Kopecek » archidioecesis Olomucensis veneratur.
incipit_latin: Gaudio exsultamus cum occasio Nobis datur ut Nostram pietatem in Beatissimam Virginem Mariam significemus
image_title_latin: Beata Maria Virgo sub titulo Matris Dei
church_or_sanctuary: Sacra aedes Visitationis B.M.V. (basilica of the Visitation)
notes: Country Czech Republic inferred from Olomouc; not stated in the act. John Paul II crowned the image himself during his apostolic visit of 21 May 1995, at the request of Archbishop Jan Graubner; the act is the commemorative record. The same act also appears at the end of passage AAS-88-1996-ocr#627.

rubric_latin: Sancta Dei Genetrix Maria, cuius imago recolitur in pago Budslaw, Patrona caelestis archidioecesis Minscensis Latinorum-Mohiloviensis Latinorum confirmatur.
incipit_latin: Sanctam Dei Matrem, cuius gratiosa imago servata in sanctuario Budslaviensi superiore anno Nostro nomine et auctoritate pretioso diademate est redimita
church_or_sanctuary: Sanctuarium Budslaviense; ecclesia Beatae Mariae Virgini in caelum assumptae
notes: Patron-confirmation act that states in passing that the Budslaw image was crowned « superiore anno » in the Pope's name and authority, i.e. in 1995 (the concession is AAS 87 [1995] 833, dated 7 June 1995). Country Belarus inferred from the archdiocese; not stated in the act.

rubric_latin: Imago Beatae Mariae Virginis Gratiarum, quae sub titulo « Matki Bozej Laskawej » in sanctuario loci v.d. Krzeszów pie colitur, pretioso diademate redimiri sinitur « nomine et auctoritate Summi Pontificis ».
incipit_latin: Silesiae antiquissima Deiparae Virginis suavis imago, quae a multis iam saeculis in ecclesia loci v.d. Krzeszów custoditur, populi renovata devotione volumus cumuletur.
image_title_latin: Beata Maria Virgo Gratiarum
church_or_sanctuary: Sanctuarium loci v.d. Krzeszów
notes: Granted at the request of Bp Thaddaeus (Tadeusz) Rybak of Legnica, whose letters are dated 12 Feb 1996. OCR splits the title as « Matki Bozej Laska-wej ». Country not stated in the act; inferred from the Latin diocese/place name.

rubric_latin: Imago Beatae Mariae Virginis Immaculatae, quae sub titulo « Nuestra Señora de Monterrey » in ecclesia cathedrali Monterreyensi pie colitur, pretioso diademate redimitur.
incipit_latin: Primi Americae continentis evangelizatores Beatae Virginis Mariae cultum ubique propagaverunt, pro certo habentes sane caelestem Reginam sibi auxilium praebituram.
image_title_latin: Beata Maria Virgo Immaculata
church_or_sanctuary: Ecclesia cathedralis Monterreyensis
notes: Requested by Adolfo Antonio Card. Suárez Rivera, Archbishop of Monterrey (letters of 14 March 1996); the image is said to have been venerated there for 400 years. Country not stated in the act; inferred from the Latin diocese/place name.

rubric_latin: Imago Beatae Mariae Virginis, quae sub titulo « Consolatrix Afflictorum » in ecclesia paroeciali loci v. d. Miedzna in dioecesi Drohiczinensi pie colitur, pretioso diademate redimitur.
incipit_latin: Lucis Matrem fecundam et Virginem purissimam omnis populus christianus firmiter confitetur Reginam caelestem, ad quam sane constanter in omnibus necessitatibus confugit.
image_title_latin: Consolatrix Afflictorum
church_or_sanctuary: Ecclesia paroecialis loci Miedzna
notes: These Letters commemorate a faculty already granted on 27 July 1996 ('concessimus die xxvii superioris mensis Iulii') at the request of Bp Antoni Pacyfik Dydycz, and the solemn coronation that followed; the exact coronation date is not given. Country not stated in the act; inferred from the Latin diocese/place name.

rubric_latin: Imago Beatae Mariae Virginis de Fatima, quae in ecclesia paroeciali oppidi v.d. Trzebinia in archidioecesi Cracoviensi colitur, pretioso diademate redimitur.
incipit_latin: « Mater pulchrae dilectionis, christianis tertii millennii in magnum Iubilaeum procedentibus quoddam erit Sidus, quod firmiter gressus Domino obviam moderabitur » (Tertio millennio adveniente, 59).
image_title_latin: Beata Maria Virgo de Fatima
church_or_sanctuary: Ecclesia paroecialis Sacratissimi Cordis Iesu
notes: Requested by Franciszek Card. Macharski, Archbishop of Kraków (letters of 17 June 1996). The same act is also visible at the end of passage AAS-88-1996-ocr#910. Country not stated in the act; inferred from the Latin diocese/place name.

rubric_latin: Imago Nostrae Dominae « de Indejo » quae in ecclesia oppidi v.d. Las Fraguas colitur, pretioso diademate redimitur.
incipit_latin: « Dominus natus est ex Maria, humani generis in se peccata suscipiens, remissionem tribuit omnium delictorum » (S. Ambrosius, Expositio ev. sec. Lucam, VIII, 23).
image_title_latin: Nostra Domina « de Indejo »
church_or_sanctuary: Ecclesia oppidi Las Fraguas
notes: Both the act and the volume index print the title as « de Indejo »; the shrine at Las Fraguas (Soria) is normally called Nuestra Señora de Inodejo, so the printed form is probably a misreading — verify. Bp Francisco Pérez González is deputed to impose the crown in the Pope's name (letters of 2 July 1996); the act mentions the 14th centenary of the diocese. Country not stated in the act; inferred from the Latin diocese/place name.

rubric_latin: Imago Beatae Mariae Virginis sub titulo « Matris Consolationis », pie servata Gnesnae in ecclesia dicata Beatae Mariae Virgini in caelum Assumptae, pretioso diademate redimiri sinitur « nomine et auctoritate Summi Pontificis ».
incipit_latin: Mater Iesu, in historiam salutis intime ingressa, maxima fidei placita in se quodammodo unit et reverberat, dum praedicatur et colitur.
image_title_latin: Mater Consolationis
church_or_sanctuary: Ecclesia B.M.V. in caelum Assumptae, Gnesnae
notes: Abp Henryk Muszyński of Gniezno is deputed to impose the crown in the Pope's name. Country not stated in the act; inferred from the Latin diocese/place name.

rubric_latin: Memoriae proditur Summum Pontificem Ioannem Paulum PP. II occasione data pastoralis visitationis archidioecesis Brundusinae-Ostunensis die XXVI mensis Octobris anno MCMXCVI coronavisse imaginem Beatae Mariae Virginis sub titulo « Nicopeia », quae religiose colitur in ecclesia paroeciali Sanctae Mariae a Victoria in oppido v.d. « San Vito dei Normanni ».

The place is printed « Skrzynsko » here and « Skrzyiisko » in the volume index (p. 1055). Country not stated in the act; inferred from the Latin diocese/place name.

rubric_latin: Sanctuarium Civitatis Castelli dioecesis, quod in loco « Colle di Canoscio » est dicatum beatae Mariae Virgini titulo « Madonna del Transito » invocatae, ad Basilicae minoris gradum dignitatemque evehitur.

rubric_latin: Sanctuarium Tlalnepantlanae archidioecesis, quod est dicatum beatae Mariae Virgini titulo « Nuestra Señora de los Remedios » invocatae, ad Basilicae minoris gradum dignitatemque evehitur.

rubric_latin: Ad Cubae sacros praesules.
incipit_latin: Me complace recibirlos en esta Audiencia, a pocos meses de mi recordado viaje a su Patria.
image_title_vernacular: Virgen de la Caridad del Cobre
notes: Allocution (in Spanish) to the bishops of Cuba on their ad limina visit, AAS 91 (1999) 105-109, dated 'Die 9 Iunii 1998'; the coronation reference stands on printed page 109, at the end of the act (printed_page of the passage is 109, but the act begins on 105). The Pope names only the devotional title, with no word for image: 'A la Virgen de la Caridad del Cobre, Madre de todos los cubanos, recordando con emocion el momento en que le ceni la corona que sus hijos le ofrecieron...' - i.e. he himself set on her the crown her children had offered. The crowning took place during his apostolic visit to Cuba (the act refers to 'mi visita a Cuba' / 'mi inolvidable Viaje' of January 1998, citing his 21 January 1998 Havana airport address, so coronation_date is given as 1998); the exact day and place (Santiago de Cuba, 24 January 1998) are NOT stated in the source and have not been supplied. Country 'Cuba' is explicit in the text ('Madre de todos los cubanos', address to the Cuban bishops). No sanctuary or diocese is named.

rubric_latin: Imago beatae Mariae Virginis titulo « Nostra Seynora de Canòlich » invocatae, quae pie colitur in Andorrae Principatus oppido « Sant Julia de Loria » intra fines Urgellensis dioecesis posito, pretioso diademate redimiri sinitur « nomine et auctoritate Summi Pontificis ».

church_or_sanctuary: paroeciale templum (parish church of Sant Julià de Lòria)
notes: Coronation granted 'Nostro nomine et auctoritate' but no date of the crowning given. Petition of Bishop Ioannes Martí Alanis, letters of 15 October [1998]. OCR gives the vernacular title as « Nostra Seynora de Canòlich » (Catalan 'Senyora'); the oppidum is printed « Sant Julia de Loria » (Sant Julià de Lòria). Country explicit in the text ('Andorrae Principatus').

rubric_latin: Templum paroeciale Sanctae Mariae a Victoria, quod in urbe « San Vito dei Normanni » intra fines archiepiscopalis sedis Brundusinae-Ostunensis exstat, ad Basilicae minoris gradum dignitatemque evehitur.
incipit_latin: Inter sacras aedes antiquae et insignis archiepiscopalis sedis Brundusinae-Ostunensis merito celebratur paroeciale templum Sanctae Mariae a Victoria in urbe « S. Vito dei Normanni »

church_or_sanctuary: Templum paroeciale Sanctae Mariae a Victoria

Could equally be classed papal_personal_coronation, but the act's own object is the basilica title. Only the year (1996) of the crowning is given, in St Peter's Square. Country (Italy) inferred from San Vito dei Normanni / Brindisi-Ostuni, not stated. Act begins on printed page 346; passage printed_page was 345.

rubric_latin: Memoriae proditur Summum Pontificem Ioannem Paulum PP. II occasione Audientiae generalis in area quae respicit Basilicam Vaticanam die III mensis Iulii anno MCMXCVIII coronavisse gratiosam imaginem Beatae Mariae Virginis sub titulo Matka Niezawodnej Nadziei, quae pie colitur in oratorio loci v.d. Jamna, in dioecesi Tarnoviensi.
incipit_latin: Firma spe restituta in pago v.d. Jamna, ubi tempore belli militum crudelitas locum fecit desolationis, nunc iuvenes una cum ferventi suo moderatore dilecto Filio Ioanne Gòra, OP
image_title_latin: imago Beatae Virginis Mariae sub titulo Matka Niezawodnej Nadziei

The Pope placed a golden crown ('auream imposuimus coronam') on the image at the general audience in St Peter's Square, 3 July 1998; recently painted image, at the youth prayer/formation centre founded by Fr Jan Góra OP. Requested by Bishop Wiktor Skworc of Tarnów. Country (Poland) inferred from the Tarnów diocese and the Polish title; not stated in the text.

rubric_latin: Memoriae proditur Ioannem Paulum PP. II coronavisse imaginem beatae Mariae Virginis, quae titulo « Maria Santissima della Neve del Monte Sirino » invocata Lacuneruli colitur.

rubric_latin: Ad Cubae sacros praesules.
image_title_vernacular: Virgen de la Caridad del Cobre
church_or_sanctuary: Santuario del Cobre

The Pope recalls in passing 'la imagen de la Virgen de la Caridad, Madre y Reina de Cuba, que tuve el gozo de coronar'. Not a coronation act; the date (during the January 1998 visit to Cuba) is inferred from the surrounding references to that journey — verify. Diocese not stated in the passage.

rubric_latin: Leopoli in beatificatione servorum Dei Iosephi Bilczewski et Sigismundi Gorazdowski.

notes: 'Za chwilę dokonam koronacji łaskami słynącego obrazu Matki Bożej Łaskawej Pani Lwowa' (p. 850) and, earlier in the same homily, 'Maryi, Matki Bożej Łaskawej, od wieków czczonej przez was w wizerunku, który dzisiaj z radością ukoronuję ... obrazem, pamiętającym śluby króla Jana Kazimierza' (p. 849). Homily at the beatification of Józef Bilczewski and Zygmunt Gorazdowski, Lviv, 26 June 2001. Act begins on printed page 844; the passage's printed_page is 850. The text links this image to the vows of King John Casimir, as it does the Lubaczów image crowned in 1983 (AAS 75, p. 935) — a checker should verify the relation between the two. Body in Polish, no Latin incipit.

rubric_latin: Sanctuario Dominae Nostrae del Valle Catamarcensis dioecesis Rosa aurea tribuitur.
